cards.product: Bicycles using RockShox Domain 302 and 318 bicycle forks
cards.title: Bicycles with RockShox Bicycle Forks Recalled by SRAM LLC Due to Crash Hazard
cards.hazard: The steel steerer on the forks can crack, causing the fork to detach from the bicycle frame. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using bicycles equipped with these forks immediately and contact their bicycle retailer for a free replacement fork.
cards.tell: Recalled forks have steel steerers, manufacture date codes 09T8 through 42T8 located on the back of the fork crown and lower leg, and were manufactured between March and October 2008.

cards.title: Fire Alarm Control Panels Recalled by Notifier Due to Alert Failure
cards.hazard: The software in the fire alarm system could fail to process an alarm condition which could result in the system failing to respond in the event of a fire.
cards.remedy: Distributors should immediately contact the company for replacement software. All known users of have been contacted.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the firmware version 11.2.2 for NFS2-640 and NFS-320 control panels, and firmware version 3.14.1 for NFS-640 control panels.

cards.product: Wiring a House, 3rd Edition and Wiring Complete, Expert Advice from Start to Finish Instructional Books
cards.title: Faulty Instructions Prompt Recall of Electrical Wiring How-to-Books by The Taunton Press; Shock Hazard to Consumers
cards.hazard: The books contain several errors in the technical diagrams that could lead consumers to incorrectly install or repair electrical wiring, posing an electrical shock hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the books and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled books by checking the ISBN number printed on the back cover.

cards.title: Boys Reversible Vests Recalled by Bon-Ton Stores Due to Choking Hazard
cards.hazard: The zipper tabs on these vests fail to meet the children's torques test standards, posing a choking hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take these vests away from children and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund.
cards.tell: Check the style number on the price tag and look for the Ruff Hewn tag found in the left pocket of the brown side.

cards.title: Woodstock Percussion Inc. Recalls Toy Drums Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard

cards.title: Teknion Recalls to Repair Office Chairs Due to Fall Hazard

cards.remedy: Consumers should inspect the chair by checking the four bolts that attach the seat bottom to the chair frame. If any of the four bolts is l…
cards.tell: All Contessa chairs shipped prior to June 30, 2008 are recalled. Check the shipping label located on the bottom of the chair seat for the date of shipment.

cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the science kits and return them to the place of purchase or School Specialty for a refund.
cards.tell: Look for Ideal or Brighter Child brand science kits in All About Electricity, All About Magnets, or The Science Search Lab models.

cards.title: Target Recalls Scooters - Various Breaking Parts Present Fall Hazard
cards.hazard: The handlebars, wheels and wheel brakes can break and detach, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these scooters away from children immediately and return the scooter to the nearest Target store for a $24 gift card,…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled red or blue aluminum scooters by model number BZ 020 SP and the F Forward logo on the stem, wheel, or base deck.

cards.title: Lead Poisoning Hazard Prompts Recall of Fun Express Children's Toys Given Away at Libraries
cards.hazard: The paint on the bendable toys contains excessive levels of lead, which is banned under federal law. Lead is toxic and, if ingested by young children, can cause adverse health effects.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled toys away from children and discard them.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled toys by their packaging labeled with item numbers 39/1461-K and 39/1461-KM.

cards.title: Lands' End Children's Light-Up Backpacks Recalled for Overheating
cards.hazard: The backpack's battery pack can overheat, causing the battery case to melt, presenting a burn hazard if touched.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these backpacks immediately. Consumers with the affected backpacks are being sent a replacement backpack and ba…
cards.tell: Style number 175732 is printed on a label attached to the left side of the main compartment, and backpacks sold after July 19, 2006 are not included.

cards.product: Cage Bell Musical Instrument for Babies
cards.title: Cage Bell Musical Instruments for Babies Recalled for Choking Hazard
cards.hazard: If the bell inside the instrument is damaged during manufacturing, the bell can be pulled out of the instrument, posing a choking hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these instruments away from children, until they are examined for the hazard. Consumers were sent instructions on how…
cards.tell: Check the model number, 5-30-00740 or 0-06-09005, written on the outside packaging of the product.

cards.product: 5-gallon sizes of "Zep Industrial Purple Cleaner & Degreaser," and "Zep Heavy Duty Floor Stripper"
cards.title: 5-Gallon Zep-Brand Cleaner, Floor Stripper Sold at Home Depot Recalled, Containers Crack and Leak Corrosive Liquids
cards.hazard: 5-gallon plastic pails containing the cleaning products can unexpectedly crack and leak from the base, posing a risk to consumers, due to the corrosive nature of these products.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled products and contact Acuity Specialty Products Group Inc. for information on how to receive a free…
cards.tell: Check the batch code written on the side of the 5-gallon pail to see if it matches the recalled codes listed for Industrial Purple Cleaner or Heavy Duty Floor Stripper.

cards.product: Tu-Wire® ballasts used with dimmable compact fluorescent lights
cards.title: Tu-Wire® Dimming Ballasts Used With Compact Fluorescent Lights Recalled for Shock Hazard
cards.hazard: These ballasts, if not properly grounded in accordance with the National Electrical Code, can present a risk of electric shock to persons who come in contact with the ballast or with a light fixture…
cards.remedy: Consumers should not touch these fixtures, since they could pose a shock hazard. Consumers should contact Lutron Electronics to arrange for…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; the recall involves Tu-Wire dimming ballasts used with compact fluorescent lights installed after July 1998.

cards.title: Speed Buckle Harnesses Used During Mountain and Rock Climbing Recalled for Fall Hazard
cards.hazard: The harness could be threaded incorrectly. If threaded incorrectly, the webbing will easily slip when loaded. Incorrectly threaded buckles can loosen, which could cause climbers to slip out of the ha…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using recalled harnesses and contact the firm for a free replacement harness.
cards.tell: Only harnesses with incorrectly threaded buckles, where the center bar is visible, are included. The model name is found on a tag sewn inside the waist belt.

cards.product: Black & Decker and Craftsman Brand Cordless Electric Lawnmowers
cards.title: Black & Decker Expands Recall of Cordless Electric Lawnmowers Due to Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: An electrical component in the lawnmowers can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: All consumers should stop using the lawnmowers immediately and call for information on receiving a free inspection and repair if necessary.…
cards.tell: Check the model number and type on the silver and black label on the rear door of the mower. Black & Decker Types 1 through 4 are recalled, while Type 5 is not.

cards.title: Atico International USA Recalls Folding Picnic Tables Due to Collapsing Hazard
cards.hazard: The legs on the picnic table can buckle or break during use, causing the table to collapse or fold unexpectedly.
cards.remedy: The firm is out of business, the remedy is no longer available, and the product should be discarded or destroyed.
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the model numbers W50B2268 or W50H0284, which are located on the product packaging.

cards.title: Gotham Light Fixtures Recalled Due to Risk of Falling Parts
cards.hazard: The reflector/trim pieces may not be properly attached to each other. The lower portion of the reflector/trim assembly could detach and fall from the ceiling, striking consumers.
cards.remedy: Gotham Lighting is directly contacting facility managers and business owners to schedule an inspection and free repair. Contact Gotham Ligh…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; only 8-inch APR incandescent and APRH high-intensity discharge down lights with clear, black, pewter, wheat, umber, gold or champagne gold trim finishes are included.

cards.product: Dell-branded lithium-ion batteries made with cells manufactured by Sony
cards.title: Dell Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries Due To Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: These lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these recalled batteries immediately and contact Dell to receive a replacement battery. Consumers can continue…
cards.tell: Dell and either Made in Japan, Made in China, or Battery Cell Made in Japan Assembled in China are printed on the batteries, with identification numbers on a white sticker.

cards.title: Ballard Designs Inc. Recalls Potted Candles for Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: The packaging or holder can ignite, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these candles immediately and discard them. Consumers should contact Ballard Designs for instructions on how to…
cards.tell: All units of the Toulon Potted Candles with item numbers AW058 and AW057 are recalled.

cards.product: Frameworx Table Height Chairs and Bar Stools
cards.title: CPSC, Brunswick Bowling & Billiards Corp. Announce Recall of Frameworx Table Height Chairs and Bar Stools
cards.hazard: The down shaft on the seat plate assembly can fracture, which can cause an occupant of the seat to fall.
cards.remedy: Bowling centers owning these table height chairs and bar stools have been directly notified about this recall. Owners of the bar stools and…
cards.tell: Affected models are short table height chair model number 53-861025-000 and tall bar stool model number 57-860979-000, which feature a plastic bucket-style seat bolted to a steel seat plate.

cards.product: NRS Manta Surfer River Boards and LL Bean Body Boards
cards.title: Safety Alert: NRS and LL Bean Inflatable Water Boards Lack Safety Warning Labels
cards.hazard: The safety warning label containing precautionary information on proper use and operation was not affixed to the device. The safety warning label should read: "CAUTION: This is not a lifesaving devic…
cards.remedy: Consumers will receive an attachable label from NRS or LL Bean. Consumers should immediately affix the label to the device as directed.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the boards by the NRS or LL Bean logos and item numbers 1869 or 41869 on the tag sewn into the bottom seam.

cards.title: Dollar Tree Stores Recall Counterfeit Extension Cords Due to Shock Hazard
cards.hazard: The counterfeit extension cords could have undersized wire and substandard insulation, which can cause overheating, resulting in a possible shock hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled extension cords immediately and return them to any Dollar Tree store for a refund.
cards.tell: All units of this product are included in the recall. Check for a silver counterfeit UL holographic label on the green 6-foot cord.

cards.title: Children's Cooking Sets with Glass Lids Recalled for Laceration Hazard
cards.hazard: The glass pot lids can break, posing a laceration hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the glass lids away from children immediately and contact ALEX to receive a free replacement lid set.
cards.tell: Recalled sets include miniature pots with clear glass lids and a red sticker labeled unbreakable glass on the lids, manufactured before April 1, 2006.

cards.product: Quiksilver and Roxy Girl lounge pants
cards.title: Quiksilver Recalls Children's Lounge Pants Due to Burn Hazard
cards.hazard: These lounge pants fail to meet the children's sleepwear flammability standards, posing a risk of burn injury to children, due to the possible ignition of the garment. These garments were not labeled…
cards.remedy: Parents should stop their children from wearing the recalled lounge pants immediately and return them to the place of purchase for a refund…
cards.tell: Girls' items are labeled ROXY GIRL and boys' items are labeled QUIKSILVER; consumers should contact the firm for specific information on included models.

cards.product: Crazy Daisy 3-in-1 Electronic Motion Shade Lamps
cards.title: J.C. Penney Recalls Lamps For Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: The lamp's electrical circuit board can spark and overheat, due to an electrical problem, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled lamps and return them to any J.C. Penney store for a full refund. Lamps purchased thro…
cards.tell: All Crazy Daisy 3-in-1 Electronic Motion Shade Lamps are recalled.

cards.title: ElectroPlasma Lamps Sold at Spencer Gifts Stores Recalled for Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: Arcing between an object and the removable cover of the lamp can pose a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and return it to any Spencer Gifts for a store credit.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the lamp by checking the writing under the black base, which includes the SKU number 00473421, Mars Lightning7001, and Lightning 2000.

cards.product: Toro Snow Commander and CCR Single Stage Snowthrowers
cards.title: The Toro Company Expands Recall of Snowthrowers Posing Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: The plastic fuel tank can crack and leak gasoline, posing a risk of fire and injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact their local Toro Authorized Service Dealer to find out if their snowthrower is included in the recall. If necessar…
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the model and serial numbers located on the rear of the axle plate between the wheels.

cards.product: Robertshaw FS Flame Switches and FM Automatic Safety Valves (installed in commercial cooking appliances)
cards.title: Robertshaw Controls Co. Recalls Gas Controls Installed in Commercial Cooking Appliances for Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: These controls are designed to prevent gas from flowing when the pilot light is out. The recalled controls can remain on after the pilot light is extinguished. If this happens, gas can continue to fl…
cards.remedy: Consumers who believe they could have recalled safety valves on their cooking appliances should contact Robertshaw Controls Co. who will ar…
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers on the commercial cooking appliance identification plate to see if it contains a recalled Robertshaw FS Flame Switch or FM Automatic Safety Valve.

cards.title: Girls' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstring Recalled for Strangulation Hazard
cards.hazard: A drawstring is threaded through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the drawstrings from the sweatshirts to eliminate the hazard. Consumers can receive a full refund by re…
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled sweatshirt by checking the collar label for ROXY GIRL, style number 484241 on the hangtag or packaging label, and the beaded heart logo with embroidered flowers.

cards.title: Troy-Bilt String Trimmer Sold at Lowe's Recalled for Laceration Hazard
cards.hazard: The blade that trims the excess string of these weed trimmers can detach from the plastic shield covering the trimmer head. The blade can be thrown outward, hitting the user or bystander, resulting i…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the trimmers immediately and contact Troy-Bilt for a free repair. Lowe's will mail free repair kits with instru…
cards.tell: Check the model number TB425CS or TB525CS and Troy-Bilt printed on the body of the muffler housing.

cards.product: Generac GTH410 and GTH220 Engines with Plastic Fuel Tanks
cards.title: Generac Power Systems Inc. Recalls Engines to Replace Fuel Tanks Due to Risk of Fire
cards.hazard: The plastic fuel tanks can leak. If an ignition source is present, a fire or explosion can occur.
cards.remedy: Consumers who purchased power equipment with the recalled engine should stop using it immediately and contact the equipment manufacturer to…
cards.tell: Check the model number on a small sticker on the side of the motor above the Generac nameplate; recalled units match specific GTH410 and GTH220 model numbers sold between July 2001 and July 2005.

cards.title: Meijer Recalls Glass Candleholders for Fire and Laceration Hazards
cards.hazard: The glue connecting the candleholder could fail, causing the candleholder to fall apart. This poses a fire and laceration hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled candleholders immediately and return them to any Meijer store for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify them by the At Home with Meijer label printed on the bottom of the vase-shaped glass candleholders.

cards.product: John Deere 3000 Twenty Series and 4000 Twenty Series Open Station Compact Utility Tractors
cards.title: Deere & Co. Recall Compact Utility Tractors for Seat Belt Bracket Failure Hazard
cards.hazard: The seat bracket, to which the seat belt is attached, could have been positioned incorrectly during the manufacturing process, resulting in a poor weld. In a tractor roll over, the weight of the oper…
cards.remedy: The company is directly notifying those consumers who purchased an affected tractor. Consumers should contact a John Deere dealer for a fre…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled tractors by checking the model and specific serial numbers located on the serial number plate on the tractor's frame.

cards.product: Hampton Bay® Transitional Collection Fire Truck and Bulldozer Accent Lamp with Night Lights
cards.title: Children's Lamp Sold at The Home Depot® Recalled for Laceration Hazard
cards.hazard: The glass window of the fire truck and bulldozer night light can become dislodged, fall and shatter into small pieces. This poses a laceration hazard and a serious risk of injury, if ingested by a sm…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled lamps immediately and return the item to The Home Depot store for a full refund.
cards.tell: Check the bottom of the wood base for SKU number 167-367 for the fire truck lamp or 167-939 for the bulldozer lamp.

cards.title: Bunn-O-Matic Corp. Expands Recall of Home Coffeemakers Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
cards.hazard: The coffeemaker's plastic pour-in bowl and lid can melt or ignite due to an electrical failure, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should unplug the coffeemaker and allow it to cool (for at least three hours) before checking if they have one of the recalled un…
cards.tell: Check the model number and six-digit date code on the white or silver sticker on the bottom to see if it falls within the recalled date ranges.

cards.title: American Suzuki Motor Corp. Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles
cards.hazard: The mounting brackets used to secure the left-front suspension arm to the ATV frame may not have been welded completely and could break off during riding. If this occurs, the rider could lose control…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact their local Suzuki ATV dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repa…
cards.tell: Check the vehicle identification number located on the left rear side of the ATV frame against the list on the Suzuki website.

cards.product: Suunto D9 and D6 Model Wristop Dive Computers
cards.title: Suunto Dive Computers Recalled Due to Decompression Hazard
cards.hazard: These dive computers could incorrectly track dive time, which could cause incorrect calculation of decompression requirements. This could lead to decompression sickness.
cards.remedy: Consumers should only use these dive computers with backup instrumentation. Consumers should bring the recalled units to the nearest author…
cards.tell: Check the model on the back and the serial number on the side; D9 units have serial numbers 62102582 and below, and D6 units have serial numbers 62103693 and below.

cards.title: Plastic Hardware Covers on Children's Furniture Recalled for Choking Hazard
cards.hazard: The small cam lock covers can be easily removed, presenting a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the hardware covers and dispose of them.
cards.tell: All units of the Homeroom bedroom collection are recalled; check for plastic cam hardware covers used on the furniture.

cards.product: LYCKSELE Chair Bed and Sofa Bed
cards.title: IKEA Home Furnishings Announces Recall to Repair Folding Chair Beds and Sofa Beds for Fingertip Amputation Hazard
cards.hazard: Fingers can become caught in the folding mechanism of the chair bed/sofa bed, posing a laceration and/or amputation hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers who have a LYCKSELE chair bed or sofa bed date stamped 0526 or earlier and which is missing safety covers for the folding mechani…
cards.tell: Recalled units were produced before July 2005 with date stamps 0526 and earlier, found on a white sticker on the underside.

cards.title: Hair Dryers Recalled for Electrocution Hazard
cards.hazard: These electric hair dryers are not equipped with an immersion protection plug to prevent electrocution if the hair dryer falls into water. Such electric shock protection devices are required by indus…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these hair dryers and contact Style Tronics Inc. for a full refund.
cards.tell: You can tell by the model name and number written on the handle or blower nozzle, with Monica model SW-117 on the handle and Turbo 1200 model DS-507 on the back of the handle.

cards.title: Humidifiers Recalled for Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: Water from the humidifier can leak into the unit's electrical compartment, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these recalled humidifiers and unplug them immediately. Contact Hunter Fan Co. to receive a free replacement pa…
cards.tell: You can tell by the model number located on a white label on the bottom of the humidifier and the tank color matching the specified models.

cards.product: Fred Bear F-Series and Outfitter Compound Crossbows
cards.title: Bear Archery Recalls Compound Crossbows Due to Faulty Trigger Mechanisms
cards.hazard: The triggers on these crossbows could fire when the safety mechanism is moved from "safe" to "fire" position without pulling the trigger. Bystanders could be unintentionally hit by an arrow fired by…
cards.remedy: Consumers should discontinue use of the product and contact the firm for a free trigger replacement.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled crossbow by checking the model name on the outside of the bottom limb and the model number printed on the product manual.

cards.title: Sportsstuff Wego Kite Tubes Withdrawn from Market after Reports of Deaths and Injuries
cards.hazard: A rider in the tube can become airborne, by pulling on handles attached to the floor of the tube. That could result in serious injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the kite tubes and discard them. The firm is no longer in business. Remedy and contact information…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Model 53-5000 is printed near the product valve on the 10-foot-wide yellow circular tube.

cards.title: Ryobi Radial Arm Saws Recalled for Blade Detachment Hazard
cards.hazard: Cracking of the plastic motor housing can cause the blade assembly to fall during operation, posing a risk of laceration to the operator or bystanders. The detachment may occur unexpectedly and witho…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these radial arm saws and contact Ryobi customer service to arrange to return part of the saw for a…
cards.tell: All units of model RA200 and RA202 radial arm saws are recalled; check the data plate behind the operator grip for the model number.

cards.title: Shimano American Corp. Recalls Quick-Release Device for Bicycles Posing Fall Hazard
cards.hazard: The quick release skewers can unexpectedly fail or break, when locked in position. When this happens, the rider could lose control and fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding immediately and take the quick release device into their local bike dealer or retailer for a free inspection a…
cards.tell: Only quick releases with silver skewers and without a round sticker on the back of the quick release lever are involved.

cards.title: M2Racer LLC Recalls Bicycle Headsets for Fall Hazard
cards.hazard: The headsets mount to bicycle frames and fasten to the front fork assembly. A protruding component of the headset can contact the steering tube of the front fork assembly, score or scratch the steeri…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding bicycles with these headsets and inspect their front fork assembly for scoring damage. M2Racer will refund the…
cards.tell: All conventional and integrated lite headsets are recalled. All units are included in this recall.

cards.title: Office Chairs Sold at Wal-Mart Recalled for Fall Hazard
cards.hazard: The legs and backs of these chairs can break, and the chairs can easily tip over, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and return it to Wal-Mart for a full refund.
cards.tell: Check the UPC code label #9501401610 and model #VCR1022 located under the seat.

cards.title: Husqvarna Outdoor Products Inc. Recalls Lawn Tractors for Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: The fuel line on these lawn tractors can separate from the fuel tank outlet. If this occurs, fuel will spill out, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers with recalled tractors should immediately stop using the tractor and contact the applicable firm to schedule a free repair.
cards.tell: Check the product, model and serial numbers located on a label under the seat of the tractor to see if they match the recalled ranges.

cards.title: Felt Bicycles Announce Recall to Repair Mountain Bicycles for Brake Failure
cards.hazard: The steel brake boss can detach from the frame, causing the rider to lose control and fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and contact your local Felt bicycle dealer to receive a free inspection and repair.
cards.tell: All model year 2005 and 2006 Kinesis-made RXC bicycles with carbon fiber rear seat stays and V-style brakes are included in this recall.

cards.product: Lexar JumpDrive® FireFly and 1GB Secure II

cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled JumpDrive® Firefly and Secure II devices and contact Lexar to receive a free replaceme…
cards.tell: Check the part number on the packaging or on the back of the Secure II 1GB drive, and look for FireFly models in red, lime green, blue, or black, or Secure II in metallic silver.

cards.title: Tiffany and Company Recalls Paloma Rattles for Aspiration, Laceration Hazards
cards.hazard: Seams on the rattle can open during use, releasing small round beads. The beads can pose an aspiration hazard to young children. The breakage also can create ragged edges on the ring, posing a lacera…
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these rattles away from babies and return the product to Tiffany and Company for a full refund or a store credit.
cards.tell: This recall involves Paloma rattles sold in March 2006.

cards.product: Vehicles in the IQ Baby Pillow Soft Activity Blocks, IQ Baby Travelin' Train Blocks, IQ Baby Vroom Vroom Vehicles and D…
cards.title: Small World Toys Recalls Toy Vehicles for Choking Hazard
cards.hazard: The plastic wheels on the toys can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled toy vehicles immediately and contact Small World Toys for information on how to obtain a free repl…
cards.tell: All units of the recalled toy vehicles are included in this recall.

cards.title: Home Fragrance Holdings, Inc. Recalls Candles Sold at Pier 1 Imports Due to Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: The candles can unexpectedly flare, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product.
cards.tell: Check the SKU number and color to identify recalled Cement Aspen Flower, Downpour, Biscotti, and Citrus Cilantro candles.

cards.product: Heat & Glo Twilight II and IIB Gas Fireplaces

cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these fireplaces until the repair is performed. Homeowners are being contacted by Heat & Glo to schedule an app…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by looking for the Twilight II or IIB model name on the bottom right side of the inside of the control compartment.

cards.remedy: Consumers should pay close attention when operating and be careful not to accidentally engage the rear brake with their foot. Consumers sho…

cards.title: Safety Alert: Porter-Cable Cordless Nailer Poses Puncture Hazard

cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the nailer immediately and contact Porter-Cable to receive free caution labels and an instruction manual insert.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled nailer by model number BN200V12 located on the name plate on the magazine.

cards.title: Oceanic Recalls Digital Dive Computer Due to Decompression Hazard

cards.title: Adjmi Apparel Group Recalls Reebok Children's Windsuits for Choking Hazard
cards.hazard: The Reebok logo appliqué on the clear rubber zipper pull on the jacket can detach, posing a choking or aspiration hazard to young children.

cards.tell: All units of this product are included in the recall.

cards.hazard: These rockets are overloaded with flash powder, violating the regulatory standard for this product. During use, these fireworks could explode with a greater force than expected and cause burns and bo…

cards.tell: All units are recalled. The rocket engine is wrapped in blue or purple paper with a picture of a rocket and the writing Phantom Fireworks Thunder Stick Rocket.

cards.title: American Suzuki Motor Corp. Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles for Crash Hazard
cards.hazard: The cushion lever mounting bracket on the ATV frame can break. If this occurs, the rider could lose control of the ATV and crash, posing a risk of serious injury or death.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and contact the local Suzuki ATV dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair…
cards.tell: Check the vehicle identification number on the lower left side of the ATV frame to see if it ends with 00089 through 11626.

cards.title: Phil Vassil Rugs Recalls Flokati Rugs for Fire Hazard

cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these pilates balls and contact the firm to obtain instructions on how to receive free replacement…
cards.tell: All units are recalled; they are blue with black handles, measure about 26 inches in diameter when inflated, and were sold with a blue air pump.

cards.product: Brass Eagle Blade Turbo Markers and Paintball Breakout Players Kits
cards.title: Paintball Markers Recalled for Ejecting CO2 Cartridges, Hits Users
cards.hazard: The carbon dioxide (CO2) cartridges can be forcibly ejected out the back of the paintball marker and break the plastic screw-on cap. This poses a serious risk of injury to the paintball marker's oper…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled Blade Turbo™ paintball marker and contact Brass Eagle to receive a free replacement sc…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The Blade Turbo is bright blue with a black handgrip and Blade Turbo printed on the side.

cards.title: Espresso Makers Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: The electrical connectors in the espresso machine can erode, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the espresso machines and contact Krups for a free repair.
cards.tell: Check the model number and factory mark stamped on a silver sticker on the bottom of the machine for model 889-45 with factory mark F8894556 or model 890-41 with factory mark F8904156.

cards.title: Black Dog Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled for Strangulation Hazard
cards.hazard: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the drawstrings from the sweatshirts to eliminate the hazard.
cards.tell: All units of this children's hooded sweatshirt with drawstrings are recalled, featuring a black dog on the front and youth sizes up to size 12.

cards.product: Lasko, General Electric, Galaxy, Air King Brand Box and Pivoting Floor Fans
cards.title: Lasko Recalls Box and Pivoting Floor Fans Posing Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: An electrical failure in the motor can pose a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the fans immediately and contact Lasko to receive a free fan protection cord adaptor.
cards.tell: Check the brand and model number stamped or on a label located on the bottom of the fan.

cards.product: Husqvarna Viking Designer I Sewing and Embroidery Machines
cards.title: CPSC, VSM Sewing Inc. Announce Recall of Sewing Machines
cards.hazard: Electrical arcing can occur in the machine's power supply, posing a risk of fire.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these sewing machines, and return them to the dealer where purchased for a free repair.
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the serial number located on the bottom of the machine against the specified serial number ranges in the notice.

cards.title: CPSC, SFC America Announce Recall to Repair Fire Extinguishers
cards.hazard: The fire extinguishers can fail to discharge properly when the trigger is activated, which puts consumers at risk of fire-related injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers with fire extinguishers included in the recall should immediately contact SFC America for information on how to arrange to have t…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the instruction label and the serial number located on the label below the UL mark to see if it falls within the recalled ranges.

cards.title: CPSC, Four Seasons and Cardinal IG Co. Announce Recall to Repair Sunroom Roof Glass
cards.hazard: Sunlight reflecting off certain sunroom roof glass and skylights onto adjacent cedar shingles or cedar shakes could pose a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Owners of Four Seasons Sunrooms described above should call the toll free number to determine if their units are affected and if so, to obt…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; only reflective Code 77 roof insulating glass units installed in sunrooms or skylights that reflect sunlight onto cedar shingles or shakes.

cards.title: SunTome Reannounces Baby Walker Recall due to Stairway Fall Hazard
cards.hazard: The walkers can fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled walkers immediately and return the walkers to the retailer where purchased for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They have eight wheels, music-playing activity trays with a steering wheel and rattles, and the word Baby printed on a sticker on the tray or base.

cards.title: DESA Heating Products Recalls Portable Propane Convection Heaters
cards.hazard: The burners on these heaters can "flashback", which is when fire burns inside the burner tube rather than out the end. This can cause the lower portion of the burner tube to get hot enough to ignite…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using this heater immediately. The firm is out of business. A remedy is no longer available. Consumers should discard…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the model names and numbers on the label attached to the heater, along with serial numbers between 017390000 and 017632220.

cards.title: CPSC, Weil-McLain Company Announce Recall of Boilers
cards.hazard: The blower assembly is not properly sealed. Gas can leak during operation and accumulate. If an ignition source is present, a fire or explosion could occur.
cards.remedy: Weil-McLain repaired all recalled boilers at no cost to consumers.
cards.tell: Check for models GV-3 through GV-6 with serial numbers between CP5075477 and CP5221234, located on the left side of the jacket above the boiler rating label.

cards.title: Bike Pro Inc. Reannounces Baby Walker Recall Due to Stairway Fall Hazard
cards.hazard: The walkers can fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these walkers immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The walkers are blue, green, pink, and yellow with musical activity trays, and have Baby or BEBELOVE printed on labels on some units.

cards.title: Ace Han Baby Walkers Recalled Due to Stairway Fall Hazard
cards.hazard: The walkers can fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled walkers and return them to the retailer where purchased for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The walkers have eight wheels, an activity tray, and a label on the base that reads Imported by Ace Han Corp.

cards.title: Steve & Barry's University Recalls Children's Outerwear with Drawstring Strangulation Hazard
cards.hazard: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should remove the drawstrings to eliminate the hazard or return the garment to the store where purchased for a refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled garments by checking the style number written on the collar or side label and looking for a tag reading Steve & Barry's Quality Athletic Goods.

cards.title: Fire Hazard with Oscillating Heater Sold in Wal-Mart Prompts Recall
cards.hazard: The wires inside the oscillating heater can short circuit and spark, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these heaters and unplug them. Return the recalled heaters to a Wal-Mart store for a full refund.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled unit by model number CH920 printed on the ETL label located on the bottom of the back side of the unit.

cards.title: Electric Shock Hazard Prompts Recall of Electric Smokers
cards.hazard: In addition to the electric cord that plugs into the wall, these units have an electric cord with prongs on both ends that connect the generator to the smoker. If the unit is plugged into the wall so…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these smokers and contact Bradley Technologies (Canada) Inc. to determine if the smoker is part of…
cards.tell: You can tell by checking the model and serial number on a silver label located on the back of the smoker.

cards.title: Leaf Blowers Sold at Home Depot Recalled for Laceration Hazard
cards.hazard: The blowers are missing the doors covering the vacuum inlet. This exposes the blower's fan blade, posing a risk of finger laceration to the user.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these blowers immediately and return them to a Home Depot store for a new blower or a full refund.
cards.tell: Only blowers missing the black cover over the fan are included in the recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Porter-Cable Announce Recall to Repair Routers
cards.hazard: The motor coil insulation can be worn away by vibration from the motor, which could pose a shock hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled routers immediately and contact Porter-Cable for a free inspection, and repair, if necessary.
cards.tell: Check the nameplate on the top of the router for the model and serial number; units marked with a T above PORTER+CABLE are not included.

cards.product: Auto Safety Kit, Auto Aid in a Bottle, Winter Safety Kit, and Outdoorsman in a Bottle
cards.title: CPSC, L.L. Bean Announce Recall of Safety Kits
cards.hazard: The products have a flashlight that relies on a powerful magnet and copper coil for manual recharging. The magnet adversely affects the polarity of the compass rendering it unreliable. The magnet cou…
cards.remedy: Consumers with recalled kits should contact L.L. Bean immediately to receive a free warning label for the flashlight. Consumers with Outdoo…
cards.tell: All units of these L.L. Bean safety kits are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Country Home Products, Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Cordless Electric Lawnmowers
cards.hazard: When the handlebar is released on the recalled lawnmowers, the motor could continue to run, which causes the blade to continue to spin. In addition, there is excessive heat build up in the wire coil…
cards.remedy: Country Home Products, Inc. is sending all registered owners instructions on how to perform the free repair on these mowers.
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the model number EM 4 1 on the front and serial number ranges CE4049212 through CE4054902 and CE4061492 through CE4071541 on a sticker under the rear discharge guard.

cards.title: Mizuno USA, Inc. Recalls "Gamer" Baseball Gloves Due to Chance of Infection in At-Risk Consumers
cards.hazard: These gloves could contain aspergillus mold. Such mold usually does not affect healthy individuals, but could cause respiratory or other infections in individuals with chronic health problems or in i…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the gloves and contact Mizuno USA, Inc. for information on how to receive a free replacement baseball glove.
cards.tell: All units of the Mizuno Gamer baseball gloves are recalled, featuring the word Gamer printed on the palm.

cards.title: CPSC, Syntace USA Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebar Stems
cards.hazard: The recalled bicycle stems can crack or break under normal conditions, causing the rider to fall and suffer serious injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled handlebar stem immediately and contact Syntace for instructions to receive…
cards.tell: Stems with production codes 01 03 through 45 04, and stems with no production code are included; the code is on the bottom of the end of the stem.

cards.product: Fisher-Price® Laugh & Learn™ Musical Learning Chair™
cards.title: Fisher-Price Recalls Infant Musical Toy Chair Posing Strangulation Hazard
cards.hazard: A child can become lodged between the seat back and side table of the chair, possibly leading to an entrapment of the neck. This can pose a strangulation hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled musical chair away from children immediately and contact Fisher-Price to receive a free repair kit that…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the underside of the seat of the chair to see if it matches the recalled model numbers.

cards.product: Mini Light and Chasing Light Sets
cards.title: Holiday Lights Recalled by Target Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
cards.hazard: These lights have undersized and exposed wires, which pose a risk of electric shock and fire hazards.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the lights and return them to the nearest Target store for a Target Gift Card in the amount of a full refund.
cards.tell: Check the tag attached to the light string for UL numbers E254698 or E182192, or if there is no UL number written on the tag.

cards.title: CPSC, Hurley International Announce Recall of Boy's Hooded Jackets with Drawstrings
cards.hazard: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should remove the drawstring to eliminate the hazard.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled jacket by style number BJ06GS printed on a label sewn inside the left side seam.

cards.title: Neptune Systems Recalls Power Strips for Shock Hazard
cards.hazard: The metal enclosure on the power strip is not properly grounded, which could result in an electrical shock.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these power strips and contact the firm for a free replacement.
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by serial numbers between DC81000 through DC81633 printed on the white label on the side of the unit.

cards.product: Kawasaki 2005-2006 model year Mule 600 Utility Vehicles
cards.title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. Recall of Utility Vehicles
cards.hazard: The steering knuckle can twist or break from wheel forces transmitted to the steering system during operation. This can cause a loss of steering control and possible collapse of the front suspension,…
cards.remedy: Consumers with recalled utility vehicles were sent direct notice from Kawasaki. Consumers should stop using these vehicles immediately and…
cards.tell: All 2005-2006 model year Mule 600 utility vehicles, model KAF400, are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Stihl Inc. Announce Recall of Chain Saws
cards.hazard: These chain saws can leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. A connection in the ignition grounding system could loosen and create a spark, posing a fire hazard. Also the springs in the clutch assembly coul…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these chain saws immediately and return them to an authorized Stihl dealer for a free repair.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled chain saws by model number MS 192 T on the starter housing and serial numbers 264371702 through 266087005 on the top/front of the housing.

cards.product: 12" Braided Flex Fuel Hose sold with certain Guardian® Home Standby Air-Cooled Generators
cards.title: CPSC, Generac Power Systems Inc. Announce Recall of Fuel Hoses Sold with Guardian Home Generators
cards.hazard: The fuel hoses can leak if bent in an unreasonable fashion during installation or upon completion of installation. If an ignition source is present, a fire or explosion can occur.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the generator if the fuel hose is bent or if the ferrules (connectors) are cracked, split or damaged in any way…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; the hoses are used with generators having serial numbers 3789827 and below, found on the identification decal tag inside the metal enclosure.

cards.product: L-Shaped Quick-Clear Valve Adapters used with Mosquito Magnet® Insect Traps
cards.title: CPSC, American Biophysics Corp. Announce Recall of Accessory Used to Clean Mosquito Magnet®
cards.hazard: The maintenance accessory is an "L"-shaped, Quick-Clear Valve Adapter that can leak or break apart during use, possibly striking and injuring nearby persons or releasing pressurized carbon dioxide (C…
cards.remedy: Consumers should not use the recalled "L"-shaped Quick-Clear Adapter on the Mosquito Magnet insect trap. Contact the firm to receive a free…
cards.tell: Only black and gold, L-shaped, brass and plastic Quick-Clear Valve Adapters are affected; straight adapters and those for traps using rechargeable batteries are not included.

cards.title: LTD Commodities and The Lakeside Collection Recall of Pilates Balls
cards.hazard: The plastic black clips at the end of the rubber tubing can come apart when in use. In addition, the grommet used to hold the black rubber tubing could separate from the nylon webbing. Consumers usin…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these pilates balls and contact the firm to obtain instructions on how to receive free replacement…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The recalled pilates balls are blue with black handles, about 26 inches in diameter, and sold with a blue air pump.

cards.product: Metal Alcohol Burners (used in scientific experiments)
cards.title: CPSC, C & A Scientific Co. Announce Recall of Metal Alcohol Burners
cards.hazard: Alcohol can leak from defective soldering around the burner's copper tubing that acts as a wick, posing a fire and burn hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled metal alcohol burners immediately and return them to place of purchase for replacement or refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The item number 97-5320 is printed on the burner's packaging.

cards.product: Certain Model Year 2006 Ski-Doo REV500 SS, REV 600 HO, and REV 600 HO SDI Snowmobiles
cards.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of Additional 2006 Snowmobiles
cards.hazard: Cracks could appear in the starter ring gears, allowing gear fragmentation at high speeds. The debris could act like projectiles and cause serious injury or death to riders or bystanders.
cards.remedy: Registered owners of affected models have been sent direct notice of this recall. Consumers should stop using these snowmobiles immediately…
cards.tell: Check the model number and serial number located on the tunnel to see if it matches the recalled units.

cards.product: Certain Model Year 2006 Ski-Doo REV, RT, and RF Snowmobiles
cards.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of 2006 Snowmobiles
cards.hazard: The steering columns on these snowmobiles could have a missing weld, which could allow a steering component to become loose. This could lead to a loss of control or possible collision, causing seriou…
cards.remedy: Registered owners of affected models have been sent direct notice of this recall. Consumers should stop using these snowmobiles immediately…
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers located on the tunnel to see if your 2006 Ski-Doo snowmobile is included in the recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Recreational Equipment Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
cards.hazard: The alloy frame used for these bicycles can be prone to fatigue failure. Frame failure results in the separation of the fork, head tube, and handlebar away from the rest of the bike, causing a loss o…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these bicycles and return them to the nearest REI store for a full refund or credit.
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; check for 20-inch Novara Dirt Rider bicycles with 5 or 6 speeds sold from October 2002 through November 2005 in specific color combinations.

cards.product: Battery packs used with Polaroid-brand portable DVD players
cards.title: CPSC, Petters Consumer Brands LLC Announce Recall of Batteries Found In Polaroid Portable DVD Players
cards.hazard: The battery can overheat and melt the plastic case while recharging, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available. Consumers can continue using the portable DVD player without the battery,…
cards.tell: Check the model number and serial number on the battery pack attached to the bottom of the silver DVD player against the recalled serial number ranges.

cards.product: Aspen 3-in-1 Cribs, sold under the Graco Trademark
cards.title: CPSC, Simplicity Inc. Announce Recall of Graco Branded Aspen Cribs for Suffocation Risk
cards.hazard: The screws on the wooden mattress support can come loose, allowing a portion of the mattress to fall, posing a suffocation hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled cribs. Destroy and discard the cribs. The firm is no longer in business. A remedy is n…
cards.tell: Check the envelope attached to the wooden mattress support for model number 8740KCW SC and serial numbers 2803 SC to 1605.

cards.title: CPSC, Meco Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Gas Grills
cards.hazard: The regulators on these gas grills, the component that controls the amount of gas released to the burner, can leak propane when the propane cylinder is connected and open, and the grill is not in use.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the grill and contact Meco for instructions on receiving a replacement regulator assembly.
cards.tell: All units are not recalled. Check model numbers on the back or sides of the control panel, and regulator date codes of 2704 and lower.

cards.title: CPSC, Family Dollar Stores Announce Recall of Spinning Star Christmas Tree Topper
cards.hazard: The tree topper can melt or smoke near the on/off switch, which could pose a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the spinning star tree topper and return it to a Family Dollar store for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are silver with external battery packs. You can identify recalled units by checking the model numbers PDV-0700 or PDV-0800 and the specific serial numbers located on the battery packs.

cards.title: CPSC, CFM Corporation Announce Recall of Legacy Propane Infrared Plaque Heaters
cards.hazard: Carbon monoxide hazard. A non-specification gasket around the heating plaques could allow heater carbon monoxide emissions to leak into the area in which the heater is being used.
cards.remedy: The firm is no longer in business, and a remedy is no longer available. Consumers should discard or destroy the product.
cards.tell: Check the model number located on the right side panel of the unit to see if it matches the recalled model numbers.

cards.title: CPSC, Dell Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries
cards.hazard: These batteries can overheat, which could pose a fire risk.
cards.remedy: Customers should contact Dell to determine if their notebook computer battery is part of this recall. If it is, consumers should immediatel…
cards.tell: Check the identification number on the white sticker on the battery and contact Dell to determine if your battery is part of the recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Black Diamond Equipment Announce Recall of Scarpa T2X Telemark Ski Boots
cards.hazard: The plastic boot cuff can crack when flexed open in an unbuckled non-skiing position, causing discomfort on the ankle or shin, making the problem evident prior to skiing and thus unsuitable for use.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the ski boots and return them to the nearest dealer for a free replacement.
cards.tell: Recalled boots have a dual color ankle cuff and the marking T2X on the outside, while repaired or replaced boots have a single color cuff.

cards.product: GE Monogram® 36-inch and 48-inch Professional Gas Ranges
cards.title: CPSC, General Electric Announce Recall of Gas Ranges Posing Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: These ranges were manufactured with a design flaw that can cause an electrical arc between the wiring and adjacent gas supply tubes at two locations in the control housing of the range, posing a fire…
cards.remedy: Customers who have purchased one of these recalled ranges should contact GE to schedule a free, in-home repair. Until the repair is complet…
cards.tell: Check the model number and serial numbers starting with DG through SH located underneath the top ledge above the range controls.

cards.title: CPSC, Advantage Publishers Group Announce Recall of Children's Books
cards.hazard: If the clear plastic container is removed from the book's back cover or breaks, young children can access the beads in it. This poses a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take these recalled activity and board books away from young children and contact the company for a replacemen…
cards.tell: Check the cover for Amazing Baby Look and Play with a yellow star, Touch and Play with a brown bear, or Rattle, Rattle with a magenta car.

cards.title: CPSC, Maxim Enterprise Inc. Announce Recall of Mini Learning Cube Toy Sold at Target
cards.hazard: Small wooden pegs in the top corners of the toy can come loose, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled learning cube toy away from young children and return it to Target for a $15 giftcard plus a…
cards.tell: All units of the Little Tree Mini Learning Cube are recalled.

cards.product: Mystery Drawer and Dice Tunnel Magic Party Favors and Costume Shield
cards.title: CPSC, Celebrate Express Inc. Announce Recall of Magic Party Favors and Costume Shield
cards.hazard: The magic party favors and the dragon ornament on the shield could break or crack, exposing sharp points that present a possible laceration hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled magic party favors and costume shield away from children immediately and contact the company for a refun…
cards.tell: All units of the specified Magic Favor Box and costume sets containing the recalled mystery drawer, dice tunnel, or costume shield are included in the recall.

cards.product: Honda Model Year 2005 and 2006 TRX400EX ATVs
cards.title: CPSC, American Honda Motor Corp. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
cards.hazard: A safety defect could exist in the transmission, that could allow the rider to downshift from 1st gear into reverse, without operating the reverse assist (lockout) lever. The reverse lockout spring m…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these recalled ATVs until the repair has been completed. Please call any Honda ATV dealer to make an appointmen…
cards.tell: All model year 2005 and 2006 TRX400EX ATVs are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Kids II Inc. Announce Recall of Doorway Baby Jumpers
cards.hazard: The plastic clamp that attaches the jumper seat to a door frame can break, which can cause the unit and child to fall to the floor. This poses an injury hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and contact Kids II for information on receiving a free replacement.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled jumper by model number 6753 written on a white warning label on the seat and a blue plastic clamp.

cards.product: Kawasaki 2005 model year Brute Force ATVs
cards.title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
cards.hazard: Tie rod separation caused by either wear or severe impact can occur during operation, causing the front wheel to separate from the steering control. Separation of the tie rod can cause the rider to l…
cards.remedy: Consumers with recalled ATVs were sent direct notice from Kawasaki. Consumers should stop using these ATVs immediately and contact a local…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the vehicle to see if it is KVF750-A1 or KVF750-B1 from the 2005 model year.

cards.title: CPSC, J & F Design Inc. Announce Recall of Girl's Sleepwear Sold at J.C. Penney Stores
cards.hazard: These pajamas sets fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability of children's sleepwear under the Flammable Fabrics Act. This poses a risk of burn injuries to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop wearing these pajama sets and return them to any J.C. Penney store for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify them by the label on the inside of the garment that reads Bobby by BobbyJack.

cards.title: CPSC, Chuck E. Cheese's Announce Recall of Plastic Siren Whistles
cards.hazard: The recalled plastic siren whistle's internal pieces can detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled plastic siren whistle away from children and discard it. Free replacement whistles can be ob…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The red, green, or purple plastic siren whistles are about 2 inches long and three-quarters of an inch wide.

cards.title: CPSC, Toshiba America Consumer Products LLC Announce Recall of DVD Home Theater Systems
cards.hazard: A problem in the system's circuit board could pose a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Toshiba America Consumer Products LLC directly contacted many of the owners of the affected product. If you have not been contacted, please…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled system by checking the model number SD-C67HT found on the front of the DVD Player/Receiver to the right of the word Toshiba.

cards.title: CPSC, King of Fans Inc. Announce Recall of Oil-Filled Radiator Heaters
cards.hazard: Welds in the heating fins can break, allowing oil to leak. This poses a burn and fall hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these heaters and unplug them. Return the recalled heaters to a Home Depot store for a full refund.
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by model number 70030 and date codes 0705 and 0805 printed on the UL label on the lower right side of the control panel.

cards.title: CPSC, Ideal Distributors Inc. Announce Recall of Pacifiers
cards.hazard: The nipples can detach from the base, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled pacifiers away from young children and return them to the store where purchased for a full r…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are blue, white, yellow, or pink plastic with a yellow nipple filled with honey or a sugary substance.

cards.product: Children's Metal Necklaces and Zipper Pulls
cards.title: CPSC, Stravina Operating Co. Announce Recall of Children's Metal Necklaces and Zipper Pulls
cards.hazard: The recalled metal jewelry contains high levels of accessible lead in the metal and/or the paint, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning to young children. Lead is toxic if ingested by children and…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take this metal jewelry away from children and contact Stravina for more information at www.stravina.com
cards.tell: All units of these Stravina personalized necklaces and zipper pulls are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Yamaha Corporation of America Announce Recall of Synthesizers
cards.hazard: Unit could emit loud "white noise" when turned off and turned on again under high temperature conditions, which could possibly damage a consumer's hearing.
cards.remedy: Yamaha will contact each customer to arrange for a repair or replacement at no cost to the customer.
cards.tell: All units of the S90 ES synthesizer are recalled, which can be identified by "S90 ES" and "Yamaha" written on the front of the black unit.

cards.title: CPSC, Porter-Cable Announce Recall to Repair Circular Saws
cards.hazard: The lower guard on these saws could stick in the open position, posing a risk of severe lacerations to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the circular saws immediately and contact Porter-Cable for the location of the nearest service center to receiv…
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers on the top label; units marked with a letter T are not affected.

cards.title: CPSC, Starbucks Coffee Company Announce Recall of Ceramic Teapots
cards.hazard: The teapots are labeled safe for microwave use, but the handles can become hot in the microwave oven. This poses a possible burn hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the teapots and contact Starbucks for instructions on returning the product for a full refund and a $5 Starbuck…
cards.tell: All 40-ounce white ceramic teapots with bamboo handles and the phrase Microwave and Dishwasher Safe printed on the bottom are recalled.

cards.product: VisionMount model VMSA swing-arm television wall-mounting unit
cards.title: CPSC, Sanus Systems Announce Recall of Television Wall Mounting Units
cards.hazard: An undersized shaft within the wall mounting unit can cause the product's main support component to loosen. As a result, the unit and the television it is supporting can fall from the wall, posing a…
