cards.hazard: The regulators on these products can leak propane when the propane cylinder is turned on and the product is not in use. This can pose a fire or explosion hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the grills and heaters immediately and contact Coleman for a free replacement regulator assembly. Once the regu…
cards.tell: You can tell by the model numbers 5100, 5300, 5400, 5600, 6000, and 7700 on the front of the grills, and model 5040 on the inside cover of the heaters.

cards.title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Kids Announce Recall of Spindle Cribs
cards.hazard: The spindles on the crib's front rail can loosen and detach from the rail. This can allow the child to fall from the crib and poses a risk of entrapment.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these cribs and contact Pottery Barn Kids to receive a free replacement front rail or a full refund…
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the product name and model number 4825402 printed on a label affixed to the base of the crib.

cards.title: CPSC, Nexgrill Industries Announce Recall to Repair Gas Grills Sold Exclusively At Home Depot
cards.hazard: The hose connecting the propane tank with the manifold can run up too close to the firebox. The heat from the firebox can damage the hose, causing it to leak gas. The release of gas creates a fire ri…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the gas grill and contact Nexgrill Customer Service to receive a free, self-installation repair kit.
cards.tell: All units with model number 720-0036-HD-05 located on the back of the grill are included in this recall.

cards.product: E-Z-GO 2002-2005 gasoline-powered Fleet and Freedom Golf Cars, and Shuttle 2+2 Personnel Carriers
cards.title: CPSC, E-Z-GO Announce Recall to Repair Golf Cars
cards.hazard: High engine temperatures can permit fuel to get into the air filter box, posing a risk of fire.
cards.remedy: Owners of the recalled golf cars should contact the nearest E-Z-GO dealer to arrange for a free repair. E-Z-GO and E-Z-GO dealers will cont…
cards.tell: Recalled vehicles have 9-horsepower engines and serial numbers ranging from 1451059 through 2341739 located on the passenger side dash housing or body below the driver's seat and chassis.

cards.title: CPSC, Continental Creations, Inc. Announce Recall of Menorahs
cards.hazard: The cups holding the candles on these menorahs are not constructed of the correct material and could ignite, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available. Do NOT use these menorahs. Please destroy or discard this product.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled menorahs by the cat or dog styles and a sticker on the base stating either P1157 or P1166.

cards.title: CPSC, Ultimate Chopper LLC Announce Recall to Inspect and Replace Food Processors
cards.hazard: The interlocking lid assembly on the appliance can malfunction, allowing the food processor to be operated when the lid is off. This can result in a laceration or fingertip amputation hazard, if cons…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately inspect their Ultimate Chopper food processor to determine if the interlocking lid is functioning properly. Co…
cards.tell: All units of the Ultimate Chopper food processor are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, World Wide Cycle Supply Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Sold at Toys "R" Us
cards.hazard: The fork that holds the front wheel can separate at the weld, causing the rider to fall and suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding the bicycle immediately and return it to a Toys "R" Us store for store credit in the amount of the purchase pr…
cards.tell: Check the serial number on the bottom bracket shell underneath the pedals; only specific ranges of serial numbers are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Atico International USA, Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Arm Band Pool Floats Sold at CVS Stores
cards.hazard: The seams of the inflatable arm bands can tear, causing them to deflate. This poses a drowning hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: The firm is out of business, the remedy is no longer available, and the product should be discarded or destroyed.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are bright orange on the outside and white on the inside, imprinted with the Surf Club logo and CVS/pharmacy.

cards.title: CPSC, Aqua Scout Announce Recall of Aqua Scout Water Scooters
cards.hazard: Hydrogen gas can build up in the battery compartment and cause the battery cover and the battery package to forcefully expel from the product, posing a risk of injury to the user or bystanders.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled water scooter immediately and return it to Aqua Scout for a free replacement.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The product has a yellow or red plastic enclosure with a black plastic handle and propeller, and has no model numbers or brand name written on it.

cards.title: CPSC, Walt Disney World Co. Announce Recall of Children's Red Sunglasses
cards.hazard: The paint on the red sunglasses contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled red sunglasses away from children and contact Walt Disney World Co. for a free replacement p…
cards.tell: Recalled are solid red sunglasses with dark plastic lenses sold attached to a navy blue Mickey Mouse cap or light blue Stitch cap with red bills.

cards.title: CPSC, American Greetings Corp. Announce Recall of Sesame Street Sunglasses
cards.hazard: The lens in the sunglasses can separate from frames, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these sunglasses away from young children immediately. Consumers can contact the firm for a coupon redeemable whereve…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled sunglasses by model number SUN-1219 printed on the back of the bright green cardboard packaging.

cards.product: Stand'n Seal Spray-On Grout Sealer sold in 2005
cards.title: CPSC, Tile Perfect Inc. Announce Recall of Stand'n Seal Grout Sealer Due to Respiratory Problems
cards.hazard: The product's odor is not chemically pungent enough to force consumers to minimize their exposure to the fumes. Consumers overexposed to these fumes can experience respiratory-related illness.
cards.remedy: Consumers should not use the aerosol product and return it to the Home Depot for a full refund.
cards.tell: Check the bottom of the can for date and lot codes starting with specific six-digit numbers listed in the recall.

cards.product: Back Trails Jr. Toddler, Youth and Child Bicycle Helmets
cards.title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Back Trails Jr. Bicycle Helmets
cards.hazard: Some of these helmets do not meet CPSC safety standards for bicycle helmets, which poses a risk of riders suffering head injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the helmets away from children and return them to the nearest Target Store for a gift card in the amount of a full re…
cards.tell: Check the white label inside the helmet for model numbers 89888, 88003, 89951, 88001, 89952, 88002, or 89917, along with the date of manufacture and Made in China.

cards.product: Maptangle™ World Edition Floor Mat Map Games
cards.title: CPSC, Hidden Hills Productions, Inc. Announce Recall of Floor Mat Map Games
cards.hazard: The orange paint on the floor mat maps contains excess levels of lead. Lead poisoning is a serious hazard to children and is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing proble…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled game maps, and contact Hidden Hills Productions Inc. for information on returning the…
cards.tell: All units of the Maptangle World Edition Floor Mat Map Games without manufacture date codes are recalled.

cards.product: Jenn-Air Model 720-0100 Natural Gas Outdoor Gas Grills
cards.title: CPSC, Nexgrill Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Outdoor Gas Grills
cards.hazard: A hose connecting the natural gas source to the grill's main manifold may not have been supplied with these grills. Without this hose, the gas would be emitted into the air, creating a potential fire…
cards.remedy: Consumers without a connecting hose should not use these grills, and contact Nexgrill to obtain a free hose. Registered consumers have rece…
cards.tell: Check for model number 720-0100 located on the back panel of the grill and the Jenn-Air brand name on a plate on the lid.

cards.title: CPSC, ZoloWear Announce Recall of Infant Carriers/Slings
cards.hazard: The stitching that attaches the webbing to the carrier/sling can break, posing a fall hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these carriers/slings immediately and call ZoloWear for instructions on having the carriers/slings repaired.
cards.tell: Recalled slings have short webbing secured by only one row of stitching instead of three, featuring a white Zolo label on the pocket.

cards.product: Tiki® Bamboo Torches and Replacement Fuel Canisters
cards.title: CPSC, Lamplight Farms Inc. Announce Recall of Tiki Bamboo Torches and Replacement Fuel Canisters
cards.hazard: The surface coating of some flame guards on these bamboo torches and replacement canisters can absorb the fuel and ignite. This can cause the torch and nearby combustibles to catch on fire, posing a…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these torches and contact Lamplight Farms to determine if they are included in the recall. If so, t…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by the UPC numbers and model names written on the packaging or attached tag.

cards.title: CPSC, West Bend Housewares LLC Announce Recall of Coffeemaker Carafes
cards.hazard: The carafe handle can unexpectedly loosen or break, resulting in the carafe falling. This can cause burn injuries from hot coffee or lacerations from broken glass.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled carafes immediately and contact West Bend Housewares to receive a replacement carafe free of charg…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the four-digit date code printed on the bottom of the coffeemaker, where date codes beginning with 04 are included.

cards.title: CPSC, Stork Craft Manufacturing Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Boxes
cards.hazard: The toy box's lid support can fail, allowing the lid to collapse suddenly. This poses a strangulation hazard to young children, and possible impact injuries to a child's head, neck, fingers or hands.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop young children from using these toy boxes and contact Stork Craft for information to determine if their t…
cards.tell: You can tell by the model numbers and manufacture date codes between November 2002 and July 2004 located on a label underneath the toy box.

cards.title: CPSC, Kadant Composites Inc. Announce Recall of Certain GeoDeck™ Decking and Railing Materials
cards.hazard: When the decking or railing material is exposed to hot temperatures and sunlight, it can prematurely degrade. The degraded material could break, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should check their GeoDeck™ decking materials for visible cracks on the surface and check to see if the surface can be easily scr…
cards.tell: Each recalled component has a manufacturing date stamp from April 2002 through October 2003 on the cut end.

cards.title: CPSC, Whittier Wood Products Announce Recall of Pub Stools
cards.hazard: The amount of glue used to bond and hold the joints together on these stools could be insufficient. These stools could break and collapse during use, causing consumers to fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers can contact Whittier Wood Products to receive a replacement stool or a free, in-home repair kit.
cards.tell: Check the model numbers 986W and 986KFRS and lot code on the outside of the box; units with lot code 06222005 are not affected.

cards.title: CPSC, Torelli Imports Announce Recall of Bicycle Tires
cards.hazard: The tire can separate from the wheel, resulting in a flat tire. This can cause the rider to lose control and fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the tires immediately and contact their local bicycle retailer or Torelli Imports to receive a free replacement…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled. Check the sidewall for Verona or Lugano labels with Torelli branding and folding Kevlar beads.

cards.title: CPSC, Almar Sales Co. Announce Recall of Children's Watches
cards.hazard: The band on the watch contains liquid petroleum distillates. If punctured, the watch band could leak. Petroleum distillates could be harmful if ingested and cause irritation to the skin or eyes on co…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take these watches away from young children and return the watches to the store where purchased for a refund o…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The watches feature clear plastic with white snaps, clear glitter-filled liquid bands, and a digital watch face.

cards.title: CPSC, JS Products and Mac Tools Announce Recall of Cordless Drill/Drivers
cards.hazard: The battery packs on these drill/drivers can overheat, expand and possibly rupture, creating an explosion or thermal burn hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers stop using the recalled drill/driver immediately and contact their Mac Tools distributor for information on receiving a free repl…
cards.tell: Check the part number on the side of the drill near the logo to see if it is CDD14438, CDD14438-Kit, CDD18012, or CDD18012-KIT.

cards.title: CPSC, The Gymboree Corp. Announce Recall of Baby Sandals
cards.hazard: A plastic flower attached to the sandals can pull or snap off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the sandals and return them to a Gymboree store for a refund. Consumers also can return the sandals…
cards.tell: All units of the Caroline Flower Baby Sandal with SKU 140002069 in sizes 1 to 8 are recalled, with the SKU printed on the price tag above the bar code.

cards.product: Holmes® and Bionaire® Tower Heater Fans
cards.title: CPSC, The Holmes Group Announce Recall of Tower Heater Fans
cards.hazard: The power cord on the units can fray or sever, causing the fan to stop working and overheat. This could pose a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the heaters and contact The Holmes Group for instructions on receiving a replacement unit.
cards.tell: Check the silver label on the back of the unit for the model number and date code, which ranges from 2604 through 3804, or through 4704 for model 6500TG-U.

cards.product: Ritchey WCS - Protocol, Carbon, DS, DS Aero, Girder models (all rear wheels only)
cards.title: CPSC, Ritchey Design Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Wheels
cards.hazard: The hub in the bicycle's rear wheel can fail to engage properly, causing no resistance when pedaling. The bicycle rider can lose balance, fall and suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Inspect your hub to determine if the wheel is included in the recall and contact Ritchey to schedule a free repair.
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; only rear wheels from the Protocol, Carbon, DS, DS Aero, and Girder models featuring high flange hubs measuring 60 millimeters in diameter with a straight hub body between the flanges are aff…

cards.product: Kelty Speedster Deluxe and Speedster Deuce Jogging Strollers
cards.title: CPSC, Kelty Announce Recall of Speedster Jogging Strollers
cards.hazard: The stroller handle can disconnect from the stroller frame during use.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these recalled strollers and return them to the store where purchased for a refund. Contact Kelty for a free da…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the tag inside the child's seat and the serial number on the rear frame sticker against the recalled ranges.

cards.product: American Classic road and mountain bike wheels
cards.title: CPSC, American Classic Announce Recall of Bicycle Wheels
cards.hazard: The hub in the bicycle's rear wheel can fail to engage properly, causing no resistance when pedaling. The bicycle rider could lose balance, fall and suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bike wheels with the recalled hubs and contact your local bicycle retailer to receive a free inspection. If…
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the rear hub shell for a serial number starting with the letter S, located on the center opposite the American Classic logo.

cards.title: CPSC, ICON Health & Fitness, Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Epic T60 Treadmills
cards.hazard: If assembly instructions are not properly followed, the gas spring/shock can be damaged during assembly, if the walking platform is folded up and goes beyond the vertical position. This action can ca…
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact ICON Health & Fitness for information on how to determine whether their treadmills have been damaged and to obtain…
cards.tell: You can tell by the model number EPTL81804 located on a decal on the front frame near the power cord entry.

cards.product: TidalForce S-750 High Performance Electric Bicycles
cards.title: CPSC, WaveCrest Laboratories LLC Announce Recall of Electric Bicycles
cards.hazard: The front and/or rear wheel can collapse, causing the rider to fall and suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding the electric bicycle immediately and contact WaveCrest Laboratories, if they purchased an electric bicycle wit…
cards.tell: Check the bicycle identification number on the white bar-coded sticker located on the seat tube of the frame against the list on the TidalForce website.

cards.product: Kawasaki Model Year 2001-2005 Prairie and Brute Force All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs)
cards.title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall of ATVs
cards.hazard: A significant impact to the front wheel of the ATV while the steering is fully turned to either side can result in suspension damage, wear, and an eventual loss of steering control, that could result…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled ATVs immediately and contact an authorized Kawasaki ATV dealer to arrange for a free repair. Regis…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the model name on the gas tank and the identification label on the frame.

cards.title: CPSC, Giant Bicycle, Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
cards.hazard: The rear axle on the bicycle is harder than required by the manufacturer's specification and could crack.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately and contact Giant Bicycle if they have a recalled bicycle. Giant Bicycle will repla…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled bicycles by checking the serial number on the bottom bracket near the pedals against the list on the manufacturer website.

cards.title: CPSC, DESA Heating Products Announce Recall of Compact Gas Fireplaces
cards.hazard: The burner tube connection to the gas valve can leak gas when the main burner is on. This leaking gas can ignite, causing a minor flare-up, which could cause nearby combustibles to ignite.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using this fireplace immediately and contact your retailer to schedule a free repair. If consumers have any questions…
cards.tell: Check the model data tags inside the lower access door for model and serial numbers between 015200000 and 017400000.

cards.title: CPSC, The Holmes Group Expands Recall of Slow Cookers
cards.hazard: The handles on the base of the slow cookers can break, posing a risk of burns from hot contents spilling onto consumers. These Rival® Slow Cookers, sold from January 1999 through May 2002, were previ…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and contact The Holmes Group to receive instructions on receiving a replacement base.
cards.tell: Check the model number on the bottom label and the date code stamped on the power plug prong, which ranges from 0199 to 3504.

cards.title: CPSC, Sportcraft Announce Recall of Treadmills
cards.hazard: The treadmill can unexpectedly accelerate and cause users to fall and sustain injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled treadmills immediately. The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available. Please de…
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the control console, where the name Sportcraft and the model Tredex 6.0, TX 440, or TX 550 are printed.

cards.product: Polaris "900 Fusion" "900 RMK" and "900 Switchback" Snowmobiles
cards.title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of 900 Fusion, 900 RMK, and 900 Switchback Snowmobiles
cards.hazard: There are three separate issues involved in this safety recall: Front Suspension Spindle - The nut that fastens the upper control arm ball joint to the suspension spindle can loosen. If this occurs,…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the snowmobile and contact their Polaris dealer to schedule a free repair. Polaris is directly noti…
cards.tell: Check the model number embossed on the identification decal located on the right-front side of the tunnel to see if it matches the recalled model numbers.

cards.title: CPSC, American Suzuki Motor Corp. Announce Recall of ATVs
cards.hazard: A significant impact to the front wheel of the ATV, while the steering is fully turned to either side, can result in suspension damage, wear, and an eventual loss of steering control, that could resu…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ATVs immediately. Registered owners have been notified about this recall by mail. Consumers with a recall…
cards.tell: All units of this model and year range are recalled. The vehicles are yellow or blue with TwinPeaks written on the fuel tank.

cards.title: CPSC, Meco Corp. Announce Recall of Children's Folding Chairs
cards.hazard: Children's fingers can become caught or entrapped in the hinge and slot areas of the chair, posing a pinch or cut hazard. Note: In 2004, Meco recalled red-colored children's folding chairs because pa…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the chairs and contact Meco for instructions on receiving a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Meco or Samsonite is printed on the label underneath the seat bottom.

cards.title: CPSC, Idea Nuova Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Children's Folding Chairs
cards.hazard: The chair's safety lock can fail, allowing the chair to collapse or fold unexpectedly. Children's fingers can become caught or entrapped in the hinge and slot areas of the chair, posing a pinch or cu…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these chairs immediately, and contact Idea Nuova for instructions on how to receive a free repair kit to replac…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Idea Nuova Inc. or I.N.I. is printed on a label located underneath the seat.

cards.title: CPSC, Fourstar Group Announce Recall to Repair Kid's Folding Chairs
cards.hazard: The chair's safety lock can fail, allowing the chair to collapse or fold unexpectedly. Children's fingers can become caught or entrapped in the hinge and slot areas of the chair, posing a pinch or cu…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the chairs immediately, and contact Fourstar for instructions on how to receive a free repair kit to replace th…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. A label located underneath the seat states MANUFACTURED BY FOURSTAR GROUP INC. or IMPORTED BY FOURSTAR INTERNATIONAL TRADING COMPANY.

cards.title: CPSC, Radio Flyer Inc. Announce Recall of Toddler Walker Wagon
cards.hazard: The tips of the clickers, which make a clicking sound when the Walker Wagon wheels move, can break off. The broken clickers pose a choking or aspiration hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take these recalled Walker Wagons away from young children and contact Radio Flyer for free replacement clicke…
cards.tell: Recalled wagons have black plastic clickers between the rear wheels and the wagon; wagons with clear plastic clickers are not included.

cards.product: Kidde 10 lb. industrial dry chemical fire extinguishers with black plastic Zytel® nylon valves in steel cylinders manuf…
cards.title: CPSC, Kidde Announce Recall of Industrial Fire Extinguishers
cards.hazard: The nylon valves on these extinguishers can separate from the steel cylinder during the 6-year recharge service or shortly afterwards, creating a safety hazard to fire extinguisher service personnel…
cards.remedy: Fire Extinguisher Distributors and Service Organizations must immediately stop servicing all units covered under this Alert. Kidde has inst…
cards.tell: The recalled units are 10 lb. industrial dry chemical fire extinguishers with black plastic Zytel nylon valves and steel cylinders manufactured between 1991 and 2000.

cards.title: CPSC, H&M Announce Recall of Baby Denim and Knit Jackets
cards.hazard: The metal buttons can come loose and detach from these garments, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Take these jackets away from young children immediately, and return the jacket to any H&M store for a full refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled jacket by checking the style number 432740 on the laundry care tag inside and H&M on the collar label.

cards.product: VisionTech USA SuperMax, TriMax, TriMax Plus and Pro model Integrated Bicycle Aero Bars
cards.title: CPSC, VisionTech USA, Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Aero Bars
cards.hazard: The centerpiece of these bicycle aero bars can crack or break, causing the bicycle rider to lose control and crash.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycle aero bars immediately and contact VisionTech USA, Inc. to have their aero bars tested. A free repla…
cards.tell: Recalled units have a gold VisionTech logo on a black background; units with a silver and red decal saying Vision by Full Speed Ahead are not included.

cards.product: So Hot Way Cool Free Wheel Trucks
cards.title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Children's Toy Trucks
cards.hazard: Small parts could break off the truck, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the toy trucks away from children and return them to the nearest Target store for a gift card in the amount of a full…
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Lamplight Farms Inc. Announce Recall of Tiki® Cone Metal Torches Sold at Wal-Mart
cards.hazard: The head and cover of these torches can come loose or be dislodged during use, allowing torch fuel to spill. This poses a risk of burn injuries and property damage.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these torches and return them to any Wal-Mart store for a refund.
cards.tell: Check for model numbers 1263 and 126301 or Wal-Mart item numbers 1656121 and 1691366 on the product or UPC 086861012635 on the bottom of the printed hangtag.

cards.product: Mountain Buggy Urban Single and Urban Double Jogging Strollers
cards.title: CPSC, Sycamore Kids Inc. Announce Recall of Mountain Buggy Jogging Strollers
cards.hazard: The handlebar can crack or break, causing the handlebar to possibly detach while in use, posing a risk of injury to young children.
cards.remedy: Contact Sycamore Kids to find an authorized repair center to receive a free replacement handlebar ratchet.
cards.tell: You can tell by checking the item and serial numbers located on the back of the metal plate above the footrest.

cards.title: CPSC, Value City Announce Recall of Blow Dart Guns
cards.hazard: Consumers may have mistakenly purchased the dart guns, thinking it was a decorative walking stick, posing the risk of injury, if someone used the gun for its intended purpose.
cards.remedy: Consumers should secure the blow dart gun and darts and return them to any Value City store for a full cash refund.
cards.tell: All units of this African Blow Dart Gun are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, BJ Alan Co. Announce Recall of Mammoth Smoke Fountain Fireworks
cards.hazard: The device can unexpectedly propel on the ground or unintentionally explode during use, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and contact BJ Alan Co. for a replacement product.
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled; they are 4.5-inch-long cylindrical tubes with MAMMOTH SMOKE written on the side in blue and yellow.

cards.title: CPSC, BJ Alan Co. Announce Recall of "Blaster Balls" Fireworks
cards.hazard: When the blaster balls are hit together, they can produce a spark that can catch on fire, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and contact BJ Alan Co. for a replacement product.
cards.tell: All units are recalled, sold in a blister pack with UPC number 3826959035 on the back.

cards.product: Nature's Bounty and Natural Wealth Brand Multivitamins
cards.title: CPSC, NBTY Inc. Announce Recall of Multivitamins
cards.hazard: The vitamins contain iron, but do not have child-resistant packaging, as required by federal law. They could cause serious injury or death if ingested by a child.
cards.remedy: Consumers should keep this product out of the reach of children and return it to the store where it was purchased or contact NBTY for infor…
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled vitamins by checking the label for lot number 60835-06 on Nature's Bounty Multi-Day Multivitamin Plus Iron or Natural Wealth Daily Vitamin Plus Iron containers.

cards.product: Inprint™ Safe-Box used to store handguns and valuables
cards.title: CPSC, Perm-a-Store Announce Recall of Inprint™ Safe-Boxes for Handguns
cards.hazard: The door on these safe-boxes may not latch properly when closed, possibly giving children and others unauthorized access to a firearm.
cards.remedy: Consumers can return the recalled safe-boxes to Perm-a-Store for a free repair or ship the safe-box directly to Perm-a-Store for free, usin…
cards.tell: Recalled units have serial numbers 04470001 through 04470500 printed on the inside back panel near the battery tray.

cards.title: CPSC, Pokémon USA Announce Recall of Pokémon Plush Toys
cards.hazard: The stuffing of the toy may contain tips of sewing needles, which could pose a puncture hazard.
cards.remedy: Parents should take these toys away from children immediately and contact Pokémon USA to receive a free replacement toy.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Check for the sewn-in label that reads Pokémon Center and 2005 MADE IN CHINA.

cards.product: Graco Duo Tandem Stroller, Graco MetroLite Stroller
cards.title: CPSC, Graco Children's Products Inc. Announce Recall of Duo Tandem and Certain MetroLite™ Strollers
cards.hazard: These strollers can fail to latch properly and unexpectedly collapse while in use. This can result in broken bones, cuts, bumps, bruises and other injuries to young children riding in the stroller an…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these strollers immediately and contact the firm to receive a free repair kit. The kit includes a custom-design…
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers on the label located on the frame (Duo Tandem) or on the cross bar under the foot rest (MetroLite).

cards.title: CPSC, Tecumseh Power Co. Announce Recall to Repair Lawn Tractors
cards.hazard: The axles on these lawn tractors can crack and break, if subject to extreme load amounts. Should the axle break, it could cause a loss of control and result in injuries to the rider.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using their lawn tractor, and contact Tecumseh for assistance in identifying affected units, and free rep…
cards.tell: You can tell by the model numbers under the seat and transaxle transaxle date codes between 4275 and 5047 followed by the letter G on the ID label.

cards.product: 2003 Rolf Prima Vigor and Elan Bicycle Wheels (rear wheel only)
cards.title: CPSC, Rolf Prima Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Wheels
cards.hazard: The rear wheel freehub mechanism can malfunction, causing no resistance when pedaling. The bicycle rider could lose balance, fall and suffer injuries.

cards.hazard: An internal metal pin can wear down, causing the pogo sticks to remain stuck in the down position and release unexpectedly, posing a risk of fall or facial impact injuries to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the products away from children immediately and contact Fisher-Price to receive a free replacement pogo stick.

cards.product: Dimension Bicycle Road and Mountain Threadless Handlebar Stems

cards.tell: The recalled stems are black or silver with a 130-degree rise and the word Dimension painted on the extension; model numbers are printed on the original packaging.

cards.tell: Recalled heaters have model number HCH4305 and a date code beginning with 33xx through 39xx located on the bottom of the heater.

cards.title: CPSC, Cimberio S.p.A. and Dormont Manufacturing Company Announce Recall of Certain Cimberio Gas Valves
cards.hazard: When one of these valves is closed, it could open up slightly. If the gas supply is on, gas will leak from the inlet port through the ball/seat and travel through the outlet port. If the valve is not…
cards.remedy: Return any affected products that remain in inventory to Dormont.
cards.tell: Affected valves have a red handle and various markings on the valve body; see the manufacturer website for photographs.

cards.title: CPSC, Simplicity Inc. Announce Recall of Cribs
cards.hazard: The white paint on the cribs can chip, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact Simplicity Inc. to receive a refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled crib by the model number printed inside the headboard and on a label on the inside bottom of the headboard.

cards.title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of Select Model Year 2004.5 and 2005 Sportsman and 2005 Model Year Scrambler ATVs
cards.hazard: Some 2004.5 and 2005 Model Year Sportsman and 2005 Model Year Scrambler 500 ATVs were assembled with possibly defective Electronic Control Modules (ECM), which may fail and overheat. If this were to…
cards.remedy: Free repair. Contact your Polaris ATV dealer to schedule an appointment for ECM replacement. Polaris has notified registered affected consu…

cards.title: CPSC, Jake's Fireworks Inc. Announce Recall of Fireworks
cards.hazard: The aerial shells are fused, shaped, and labeled in a way that could cause consumers to unintentionally place them into the launch tube upside down, resulting in a ground-level explosion. Such an exp…

cards.tell: All 24-shot Excalibur Reloadable Artillery Shell Kits sold in a black box with plastic windows are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Atico International USA Announce Recall of Children's Folding Chairs
cards.hazard: The chair's safety lock can fail, allowing the chair to collapse or fold unexpectedly. Children's fingers can become caught or entrapped in the hinge and slot areas of the chair, posing a pinch or cu…

cards.hazard: The fuel petcock inserts were made with incorrect material, that does not correctly bond the fuel tank and petcock insert, which could allow fuel leakage. If this occurs, a fire hazard with the possi…

cards.product: Okie Dokie® Striped Bodysuits with Puffy Appliqué

cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the fireplaces immediately and contact Heat & Glo to make arrangements for a free repair. To be sure that no on…

cards.title: CPSC, Bell & Gossett Announce Recall of Dual Unit Valves
cards.hazard: Burn injury from a hot water leak.

cards.title: CPSC, Sharp Electronics Corp. Announce Recall of Conventional Tube Televisions
cards.hazard: The power button can break, allowing objects to be inserted through the opening. Foreign materials, such as crayons, metal objects or straws, can ignite posing a fire hazard.

cards.tell: You can tell the recalled televisions by checking the model number on the label located on the back of the television.

cards.remedy: Owners who have not already been directly contacted by Royal Seating should visit the firm's Web site or call Royal Seating toll-free to re…

cards.product: Light-up Pacifier, New Style Piano and High Toys Choochoo Toy Train

cards.hazard: The pacifiers and toys can easily break apart, exposing small parts. This poses a choking hazard to young children.

cards.tell: All units of the Light-up Pacifiers, New Style Pianos, and High Toys Choochoo Toy Trains are recalled.

cards.product: Martha Stewart Everyday "sunny meadow" four-piece sanded votive candle sets
cards.title: CPSC and Global Gift Industries Announce Recall of Martha Stewart Everyday Brand Flowerpot Candle Sets Sold Exclusively at Kmart
cards.hazard: These candles can have a high flame, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers.

cards.title: CPSC, Carter's Announce Recall of Carter's Brand Children's Overalls

cards.product: Yamaha PW80 and TT-R90 Off-Road Motorcycles and Grizzly 125 ATVs

cards.title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Karaoke Cassette Player/Recorders
cards.hazard: The paint on the five control buttons of the karaoke player contains excessive lead, posing a lead poisoning hazard to young children. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problem…

cards.hazard: Water can enter the throttle lever case and freeze, causing the throttle lever to become stuck and fail to automatically return to the idle position when the rider releases the throttle. If the throt…

cards.remedy: Return the recalled bathrobes to Petit Bateau USA Inc., 45 Essex Street, Suite 200, Millburn, NJ 07041 to receive a full refund, including…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The bathrobes are labeled Petit Bateau on the center-back neck edge.

cards.title: CPSC, Cordelia Lighting Announce Recall of Hampton Bay® Light Fixtures Sold at Expo Design Centers
cards.hazard: The decorative metal rings on the ends of the lamp fixtures can detach. Consumers could suffer minor burns if they touch the hot rings.
cards.remedy: Customers should stop using the light fixtures and return them to the nearest Expo Design Center store for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the fixture by its three adjustable lamp heads with silver metal rings and frosted glass shades, measuring 15.75 inches wide by 6 inches high, with a clear label reading MADE IN…

cards.title: CPSC, Schneider Electric North American Division Announce Recall of AFCIs
cards.hazard: An AFCI is an electrical circuit protection device (circuit breaker) that detects electrical arcs from cracked, broken or damaged electrical insulation and shuts off power to the circuit before the a…
cards.remedy: Installed AFCIs will be replaced free of charge through electrical contractors. Consumers can return uninstalled AFCIs to the retailers or…
cards.tell: Recalled units have a blue test button, date codes CN through JN stamped in red on the label above the wiring terminal, and specific catalog numbers printed on the front label.

cards.product: adidas Superstar Ultra and Pro Team Shoes
cards.title: CPSC, adidas America Inc. Announce Recall of Basketball Shoes
cards.hazard: A portion of the sole of the heel can separate or tear during use, which can result in injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled shoes, and contact adidas America to receive a prepaid mailing label and a refund or g…
cards.tell: Check the six-digit article number on the inside part of the shoe tongue against the recalled list.

cards.title: CPSC, Quality Bicycle Products Announce Recall of Bicycle Forks
cards.hazard: The steering tube on the bicycle fork can crack or break, causing a sudden loss of steering control and causing a fall hazard to bicyclists.
cards.remedy: Contact your local Salsa dealer to schedule a free repair. Salsa dealers have notified consumers directly about this recall.
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; check for code CK, DA, or DB and serial number 03400 to 04600 on a label at the base of the steerer tube near the crown.

cards.product: Robertshaw TS-11 Thermal Safety Control Gas Valve and the "magnet head" on the gas valve
cards.title: CPSC, Robertshaw Controls Company Announce Recall of TS-11 Thermal Safety Control Gas Valves
cards.hazard: If the pilot light goes out, the gas valve can stick in an open position, permitting gas to continue to flow. This can result in a gas explosion and fire, which could result in severe personal injury…
cards.remedy: Free repair or replacement (if necessary). Robertshaw Controls Company will arrange for free repair or replacement of the recalled gas valv…
cards.tell: Recalled valves can be identified by date codes 0306 through and including 0432.

cards.product: Batteries in Kyocera Wireless Corp. Cell Phones
cards.title: CPSC, Kyocera Wireless Corp. Announce Recall of Cell Phone Batteries
cards.hazard: Some of the cell phone batteries supplied by the battery manufacturer may be counterfeit. This can cause the batteries to short-circuit, overheat and pose burn hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled batteries in their cell phones. Kyocera will contact consumers directly to arrange for…
cards.tell: Check the battery model numbers and Kyocera name printing on the battery to see if it matches the recalled battery product codes for Slider, K400, and 3200 series.

cards.title: CPSC, Rio Brands Announce Recall of Folding Lawn Chairs Sold at Wal-Mart
cards.hazard: The chair arms can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and return the chairs to Wal-Mart for a refund.
cards.tell: The recalled chairs have green or blue plastic arms with matching folding frames and vinyl webbing, and the word RIO on the left-hand arm.

cards.product: Toy Ice Cream Car, Police Car, and Washing Machine
cards.title: CPSC, Tai Tung International Recall Car and Washing Machine Toys
cards.hazard: The multicolored beads inside the toys can become accessible to children, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled toys away from young children and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The toys include multicolored 5-inch cars and pink, white, or red 4.5-inch washing machines that make sounds and flash lights.

cards.title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of RANGER 4x4 Utility Vehicles
cards.hazard: The lower steering shaft assembly may have a missing or misplaced weld that connects the steering wheel to the steering gear box assembly. If a weld is missing or misplaced, the lower steering shaft…
cards.remedy: Contact your Polaris dealer to schedule an appointment to replace the steering shaft assembly. Polaris has notified consumers directly abou…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by model number R05RD50AA located on the upper right frame tube directly under the right side of the seat.

cards.product: Beefmaster Explorer Outdoor Gas Grill, Model Number 720-0001
cards.title: CPSC, Nexgrill Industries Announce Recall of Gas Grills to Replace Gas Pressure Regulator (On/Off Gauge)
cards.hazard: As consumers adjust the gas pressure regulator (on/off gauge) leading to the propane cylinder, the label on the valve can become positioned in such a manner that it is difficult to read. This can cau…
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact Nexgrill to obtain a free replacement gauge. Consumers can also return the product to the company for installation…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled grill by checking the model number 720-0001 located on the back panel and the brand name Nexgrill on a plate on the grill lid.

cards.title: CPSC, International Playthings, Inc. Announce Recall of Rattles
cards.hazard: The spiral section of the rattle can come apart, releasing small balls inside. This can pose a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled rattle away from young children and contact International Playthings for a refund or replace…
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Zippo Announce Recall of Multi-Purpose Utility Lighters
cards.hazard: The utility lighters may spill fuel from the nozzle when first used, causing a potential fire hazard, through a secondary source of ignition.
cards.remedy: Free replacement multi-purpose lighter when consumer sends to the company the black adjuster knob from the bottom of the lighter.
cards.tell: Check the black adjuster knob on the bottom of the lighter for the date codes G03, H03, I03, or ZH03.

cards.title: CPSC, Chris Arlotta Enterprises Ltd. Announce Recall of Mattress Pads
cards.hazard: These mattress pads fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability, under the Flammable Fabrics Act. They pose a serious risk of burn injury or death to consumers, if exposed to smolder…
cards.remedy: Consumer should immediately stop using the product and contact Chris Arlotta Enterprises Ltd. or the retailer, for information on how to ob…
cards.tell: Check the style numbers and retailer information identified on the product packaging to identify the recalled natural colored 100 percent cotton Chenille mattress pads.

cards.title: CPSC, Avanti Products Inc. Announce Recall of Water Dispensers
cards.hazard: The hot water faucet on these units has a child-resistant safety feature to prevent young children from accessing the hot water. The device can malfunction, so that the faucet will not turn off, caus…
cards.remedy: Consumers with small children should immediately disable the hot water by turning the red switch on the back of the dispenser to off and co…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model number on a silver sticker located on the back of the unit for WD32, WD 50, WD 50.1, WDT51, WDR 52, or WHC 59.

cards.product: Care Bears Lunch Kits with Water Bottles
cards.title: CPSC, Sky High International Announce Recall of Care Bears Lunch Kits Sold at Kohl's Department Stores
cards.hazard: The pull-up drinking spout can detach from the bottle, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers are advised to stop using the water bottles immediately and contact Sky High International for a refund of the water bottle.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The purple and blue lunch bags are about 9 inches tall with a rainbow strap and a multi-colored front displaying Care Bears characters.

cards.title: CPSC, IKEA Home Furnishings Announce Recall of Fargglad Multi-Color Children's Chair
cards.hazard: Choking hazard from red plastic feet that can detach from chair legs.
cards.remedy: Full refund. Take the Fargglad multi-color children's chair away from young children immediately and return it to the "Returns and Exchange…
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by article number 400.548.40 and supplier number 16592 or 17128 located on a label on the rear leg or underside of the seat.

cards.title: CPSC, Little Giant Pump Co. Announce Recall of Cooler Pumps
cards.hazard: The motor caps on the cooler pumps are not made with flame-retardant material and an internal electrical failure can ignite the cap, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the pump immediately and contact Little Giant to receive a replacement cap and instructions free of charge.
cards.tell: Recalled pumps have a light blue motor cap and list specific model and item numbers on a label on the motor cap.

cards.title: CPSC, LaCrosse Footwear, Inc. Announce Recall of Work Boots
cards.hazard: The protective toe cap on the boots may not provide sufficient impact and compression protection. This could result in crushing, bruising, or other injury to the wearer's foot.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the boots immediately and contact LaCrosse to receive a store credit toward the purchase of a new pair of boots.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled boots by checking the style name Polar or Trailblazer and the style number printed on the inside of the tongue.

cards.title: CPSC, Giant Bicycle Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
cards.hazard: The front brake mounting tabs can break, causing the brakes to fail and the rider to lose control of the bicycle.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact Giant Bicycle to determine whether their bicycle is included in this recall. Authorized dealers who sold these bic…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled bicycle by checking the 2004 Rainier model with Marzocchi EXR Comp front forks and model numbers 333502, 333503, 333504, or 333505.

cards.product: Teng Fei Energy Saving Light Bulbs
cards.title: CPSC, Teng Fei Trading Inc. Announce Recall of Energy Saving Light Bulbs
cards.hazard: The base of the bulb is not flame-retardant, as required in the voluntary standard for this type of bulb. Electrical components in the bulb can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these light bulbs and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled bulbs by checking the packaging for model numbers T6112, T6113, T6114, and T6115, and by looking for Teng Fei 110-127V 50/60Hz written on the bulb.

cards.title: CPSC, Chicago Wholesale & Imports Inc. Announce Recall of Electric Pictures
cards.hazard: These pictures have inadequate construction, incorrect wiring, and use flammable materials, all of which pose fire and electric shock hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumer should stop using the electrical components to the pictures immediately and return them to Chicago Wholesale & Imports for a refun…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. These are framed artwork featuring moving background scenes with electric lights and sound, coming in seven different sizes with wooden, glass mirror, or plastic frames.

cards.product: AC adapters used with notebook personal computers
cards.title: CPSC, Dell Inc. Announce Recall of AC Adapters for Notebook Computers
cards.hazard: The adapters can overheat, posing a risk of fire and electrical shock hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers with these adapters should immediately contact Dell to determine if they are included in this recall. Not all adapters listed abo…
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled AC adapters by the words DELL and P/N 9364U, P/N 7832D, or P/N 4983D printed on the back of the unit.

cards.title: CPSC, New York Zion Trading Corp. Announce Recall of Electric Fans
cards.hazard: The wiring is undersized and the power plug is not polarized, creating fire and shock hazards.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these fans immediately and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund.
cards.tell: Check the silver label on the back of the controls for model numbers FS-1601A or FS-1607C, and NYZT on the front fan guard.

cards.title: CPSC, Runtal North America Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Runtal Sundance Towel Radiators
cards.hazard: The towel rack may overheat and rupture when overloaded with towels, releasing heated fluid, which could result in a burn injury.
cards.remedy: Free replacement. Consumers should immediately stop using the heater function with towels loaded on the top rungs. Runtal is replacing all…
cards.tell: All units of the Runtal Sundance Towel Radiator are included in this recall.

cards.product: Ski-Doo® 2003 Grand Touring 800 SDI SE; Legend 800 SDI SE Ski-Doo® 2004 Legend 600 HO SDI SE, SE GT, Sport and Sport GT…
cards.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
cards.hazard: The throttle lever could become stuck, leading to loss of speed control and possible collision.
cards.remedy: Owners of affected units will be notified directly. Consumers should contact an authorized Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for re…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the vehicle to see if it matches the recalled 2003-2005 Ski-Doo snowmobile models listed in the recall.

cards.product: Ski-Doo® 2004 MX Z (E) 800 HO and GSX LTD (E) 800 HO snowmobiles
cards.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Announce Recall of Snowmobiles
cards.hazard: The starter ring gear may crack, causing fragmentation and debris, which may act as a projectile at high speeds. A projectile could cause serious injury or death.
cards.remedy: Owners of affected units will be notified directly. Consumers should contact an authorized Ski-Doo dealer to schedule an appointment for re…
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers on your snowmobile to see if it matches the recalled 2004 MX Z 800 HO and GSX Ltd 800 HO models.

cards.title: CPSC, Goodman Company, L.P. Announce Recall of Amana, Trane, and American Standard Brand Package Terminal Air Conditioners/Heat Pumps
cards.hazard: Fire hazard, resulting from this chain of events: filter becomes clogged due to lack of maintenance, severely restricting airflow and resulting in elevated internal temperature; this may cause two sa…
cards.remedy: Free thermal safety limit switch. Commercial and institutional owners will install the replacement switch themselves. Individual homeowners…
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers located below the operating controls under the front cover assembly to see if they match the recalled ranges.

cards.product: Allez Sport, Allez Elite, Roubaix, and Sequoia Bicycles
cards.title: CPSC, Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
cards.hazard: The handlebar may loosen and turn unexpectedly, which can cause the rider to lose control and fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles with these recalled handlebars and return the recalled handlebars to the place of purchase for rep…
cards.tell: The recalled handlebars were sold on the 2005 Allez Sport, 2005 Allez Elite, 2005 Roubaix base model and 2005 Sequoia base model bicycles, with model names on the frame.

cards.product: Full Speed Ahead (FSA) Scatto bicycle wheel quick releases
cards.title: CPSC, Full Speed Ahead Announce Recall of Scatto Bicycle Wheel Quick Releases Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
cards.hazard: An internal part in the lever mechanism can break, reducing clamping effectiveness and rendering the unit inoperable, potentially causing a bicyclist to fall.
cards.remedy: Free replacement. Consumers should stop using the quick releases and call Full Speed Ahead toll-free at (877) 743-3372 from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m…
cards.tell: All Full Speed Ahead Scatto bicycle wheel quick releases are recalled. The levers are laser etched FSA and the end pieces have a distinctive round shape.

cards.title: CPSC, Sauder Woodworking Co. Announce Recall of TV/VCR Carts Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
cards.hazard: The carts can tip over and the television can fall off, posing a risk of serious injury or death if the TV and cart fall on a child.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the TV/VCR carts immediately and do the following: Remove the television and all contents. Turn the cart over a…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled carts by model numbers 3355, 6355, 7755, 9855, and 9755, which can be found on the instruction book that came with the cart.

cards.title: CPSC, PlayKids USA Announce Recall of Baby Walkers Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
cards.hazard: The walkers will fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed if they fall down stairs.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled walkers immediately and contact PlayKids to receive a full refund.
cards.tell: Check the package and the sewn-in label on the seat back for the brand and model numbers.

cards.title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of ATVs
cards.hazard: The throttle cable may bind when the handlebars are turned full left or full right, resulting in an increase in engine speed and unintended vehicle acceleration. In addition, the fuel line may rub ag…
cards.remedy: Free repair. Contact your Polaris dealer to schedule an appointment to inspect, reroute, and replace the throttle cable and the fuel line a…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the rear upper frame tube under the right side of the seat.

cards.title: CPSC, Natura Products Downey Inc. Announce Recall of Pacifiers Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
cards.hazard: The pacifiers are banned under federal law. They failed federal safety tests, come apart, and can pose a choking hazard to infants and small children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the pacifiers away from young children and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The pacifiers are three inches long, made of pink, blue, green, or white plastic with a yellow nipple filled with a sugary substance, and the shield is labeled Jaloma.

cards.title: CPSC, IKEA Home Furnishings Announce Recall of Glass-Door Wall Cabinets Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
cards.hazard: Some of these glass-door wall cabinets have the wrong sized screws for the safety bracket, which can result in the cabinet not being properly secured to the wall. The cabinets can fall and injure nea…
cards.remedy: IKEA is offering a free repair kit. Consumers should contact IKEA to determine if their wall cabinet needs this repair.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the cabinet by the BERTBY name, article number 380.472.10, and supplier number 14709 on a label on the underside of the bottom panel or top side of the top panel.

cards.title: CPSC, Delta Enterprise Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Director's Chairs for Children Firms agree to stop importation until hazard is eliminated
cards.hazard: The chair can inadvertently be misassembled, so that the fabric seat can come off the chair's frame and expose metal support rods. If fabric seat comes off the frame, there is a laceration and fall h…
cards.remedy: Consumers are advised to stop using the chair immediately and contact Delta Enterprise Corp., to receive a free repair kit consisting of ne…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the model number found on a label located on the leg of the chair.

cards.product: Forte Flyte OS and "Weyless CF200" Carbon Handlebars
cards.title: CPSC, Performance Inc. and Supergo Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebars
cards.hazard: The handlebars can develop cracks that may not be visible, which can cause the handlebar to break without warning, resulting in serious injury or death.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles with these handlebars immediately and return the handlebars to the nearest Performance or Supergo…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; check for specific brand printing and graphics on the natural carbon gray handlebars.

cards.title: CPSC, Eddie Bauer Announce Recall of Ebtek Brand Backpacks with Stools
cards.hazard: The stool could collapse and cause the person using the stool to fall. The stool does not meet the firm's strength requirements.
cards.remedy: Known purchasers have received notification of this recall via a recall notice letter. Consumers should stop using the stool and contact Ed…
cards.tell: This recall includes units manufactured between February 2004 and March 2004.

cards.product: Some Bombardier 2003 Traxter® MAX; 2004 Traxter, Traxter MAX, Quest™ and Quest MAX; 2005 Traxter 5SP, 5SP MAX, CVT and…
cards.title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc., and Deere & Company Announce Recall of ATVs
cards.hazard: Front brake hose can be pulled out of its retaining brackets on either side of the ATV by foreign objects. This can cause the brake hose to wear by rubbing on the inner wheel or shock absorber spring…
cards.remedy: Free repair. Call a Bombardier or John Deere dealer to make an appointment to have your ATV repaired free of charge. Stop using your ATV un…
cards.tell: Check the model name and model number on the vehicle to see if it matches the recalled list.

cards.product: Wild Country-brand Helium carabiners used in rock climbing
cards.title: CPSC, Wild Country Ltd. Announce Recall of Helium Carabiners
cards.hazard: The carabiner gate may come open under a heavy load, which will significantly reduce the strength of the carabiner. The carabiner could break if the climber falls, posing a risk of serious injury or…
cards.remedy: Consumer should call the firm for instructions on returning these carabiners. The firm will reimburse shipping expenses and send the consum…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled carabiners by checking for batch codes AAA, AAB, AAC, AAD, AAE, and AAF, along with Wild Country and the model name written on the product.

cards.title: CPSC, Gruga U.S.A. Announce Recall to Repair Office Chairs Sold At Staples Stores
cards.hazard: The legs on the base of the chair can break, posing a risk of injury to the user.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the chairs immediately and contact Gruga U.S.A. to receive a free replacement base repair kit.
cards.tell: Check the label underneath the seat cushion for model numbers and date codes; only chairs with a date code prior to April 1, 2004, are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Reebok International Announce Recall of Toddler's Athletic Shoes
cards.hazard: The I-3 logo-tag on the tongue of the shoe can be peeled off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take these shoes away from young children and contact Reebok to receive a refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled shoes by checking the model number printed on a label on the underside of the tongue.

cards.title: CPSC, IMI Cornelius Announce Recall to Repair Frozen Carbonate Drink Dispensers
cards.hazard: The motor drive can overheat and cause the liquid contents to become hot. If this happens, the dispenser's nozzle can break and expose consumers to the hot liquid, posing a risk of burns.
cards.remedy: Owners of the drink dispensers should discontinue use and contact IMI Cornelius. The company will send a customer service representative to…
cards.tell: Cornelius is notifying customers of the serial numbers of affected units, and the names Cornelius, FCB, and Pinnacle are on the identification plates on the right-side panel.

cards.title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Inc. Announce Recall of Certain 2004 Snowmobiles
cards.hazard: The red plastic skis used on certain 2004 Firecat and Sabercat snowmobiles could crack or break as a result of off-season exposure to ultraviolet sunlight. Ski failure could lead to loss of control,…
cards.remedy: Free repair at the local Arctic Cat snowmobile dealer. Registered owners have been notified about this recall by mail.
cards.tell: All 2004 Firecat and Sabercat snowmobiles with red plastic skis having part number 1703-500 are included; the model name is on either side of the hood.

cards.title: CPSC, NCR Corp. Announce Recall of NCR Universal Inkjet Refill Kits
cards.hazard: The product does not have required child-resistant packaging or required warning labels. The product contains ethylene glycol, posing an ingestion hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the kits out of the reach of young children and return to the store where purchased to receive a refund…
cards.tell: You can tell by the model numbers 943264, 999292, or 999289 printed on the side panel above the UPC code on the clear plastic package.

cards.title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of ATVs
cards.hazard: The front brake lines can crack and leak brake fluid, possibly resulting in loss of braking capability. This could result in severe injury or death.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact their Polaris dealer to schedule an appointment for free inspection and repair.
cards.tell: Check the model number on the lower left frame tube ahead of the engine to see if it matches the recalled numbers.

cards.title: CPSC, Baby Swede, LLC Announce Recall to Repair "Baby Björn" Infant Carriers
cards.hazard: The back support buckle can detach from the shoulder straps, posing a fall hazard to the baby.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the carrier immediately and contact Baby Swede, LLC for instructions on returning the carriers for repair.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled carrier by model number 0260 printed on the care label on the strap and Baby Carrier Active written above the warning label.

cards.title: CPSC, Suzuki Announce Recall of Four-Wheel Drive Eiger ATVs
cards.hazard: Mislocated welds securing the upper front suspension arm mounting brackets to the frame. The mounting bracket could break off during riding, reducing rider control and resulting in loss of control of…
cards.remedy: Free inspection and repair at dealership. Call your Suzuki dealer for an appointment to have your Eiger ATV inspected and, if necessary, re…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; only 2004 model year Eiger ATVs with model numbers LT-A400FK4 and LT-F400FK4 produced from May 19 through May 25, 2004 are affected.

cards.title: CPSC, Hasbro Inc. Announce Recall of Monster Rockets
cards.hazard: The cap on the water tank can unexpectedly and forcibly project off when it is quickly unscrewed from the tank, posing a risk of impact injuries to users or bystanders. In addition, the rocket's tail…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the rockets immediately and contact Hasbro to receive a replacement product of equal value.
cards.tell: All Super Soaker Monster Rockets are included in this recall.

cards.product: Lexmark, Dell and IBM Laser Printers
cards.title: CPSC, Lexmark International Inc. Announce Recall of Laser Printers
cards.hazard: These printers can short-circuit, posing an electrical shock hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the laser printer, unplug it, and contact their corresponding laser printer company to register the…
cards.tell: Check the brand name and model number on the front of Lexmark and IBM printers, or inside the front cover for Dell printers.

cards.product: Leoch Electric Scooters (also known as "Red Dragon" and "E-Scooter")
cards.title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Electric Scooters
cards.hazard: Improper wiring can cause a short circuit, posing a fire hazard in the scooter. In addition, inadequate insulation may expose electrical wiring, which poses a shock hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the scooters immediately and return them to any Target store for a full refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled scooter by model number DK24250-3, a sticker on the left footrest reading E-Scooter, and a right footrest sticker with a horse-head image.

cards.product: Oceanic-brand Reliant Buoyancy Compensator (BC) Inflators and AERIS-brand AW3 BC Inflators
cards.title: CPSC, Pelagic Pressure Systems Announce Recall of SCUBA BC Inflators
cards.hazard: Inflator buttons can stick, which can cause uncontrolled inflation of the BC. This could cause divers to ascend too fast, resulting in decompression sickness as well as the danger of an embolism.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using BCs fitted with the recalled inflators immediately and take them to any authorized Oceanic or AERIS dealer to g…
cards.tell: The Oceanic Reliant inflators have three flow-through holes in the hand grip, and the AERIS AW3 inflator has one flow-through hole in the hand grip.

cards.title: CPSC, IBM Announce Recall of AC Adapters for Notebook Computers
cards.hazard: The adapters can overheat, cause damage to the circuit board and melt through the housing, which poses a fire and electrical shock hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should unplug the recalled adapters from the wall outlet immediately and contact IBM for a free replacement unit.
cards.tell: Recalled units have three hollow pins at the AC inlet and part number 02K6549 on a label on the top of the unit.

cards.title: CPSC, Halcyon Manufacturing Announce Recall of SCUBA BC Inflators
cards.hazard: The SCUBA BC bladder can have a slow leak because of imperfections within the machining of the stainless air barrel of their inflators. This can cause unexpected buoyancy problems with divers, possib…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these BCs immediately and contact Halcyon for information on receiving a free repair.
cards.tell: All stainless steel power inflators with a stainless steel oral and power inflate button are recalled. Plastic inflators are not included.

cards.product: Big V Maternity and Nursing Pillows
cards.title: CPSC, Theraline Inc. Announce Recall of Maternity and Nursing Pillows
cards.hazard: If infants are placed on these pillows and left unattended, there is a risk of suffocation. Infant pillows and cushions are banned under the Federal law. Infant pillows have a flexible fabric coverin…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these pillows immediately and contact the firm for information on receiving a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the pillow by the fabric tag sewn on it that reads Theraline, The Big V, and Finest Micropearl Filling.

cards.title: CPSC, Regal Lager Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Stroller Attachments
cards.hazard: The Buggy Board's red connecting pins can break, causing the board to partially detach from the stroller or carriage, posing a fall hazard to the user.
cards.remedy: The manufacturer is providing free repair kits to consumers, consisting of orange replacement pins for these Buggy Boards.
cards.tell: Recalled units have black connecting pins, while units with orange connecting pins are not included.

cards.title: CPSC, Boston Billows Inc. Announce Recall of Nursing Pillows
cards.hazard: If infants are placed on these pillows and left unattended, there is a risk of suffocation. Infant pillows and cushions are banned under the Federal law. Infant pillows have a flexible fabric coverin…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these pillows immediately and contact the firm for information on receiving a refund. Update: A December 19, 20…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled nursing pillow by the fabric tag on the pillow that reads, Boston Billows, Inc.

cards.product: Freestanding ranges, double ovens, and oven-microwave combinations

cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers located on a label inside the door of the units to see if they match the recalled ranges and ovens.

cards.product: General Electric, Hotpoint, Kenmore, and Americana brand freestanding electric ranges and double wall ovens

cards.tell: Check the brand and model number listed on the unit to see if it matches the specific recalled freestanding electric ranges and double wall ovens.

cards.hazard: The helmets do not comply with impact testing requirements in the Consumer Product Safety Act.

cards.product: Kid's Essentials Five-Piece Folding Furniture Set

cards.hazard: The UPS outputs were wired incorrectly, creating a reverse polarity configuration and a potential electrical shock hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the unit and contact Belkin Corp. for a free replacement unit.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model number on the label located on the rear of the unit.

cards.title: CPSC, Vaxcel International Co. Ltd. Announce Second Recall of Ceiling Fans
cards.hazard: These ceiling fans were assembled without the proper wire insulation sleeving, which could result in exposed wiring. Consumers could receive an electrical shock during installation or removal.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact Vaxcel to verify if they have one of the recalled ceiling fans and to receive a free replacement ceiling fan if th…
cards.tell: All units have model number 355-6645 and file number E215078 printed on a label located on the central housing of the ceiling fan.

cards.product: Wooden bunk beds: Twin/Twin, Twin/Double, and Loft Bunk
cards.title: CPSC, PJ Sleep Shop Announce Recall to Repair Bunk Beds
cards.hazard: These bunk beds have gaps between parts of the upper bunk end structure that violate the federal safety standard, because they pose entrapment or strangulation hazards to children. The spaces exceed…
cards.remedy: Stop using the recalled bunk beds and get a free repair kit from the manufacturer to cover up the entrapment hazards. Consumers can install…
cards.tell: Look for the manufacturer label on the inside of the upper bunk's end structure, and identify the configuration as Twin/Twin, Twin/Double, or Loft Bunk.

cards.title: CPSC, OTT-LITE Technology Announce Recall of "10,000 Lux Light Box" That Simulates Natural Sunlight
cards.hazard: Overheating around the socket (where the bulb fits into the light box) can result in melted plastic and smoke, posing a possible fire and burn hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled "10,000 Lux Light Box" immediately, unplug it, and return the product to OTT-LITE Technology for a…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The white light box measures 24 inches high and some may have a small label on top with the name Nu-Yu Light.

cards.product: Pokémon plush dolls, beanbags, and key chains

cards.hazard: The wooden rings on the holes of the product may crack, allowing the small wooden heads to fall out and pose a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: HearthSong will notify all known purchasers by mail regarding a refund and a discount towards the next purchase.
cards.tell: All units of the Peek-a-Boo Ball are included in this recall.

cards.hazard: The seams in the toy can tear open and expose small plastic pellets, posing a choking or aspiration hazard to young children who mouth the pellets.

cards.tell: Check the model number on the UL label on the bottom and a plug date code from 0199 to 1802 manufactured before May 2002.

cards.tell: You can identify the recalled bulbs by checking the UPC bar code on the back of the package for ending digits 13323, 13329, 13333, 13442, 13445, 13454, 13565, 13650, or 13721.

cards.title: CPSC, Vornado Air Circulation Systems Announce Recall of Portable Electric Heaters
cards.hazard: A faulty electrical connection can cause the heater to overheat and stop working, posing a fire hazard to consumers.

cards.hazard: These electric pressure washers do not have a ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) on the power cord, which poses a serious electrocution hazard if the unit comes into contact with water.

cards.product: Wheelbarrows sold under the brand names "Easy Roller," "Homeowner," "Mustang," or "Thoroughbred"
