cards.product: Defrost heaters used in grocery store frozen food cases
cards.title: CPSC, Carrier Commercial Refrigeration, Inc. Announce Recall of Grocery Frozen Food Case Heaters
cards.hazard: Moisture building up pressure inside the defrost heater can cause it to forcefully eject from the frozen food case, possibly injuring bystanders.
cards.remedy: Tyler will replace the recalled defrost heater with a Cal-rod hairpin style heater in all wide island frozen food and ice cream end cap cas…
cards.tell: You can tell by checking the model number 51957100 for the heater or case models NCE, NFE, NGE, NCGE, NFJEA, NCJEA, NCJGEA and NFJGEA listed on the data plate on the front inner panel.

cards.product: General Electric Cool Touch Slow Cooker
cards.title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. Announce Recall of Slow Cookers
cards.hazard: The heating element can drop to the bottom of the slow cooker and melt through the plastic outer shell, posing a burn hazard to users.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and return the slow cooker to Wal-Mart for a full refund.
cards.tell: Check the bottom of the base for the model number 168945 on a silver label.

cards.title: CPSC, The Land of Nod® Announce Recall of Children's Wooden Chairs
cards.hazard: The leg supports can crack, causing the chair to collapse. Children sitting in these chairs can fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these chairs immediately and contact The Land of Nod for instructions on how to return these chairs. The compan…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Check underneath the seat for a sticker reading Made in PROC or Made in China with no other writing.

cards.title: CPSC, Basler Electric Co. and Lutron Electronics Announce Recall of Power Supply Units
cards.hazard: The power supply, if overloaded, can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact Lutron Electronics to receive a free replacement power supply unit.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled unit by the model number BE29736001 imprinted on the plug side and a blue and white Lutron label with GRX-12VDC on the opposite side.

cards.product: Reedy Quasar Pro Battery Charger (charges batteries used to power remote control race cars)
cards.title: CPSC, Associated Electrics Inc. Announce Recall of Battery Chargers for Radio Control Race Cars
cards.hazard: A defective fuse and program error in the charger can cause the battery packs being charged to overheat and explode, posing a risk of serious injury to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the charger immediately and contact Associated Electrics to receive a free repair.
cards.tell: Recalled chargers show QUASAR PRO VERSION 1.0 on display, have no barcode label or have barcode labels with 611 or 611A on the underside.

cards.title: CPSC, Allen Organ Company Announce Recall of Wooden Organ Bench
cards.hazard: The wooden bench may collapse because not enough glue was used during assembly.
cards.remedy: Stop using the recalled benches immediately and contact your local Allen Organ dealer or call the Allen Organ Company Service Department fo…
cards.tell: All units of this wooden organ bench are recalled; it measures 26 inches high, 12 inches wide, and 48 inches long, and is made of oak, red oak, or walnut colored wood.

cards.title: CPSC, SMC and Home Depot Announce Recall of Oscillating Fans
cards.hazard: The electric power cord can be damaged by the oscillation motion of the fan. The damage to the cord can result in a short circuit and possible ignition of the plastic case, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled fans immediately and either return them to the Home Depot for a store credit, or contact SMC Marke…
cards.tell: You can tell by the model number SR-18 or SP-18 located on the back of the fan beside the on/off button.

cards.title: CPSC, First Samco Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Gun Holsters
cards.hazard: A plastic or leather strap on the gun holster can catch the trigger of the gun when inserted into the holster, causing the gun to unintentionally discharge, posing an injury hazard to the user.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the gun holsters immediately and bring the recalled gun holsters to an authorized Fobus USA distributor for a f…
cards.tell: Recalled holsters have GL 2*EMZ engraved on top, FOBUS and MADE IN ISRAEL on the back, and a retention strap less than one inch wide.

cards.title: CPSC, Far East Brokers and Consultants Inc. Announce Recall of Kiddie Car Cruisers Sold Exclusively at Big Y Stores
cards.hazard: The Kiddie Car Cruiser can continue to run when the accelerator is no longer depressed, which could result in the rider losing control of the car.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled car immediately and return it to a Big Y store to receive a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The ride-on toys feature Turbo and Cruiser printed on labels on the side.

cards.title: CPSC, Targus Announce Recall of International Plug Adapters
cards.hazard: The adapters may have an electrical wiring problem, posing a shock and fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the adapters immediately and contact Targus to receive a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The brand name Targus is printed on the front, and a switch on the side selects country settings.

cards.title: CPSC, Old Navy Announce Recall of Children's Zippered Outerwear
cards.hazard: The plastic zipper pull can detach from the zipper, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should return the garments to any Old Navy store for a refund and a complimentary $5 appreciation card.
cards.tell: You can tell by the style number and a clear oval-shaped zipper pull, with style numbers printed on a white label located under the garment-care tag.

cards.title: CPSC, Dynamic Cooking Systems Announce Recall of Self-Cleaning Wall Ovens
cards.hazard: When the oven is in the self-cleaning mode, the oven's exterior door temperature exceeds the allowable surface temperature limits under the industry voluntary standard for household electric ranges.…
cards.remedy: Consumers should not use the oven in self-cleaning mode, until free replacement doors have been installed. Call the company to make arrange…
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the model and serial numbers printed on the rating plate located on the oven frame, matching specific ranges for WOS and WOSD models.

cards.title: CPSC, Sportcraft Announce Recall of Tredex Treadmills
cards.hazard: The treadmill's circuitry can overheat, causing it to unexpectedly accelerate during use. When this happens, the user can fall.
cards.remedy: Stop using the Tredex 10.0 treadmill immediately. Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product. Do no…
cards.tell: You can tell by the name Tredex 10.0 which appears on the control console and on the motor cover.

cards.title: CPSC, Marukyo USA Announce Recall of Hair Dryers
cards.hazard: These electric hair dryers are not equipped with an immersion protection device, to prevent electrocution, if the hair dryer falls into water.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the hair dryers immediately and return them to the store where purchased or to Marukyo U.S.A. Inc. for a refund.
cards.tell: You can tell by the model number found on the handle, the blue or pink color, and the lack of an immersion protection device at the end of the plug.

cards.product: Room Air Conditioning and Heating Units
cards.title: CPSC, Electrolux Home Products Announce Recall of Air Conditioning/Heating Units
cards.hazard: The heating coil in the units can be damaged during assembly, causing an electrical short and overheating, which poses a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the units immediately and contact Electrolux for a free inspection and repair, if needed.
cards.tell: Check the model number on the serial plate on the side of the unit for Frigidaire model FAH12EM21 or Carrier models 52FED31201AA.

cards.product: Smart Fit™ and Teeny Toes™ Athletic Shoes
cards.title: CPSC, Payless ShoeSource Announce Recall of Children's Athletic Shoes
cards.hazard: The metal eyelet lace holder at the top of the shoe can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled shoes away from young children immediately and should return the shoes to a Payless ShoeSource store for…
cards.tell: You can tell by the five-digit number on a label on the bottom of the shoe tongue, which is one of the recalled numbers.

cards.title: CPSC, Dream On Me Industries Announce Recall of Baby Walkers
cards.hazard: The walkers will fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed if they fall down stairs.
cards.remedy: Stop using the recalled walkers immediately and return the walkers to the retailer where purchased to receive a refund.
cards.tell: Check the model number 408 or 423 written on a label sewn into the seat.

cards.product: Turbo Power electric hand-held hair dryers
cards.title: CPSC, Turbo Power Inc. Announce Recall of Electric Hand-held Hair Dryers
cards.hazard: These electric hair dryers are not equipped with an immersion protection device to prevent electrocution, if the hair dryer falls into water. Such electric shock protection devices are required by in…
cards.remedy: Return the hair dryer to either the retail store where purchased or to Turbo Power for a free replacement. Mail to: Turbo Power Inc., 31-40…
cards.tell: Check the label for Turbo Power or PIBBS, the model number, and voltage marking 110V/60HZ.

cards.title: CPSC, Pier 1 Imports Announce Recall of Tea Light Candleholders
cards.hazard: The beads on these tea light candleholders can catch fire during use.
cards.remedy: Stop using these tea light candleholders. Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled candleholders by the price sticker on the bottom that reads Pier 1, China, and SKU 1997504, 1998132, or 1998145.

cards.title: CPSC, Front Porch Classics Announce Recall of "Old Century Dread Pirate™" Coffee Table Games
cards.hazard: The surface coating and the metal in the ships contain lead and pose a risk of lead poisoning to young children. A child could ingest lead by swallowing a broken part of the ship or by repeatedly mou…
cards.remedy: Take the recalled "Dread Pirate" ships away from children immediately and call Front Porch for free replacement toy ships that do not conta…
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking for lot numbers 75, 79, and 81 located on the bottom of the treasure chest.

cards.title: CPSC, Backyard Products Announce Recall of Swings
cards.hazard: Chains on the swing can detach during use, and cause the child to fall to the ground and possibly suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product. Do not donate or resell.
cards.tell: All units are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, A. O. Smith Co. Announce Recall of Spas
cards.hazard: The motor in the circulating pump can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the spas immediately and contact the Spa Fulfillment Center to arrange for installation of a free replacement p…
cards.tell: The model name is on the top corner of the spa, and the recalled units have a motor label with the words Tiny Might.

cards.product: OKIFAX® 5780, 5980, 5980DL and Konica 9880 Facsimile machines (Fax machines)
cards.title: CPSC, Oki Data Announce Recall of Fax Machines
cards.hazard: The fax machines may incur a mechanical malfunction, posing a shock hazard to users.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the fax machines immediately, unplug the unit, and contact the company for a free repair.
cards.tell: Recalled units have serial numbers beginning with 3110A, 311A, 312A, 401A and 402A on the black and white barcode label on the back of the unit.

cards.product: Fondue Sets: the Modern Set in White, Black, or Stainless; the Classic Set in White or Black
cards.title: CPSC, The Fondue Factory LLC Announce Recall to Replace Glass Stands on Fondue Sets
cards.hazard: The top piece of glass that supports the fondue pot can shatter, posing a burn and laceration hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Stop using the recalled fondue pot immediately and contact the firm for a replacement wire frame stand that replaces the glass stand.
cards.tell: Check the item number printed on the invoice and assembly directions to identify the recalled sets.

cards.title: CPSC, LB International Inc. Announce Recall of Fold-Away Ladders Sold by Hammacher Schlemmer
cards.hazard: A rung on these aluminum, multi-purpose ladders can release or the side rail can bend unexpectedly. If that happens, the ladder can collapse, causing the user to fall.
cards.remedy: Hammacher Schlemmer is directly notifying consumers who purchased these ladders and providing information to return the ladders for a refun…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled ladders by checking the size and length, and looking for a label on the side rail that reads Multi-Purpose Heavy Duty Ladder.

cards.title: CPSC, Great Gifts Inc. Announce Recall of Snowmen Holiday Lamps
cards.hazard: These electric holiday lamps have undersized wiring, no strain relief on the electric cords, and the molded plastic enclosure is flammable. The lamps pose fire and electrocution hazards.
cards.remedy: Stop using these lamps and contact the firm to get information on returning them and receiving a refund.
cards.tell: Check the model number and label stating Made in China for Great Gifts McKeesport PA 15132 located on the base of the lamp.

cards.title: CPSC, Avon Products Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Snowman Nightlight Diffuser
cards.hazard: The scented oil can drip, causing the nightlight base to crack or break, exposing electrical wire or metal parts inside the nightlight, thus causing a potential shock hazard. There is also a risk of…
cards.remedy: Consumers can get a free replacement nightlight base that will not crack or break from the oil. Known purchasers are being sent direct mail…
cards.tell: All units of the Snowman Nightlight Diffuser are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Kmart Corp. Announce Recall of Martha Stewart Everyday® Safety Matches
cards.hazard: These matches may ignite upon impact, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the matches immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They come in a yellow checkered box with UPC 045774700237 printed on the back and are 11 inches long.

cards.title: CPSC, Genan Import Inc. Announce Recall of Kinetic Lighting Pictures
cards.hazard: These pictures have inadequate construction, incorrect wiring, and use flammable materials, all of which pose fire and electric shock hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Return the picture to Genan Import for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are framed artwork with electric lights and sound featuring moving background scenes like waterfalls, snow, nature, wolves, elephants, or dolphins in seven different sizes.

cards.title: CPSC and CESSO, LLC Announce Recall of Tree Stand Components
cards.hazard: If the "Tree Lounge" is subjected to significant impact from a heavy load, a tube on the leveler can crack. If the leveler is installed beneath the "Tree Lounge," the bolts attaching the leveler to t…
cards.remedy: Consumers should return their levelers to the firm for a free repair.
cards.tell: All Tree Lounge tree stand levelers are included in this recall.

cards.product: Children's Board Books with Sound Maker
cards.title: CPSC, DK Publishing Announce Recall of Children's Board Books with Sound Maker
cards.hazard: The sound maker mounted inside a plastic covering on the last page of the books poses a choking hazard to young children if removed.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these books away from young children immediately and contact DK Publishing to receive a replacement book of equal val…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The books feature eight different titles with a raised sound button in the lower right corner and the DK logo in the lower left corner.

cards.product: Metal Twin/Twin and Twin/Full Bunk Beds
cards.title: CPSC, Coaster Co. of America Announce Recall of Bunk Beds
cards.hazard: A gap between the step of the built-in ladder and the top bunk allows enough room for a child's body to slip through but will not allow for a child's head to pass through. This poses a serious strang…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bunk beds immediately and call Coaster of America for a free repair kit.
cards.tell: Check for model numbers 2008, 2056, 2256, or 2258 and a Coaster Company of America label on the bed frame of the top bunk.

cards.title: CPSC, Baby Trend Announce Recall of Certain Baby Trend "Passport" Strollers
cards.hazard: The fold joint can collapse unexpectedly, causing the baby to fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the stroller and contact Baby Trends, Inc. immediately. Baby Trend will ask the consumer to send a cut-out sect…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; check for model number 1514 and manufacturing dates between July 10, 2003, and November 26, 2003, printed on the lower frame behind the seat.

cards.title: CPSC, E & B Giftware LLC Announce Recall of Universal Electric Outlet Adaptor Plugs
cards.hazard: Multiple metal plugs can be extended from the product at one time. Consumers touching an exposed plug, while the adaptor is inserted into an electric outlet, can receive an electric shock.
cards.remedy: Stop using the adaptor plugs immediately and call E & B Giftware LLC for a replacement item of comparable value or a refund.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled adaptor plugs by MODEL: 1804 written on the bottom of the adaptor plug.

cards.title: CPSC, Shaw Industries Announce Recall of Flammable Carpet
cards.hazard: Due to a manufacturing error that over-treated the carpet with a "soil-resist" application, the carpet could readily ignite, presenting a serious risk of burn injuries. The recalled carpet violates t…
cards.remedy: Shaw Industries corrected the manufacturing error and will replace the recalled carpet with the same or comparable carpet.
cards.tell: Check the style name, style number, and color name against the specific list of recalled styles and colors provided by the manufacturer.

cards.title: CPSC, Casio Inc. Announce Recall of Piano Benches
cards.hazard: The screws and bracket assemblies attaching the legs to the bench can weaken and detach, causing the bench seat to collapse during normal use.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the benches immediately and contact Casio for instructions on how to return the product for a full refund plus…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled benches by the model name Bench DK in dark wood or Bench LT in light wood, featuring a plush leather covering and a Made in China sticker.

cards.product: Modular Test Leads used for Electrical Testing Multimeters
cards.title: CPSC, Fluke Corp. Announce Recall of Electrical Testing Components
cards.hazard: The leads, which are used to connect probes to handheld digital multimeters when testing for the presence and amount of voltage present in electrical circuitry, can result in incorrect multimeter rea…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled modular test leads immediately and contact Fluke for information on getting free replacement compo…
cards.tell: The recalled leads are red and black with no permanent probes, feature the Fluke logo, and lack the SureGrip symbol. Model numbers are on packaging or documents, not the leads.

cards.title: CPSC, L&N Sales and Marketing Announce Recall of Cordless Sweepers Sold on QVC
cards.hazard: The sweeper can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the sweeper immediately. A replacement sweeper will be offered free of charge by L&N through QVC. Consumers wil…
cards.tell: All units have clear blue plastic housing and model number EB005 / 52008 written on a silver-colored label on the bottom.

cards.product: LP and Convertible Gas Water Heater Temperature Controls
cards.title: CPSC, White-Rodgers Announce Recall of LP and Convertible Gas Water Heater Temperature Controls
cards.hazard: The gas water heater controls can gradually open instead of snapping open to full flow, which can cause soot to build up on the water heater burner, presenting a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Contact White-Rodgers to arrange for a qualified service technician to replace the recalled control, free of charge.
cards.tell: Check the white label with red lettering on the right side for the model number and the four-digit metal stamped date code 0240 to 0329 located below the label.

cards.title: CPSC, Trojan Technologies Announce Recall of Residential Water Disinfection Systems
cards.hazard: Some of the lamp pins used in these disinfection systems are improperly soldered, and can cause the units to overheat, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Contact Trojan Technologies to arrange a free lamp repair or replacement.
cards.tell: Check the Underwriters Laboratories label on the power supply for models D, D Plus, E, E Plus, F, F Plus, Pro 7, and 15.

cards.product: Majestic Vermont Castings fireplace remote receivers
cards.title: CPSC, CFM Corporation Announce Recall of Fireplace Remote Receivers
cards.hazard: The circuit board can overheat and catch fire, posing a burn and fire hazard.
cards.remedy: The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer available.
cards.tell: You can tell by the words Majestic Vermont Castings on the front label and model number ERX15 B on the CSA approval sticker on the back.

cards.product: Hamilton Beach Cappuccino Plus Espresso and Cappuccino Makers
cards.title: CPSC, Hamilton Beach Announce Recall of Espresso/Cappuccino Makers
cards.hazard: The steam tube inside the espresso/cappuccino maker can burst under pressure, presenting a risk of injury to consumers. This can occur if the frothing nozzle becomes clogged and the espresso button i…
cards.remedy: Hamilton Beach will ship free replacement espresso/cappuccino makers to consumers.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking model number 40714 printed on the bottom of the black plastic and stainless steel machine.

cards.product: Ashley "Trails End," "Cottage Retreat," and "Stages" bunk beds
cards.title: CPSC, Ashley Furniture Industries Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Bunk Beds
cards.hazard: There are gaps between parts of the bunk bed that violate federal safety standards and can be entrapment or strangulation hazards to children. For model B383, the gap between the end rails on the upp…
cards.remedy: Stop using the recalled bunk beds and get a free repair kit from the retailer to cover and close the entrapment gaps. Consumers can install…
cards.tell: Check the model number on product stickers located on the inside of the lower rail on the top bunk end panel or the inside of the lower panel on the bottom bunk.

cards.title: CPSC, Virgo Enterprises Announce Recall of Hair Dryers
cards.hazard: These hair dryers do not have an immersion protection device or ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) on the power cord, which poses a serious electrocution hazard if dropped in water. In 1991, a v…
cards.remedy: Stop using these hair dryers immediately and return the unit to the firm for a replacement unit that has an immersion protection device.
cards.tell: All units of the named models are recalled; check the label on the hair dryer for the model name and number, which also reads Virgo Professional and 110V/60HZ.

cards.title: CPSC, Kids II Announce Recall of Children's Mirror Books
cards.hazard: The mirror in the books can crack or break, posing a laceration hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Parents should take the product away from small children immediately and detach and mail the mirror page of the product to Kids II at 1015…
cards.tell: Check for the Kids II name on the back cover or Carter's on the front and back of the four named models.

cards.product: Trane and "American Standard" brand accessory electric heaters
cards.title: CPSC, American Standard Companies Announce Recall of Trane and American Standard Accessory Electric Heaters
cards.hazard: Overheating of the wiring in the accessory heater can lead to wall thermostat fires.
cards.remedy: Consumers who have not yet been contacted by independent dealers should immediately contact their installer to determine if they have a rec…
cards.tell: Recalled units have model number BAYHTR1415BRKAC and were manufactured between April 14, 2003 and February 6, 2004, located inside the air handler cabinet.

cards.title: CPSC, Shindaiwa Inc. Announce Recall of Hedge Trimmers
cards.hazard: The muffler's retaining bolts can allow the muffler to come loose from the engine while the hedge trimmer is in operation. A loose muffler can contact and damage the fuel tank, creating a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Stop using these hedge trimmers and return them to an authorized Shindaiwa dealer to have the muffler bolts replaced, free of charge.
cards.tell: All double-sided professional hedge trimmer models DH 231 and HT 231 with serial numbers up to 110000 are recalled. Serial numbers are on a nameplate on the engine cover.

cards.title: CPSC, Tek Nek Toys Announce Recall of Ride-On Toys
cards.hazard: The screw and nut assembly, attaching the steering wheel, can come loose, posing a choking and aspiration hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these recalled ride-on toy vehicles away from young children immediately and contact Tek Nek Toys for free replacemen…
cards.tell: All units have date codes from 20021127 to 20030319 located in the battery compartment on the top panel next to the steering wheel.

cards.title: CPSC, Mattel, Inc. Announce Recall of BATMAN™ BATMOBILE™ Toy Vehicle
cards.hazard: The rear tail wings of the Batmobile are made of rigid plastic and come to a point, which poses a potential puncture or laceration hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Parents should take these toys away from children immediately and contact the firm for information on receiving free replacement wings. Mat…
cards.tell: Check for model number B4944 written on the bottom of the blue and gray plastic toy vehicle.

cards.title: CPSC, Nikko America Announce Recall of Radio-Control Toy Trucks
cards.hazard: A problem with the circuit board causes the toy truck to overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the toy trucks and contact Nikko America for instructions on returning the product for a free circuit board rep…
cards.tell: Check the model number, vehicle make, and model names found on the body of the truck.

cards.title: CPSC, Ethan Allen Announce Recall of Bunk Beds
cards.hazard: A metal "j" hook on the guardrails can become dislodged, allowing the guardrail to slide or move out of position. This can allow the guardrail to detach from the bunk bed or allow the occupant to rol…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the top bunk if a "j" hook has become dislodged. Ethan Allen is directly notifying consumers who purchased thes…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled bunk beds by checking the item numbers located on the inside of the bottom bunk headboard or footboard.

cards.title: CPSC, Deere & Company Announce Recall of Compact Utility Tractors
cards.hazard: Some of the steel bolts used to secure Roll-Over Protective Structure (ROPS) to the tractor's real axle can shear off, decreasing the strength of the ROPS and its ability to protect the operator, in…
cards.remedy: The company is directly notifying purchasers. Consumers should stop using their tractors immediately and contact a John Deere dealer for a…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; check the model and serial number on the plate on the tractor's frame to see if it falls within the specified ranges.

cards.title: CPSC, H&M Announce Recall of Promotional Water Bottles
cards.hazard: The pull-up black plastic drinking spout can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Return the water bottle to any H&M store for a free $5 coupon towards another H&M purchase.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. These are black plastic water bottles in green canvas sports holders with H&M written on the bottle and strap.

cards.title: CPSC, Sauder Woodworking Co. Announce Recall of TV/VCR Carts that Can Tip Over Easily, after Baby's Death
cards.hazard: The carts can tip over and injure or kill children and adults when the cart and the television fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the TV/VCR carts immediately and do the following: Remove the television and all the contents from these carts.…
cards.tell: Recalled carts are models 2655 and 2755, measuring about 29.5 inches wide, 18 inches deep and 27 inches high with four removable casters. The model number appears on the instruction booklet.

cards.title: CPSC, Valley Dynamo Announce Recall of Air Hockey Tables
cards.hazard: The blower motor, located under the table, has an opening large enough for a child's finger, posing a laceration hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product and contact Dynamo for instructions on receiving a free repair kit.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled tables by the model names Arctic Flash, Arctic Wind, or Air Elegance printed on the play field or design features like wood-grain finish or overhead scoring display.

cards.title: CPSC, Pacific Cycle Inc. Announce Recall of Mongoose 20-Inch Mountain Bicycles
cards.hazard: The rear shock absorber allows the aluminum dual-suspension frame to flex severely, causing the frame to become unstable and break, posing the risk of injury to riders.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately and call Pacific Cycle Inc. to receive a free replacement rear shock and instruction…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled bicycles by the model number R1590WMET on the service sticker located on the bottom bracket tube near the pedals, and they have silver and red aluminum frames.

cards.title: CPSC, Kingfisher Publications Announce Recall of Children’s Easter Books
cards.hazard: A sponge "touch-and-feel" item inside the book can detach, or small pieces can be torn away, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these books away from young children immediately, and return the books to Kingfisher Publications PLC, Customer Servi…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The book has My Easter Basket Book printed on the cover and KINGFISHER on the spine and back cover.

cards.title: CPSC, Babies "R" Us and Playwell Announce Recall of Snail Push Toys
cards.hazard: The screw securing the toy handle to the push toy could detach, posing a choking hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the push toy away from small children immediately and return it to Babies "R" Us for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units of this toy are recalled; you can identify it by the yellow and blue tag stating Imaginarium Baby.

cards.product: High Intensity Discharge (HID) light fixtures with acrylic lenses and/or reflectors
cards.title: CPSC, Lithonia Lighting Announce Recall of Indoor HID Light Fixtures
cards.hazard: A component in the light fixture can leak fluid, which can degrade the acrylic lenses and reflectors, causing them to crack and fall. Falling pieces of acrylic can injure someone below the fixture.
cards.remedy: Building owners and managers with recalled fixtures should contact Lithonia to verify that the fixtures are included in the recall and arra…
cards.tell: Check the label on the ballast housing for the model, wattage, city, and date of manufacture from November 2002 through October 2003.

cards.product: Window air conditioners with electric heat
cards.title: CPSC, Fedders Corporation Announce Recall to Repair Window Air Conditioners with Electric Heat
cards.hazard: If the outside fan blade becomes blocked, when operating in the heating mode, this unit could present a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product. Do not donate or resell.
cards.tell: Locate the model and serial number on the cabinet near the bar code. Recalled units have specific model numbers and serial numbers beginning with designated two-letter codes.

cards.title: CPSC, Stanley Furniture Company Inc. Announce Recall of Cribs

cards.title: CPSC, Trisonic Announce Recall of Nightlights
cards.hazard: The nightlight poses a serious electrocution, electric shock, burn and fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should mail the night light to Trisonic/Eastern America Trio Products, 11-11 131st St., P.O. Box 527018, Flushing, NY 11352, for…

cards.title: CPSC, Creative Kids Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Art Supply Sets
cards.hazard: The sets contain mini-cutters with razor blades, which pose a laceration hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should remove the mini-cutters from the set and return them to Creative Kids to get a free pack of colored paper clips.

cards.title: CPSC, Babi Italia/LaJobi Industries Announce Recall to Replace "Tiffany" and "Josephine" Crib Drop-Side Rails

cards.title: CPSC, Conceptual Marketing & Development, Inc., Announce Recall of Weed Cutting Attachment Blades
cards.hazard: The blades can break off and hit consumers, causing severe impact and laceration injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled blades immediately and contact CMD for free replacements.

cards.hazard: When the flexible straw on the cups is chewed, small pieces of plastic can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.

cards.tell: All units are recalled; this covers all Starbucks Bearista Bear tumbler cups sold in blue and green.

cards.product: Central fire sprinklers with O-ring seals

cards.title: CPSC, The Step2 Company Announce Recall of Toy Drumsticks

cards.tell: Check for Ultra 155 and Ultra 230 gas boilers with a cast aluminum mono block heat exchanger and glossy silver/flat black jacket sold from December 2002 through February 2003.
