cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these table saws immediately, unplug them, and call Black & Decker to arrange for a free repair.
cards.tell: Check the name plate on the front panel above the power switch for model BT2500 and date codes 200128-CT through 200148-CT.

cards.title: CPSC, Black & Decker Announce Recall to Repair Cordless Drill/Drivers
cards.hazard: The drill's switch can malfunction and overheat, posing the possibility of a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using their drill/drivers immediately, remove the battery, and call Black & Decker to arrange for a free repair.
cards.tell: Locate the model number on the side nameplate and the date code on the bottom of the handle by removing the battery.

cards.title: CPSC, BCI Burke Announce Recall of Buckle Bridges on Series 2000 Playgrounds
cards.hazard: The platform edge, where the bridges are attached, can crack and the bridge could potentially detach from the platform and result in injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bridges immediately and call BCI Burke to receive a retrofit kit. BCI Burke sent notices to receive a free…
cards.tell: All Buckle Bridges on Series 2000 modular playgrounds are included in this recall.

cards.product: Arctic Cat ATVs with the following model names: 250, 300, 300 Massey Ferguson, 375, 400, 400i, 500, TBX 500 and 500i
cards.title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Inc. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
cards.hazard: The pressure switch in the braking system leaks fluid. The unexpected loss of fluid can cause the brakes to fail, posing the risk of serious injury or death.
cards.remedy: To determine if an ATV is part of this recall, consumers should contact Arctic Cat. Consumers should have their ATV's model name and number…
cards.tell: Recalled 2002 model ATVs are red or green with Arctic Cat on both sides. The model name is on the front just below the speedometer.

cards.product: Arctic Cat ATVs with the following model names: 250, 300, 300 Massey Ferguson, 375, 400, 400i, 500, TBX 500 and 500i
cards.title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Inc. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
cards.hazard: The ball joints on the front suspension of these ATVs can fail, resulting in a loss of control. This can cause the ATV to overturn, posing a risk of serious injury or death to riders.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ATVs immediately. Registered owners have been notified about this recall by mail. To determine if an ATV…
cards.tell: Recalled 2002 model ATVs are red or green with Arctic Cat on both sides. The model name is on the front just below the speedometer.

cards.title: CPSC and Shindaiwa Announce Recall of Hedge Trimmers Sold in California
cards.hazard: The catalytic muffler can overheat and damage the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these hedge trimmers immediately and contact their authorized Shindaiwa dealer for a free inspection and muffle…
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers printed on the nameplate on the engine cover to see if it falls within the recalled ranges.

cards.title: CPSC, Fluke Corp. Announce Recall of Digital Multimeters
cards.hazard: The recalled units can take longer than normal, up to 18 seconds, to display readings of AC voltages above 500 volts. Users can misinterpret the delayed reading to mean that high voltage is not prese…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these testers immediately and contact Fluke for information on returning the recalled unit for a free repair.
cards.tell: Recalled units have model 175, 177, or 179 and a serial number below 79000000 located on the back under the hinged stand.

cards.title: CPSC, Proctor-Silex Announce Recall of Steam Iron
cards.hazard: The circuit board inside the steam iron can ignite and present a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the iron immediately and call the company toll-free to arrange for a free replacement.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled iron by model number 17520 and series number located on the back side of the iron at the bottom.

cards.product: Marin-brand mountain bikes with aluminum frames
cards.title: CPSC, Marin Mountain Bikes Announce Recall of Mountain Bikes
cards.hazard: The steer tube on the front of these bicycles can break off from the two main tubes of the frame, causing the rider to lose control, fall and possibly suffer serious injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled bikes immediately and contact Marin Mountain Bikes to learn where to take their bikes to have the…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; only Marin aluminum-frame bikes with 11.5-inch or 13.5-inch frames, featuring model names written on the top tube.

cards.title: CPSC, Cavagna North America Inc., Announce Recall of Safety Relief Valves for Large Propane Tanks
cards.hazard: The recalled valves can have sharp internal edges that can cut into gasket seals in the valves, causing a propane gas leak. This poses a risk of fire or burn injuries.
cards.remedy: LP distributors, LP tank owners and propane gas users with recalled valves should immediately contact Cavagna to schedule an appointment, t…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled valves by model number 66-1031, writing that reads OMECA 66-1031, and year and batch codes 99.02, 99.10, 99.16, 99.27, or 99.28 stamped on the valve.

cards.product: Bicycle stems installed on 2002 and 2003 Cannondale bicycles
cards.title: CPSC, Cannondale Corp. Announce Recall of Bicycles With Defective Stems
cards.hazard: The stem can break away from the bicycle, causing a loss of control, falls and serious injury to riders.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding bicycles with these stems immediately and contact a local Cannondale retailer for a free repair.
cards.tell: The recalled stems are black with the model name 3T ZEPP XL printed in white on the sides and 3T on the front faceplate.

cards.title: CPSC, Bradford White Corporation, Announce Recall of Gas Water Heater
cards.hazard: The water heater may have been fitted with incorrectly made flue gas baffles. These baffles may affect fuel combustion, resulting in excessive carbon monoxide emissions, which can cause serious injur…
cards.remedy: Consumers who purchased one of these water heaters should immediately contact their installing contractor or call Bradford White Technical…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled water heaters by checking the model and serial numbers on the rating plate and shipping carton label.

cards.title: CPSC, Carrier Guam Announce Recall of Room Air Conditioners
cards.hazard: Salty sea spray can cause the electrical capacitor within these units to corrode, posing a possible fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers with one of these recalled air conditioners should call Carrier Guam, which will schedule a free inspection and repair visit. Alt…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the model number 77ZFA007101 and serial number ranges located on the top of the plastic evaporator scroll behind the front plastic grill.

cards.title: CPSC, Square D Company Announce Recall of Circuit Breakers
cards.hazard: The circuit breakers may have an incorrect torque load applied to the lug mounting screws. This could cause the clamping load between the lug and the circuit breaker terminals to be lower than specif…
cards.remedy: Contact Square D for a free repair. Repairs will consist of verifying proper screw torque and tightening all screws that do not meet the re…
cards.tell: All units manufactured between October 2000 and March 2002 are recalled.

cards.product: Motorola DCT2000 digital cable set-top boxes
cards.title: CPSC, Motorola Inc. Announce Recall of Digital Cable Set-Top Boxes
cards.hazard: Pins in the rear of the box, that connect to the power cord, could break, which could pose an electric shock hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers with these DCT2000 digital cable set-top boxes can continue to use them as normal, but they should not remove the power cord from…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; only Motorola DCT2000 digital cable set-top boxes distributed from March 2002 through June 2002 are included.

cards.title: CPSC, Briggs & Stratton Announce Recall of Engines Used on Fun Kart Type Go-Karts
cards.hazard: Fuel from the engine can spill out, if the fun-kart overturns, posing serious fire and burn hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the fun-karts immediately and contact a local Briggs & Stratton dealer for a free engine repair.
cards.tell: All 1352XX model series are included. For FunPower 1362XX, only engines built on or before June 22, 1995 with a 2 inch tall plastic fuel cap are recalled. Model and date codes are stamped on the engine.

cards.title: National Sporting Goods Announce Recall of Speed Skates
cards.hazard: The wheel and axle assemble may break off during skating, resulting in injury to the skater.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the skates immediately and return them to the nearest JCPenney catalog desk for a free replacement.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled skates by model numbers 809-0205 or 809-0256, coming in black or white with the word Bullet written on the side.

cards.product: Star Clacker wooden toys and Ride-On Duck wooden riding toys
cards.title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Kids Announce Recall of Wooden Clacker and Ride-On Toys
cards.hazard: The wooden peg can come off of the Star Clacker toy and pose a choking hazard. The Ride-On Duck's wheel cap can break, allowing the wheel to come off and release small parts, also presenting a chokin…
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled toys away from young children immediately and return the toys to the store where they were purchased, fo…
cards.tell: All units of the Star Clacker and Ride-On Duck toys are recalled. Star Clackers feature a gold Made in China label and white age label, and Ride-On Ducks have a gold Made in China label on the bottom.

cards.title: CPSC, Crate & Barrel Announce Recall to Repair Media Carts
cards.hazard: The media cart has metal and plastic casters that can break, causing a television or other objects on the cart to fall and injure consumers nearby.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled media carts immediately and call Crate & Barrel or contact the store from which the cart was purch…
cards.tell: All Elements Media Carts are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Adams Manufacturing Corp. Announce Recall of Folding Chair
cards.hazard: Some of the legs on these chairs were mis-assembled by the installer and a piece of the chair could be bent out of shape. This can allow the chair to collapse during use, causing consumers to suffer…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the folding chairs immediately and return them to the place where purchased to receive a replacement chair or a…
cards.tell: Check the item number and ensure the chair is white, green, or sandstone molded plastic with a label on the backrest reading Adams Quick Fold Chair.

cards.product: Grass Bag Attachments for MTD electric walk-behind lawn mowers
cards.title: CPSC, MTD Products Inc. Announce Recall of Grass Bags Used On Electric Lawn Mowers
cards.hazard: The lawn mowers have a rear-mounted grass bag that does not seal properly to the rear door of the mower, allowing grass and other debris to be thrown out at the top of the bag. This could result in i…
cards.remedy: Consumers who have the recalled lawn mowers should remove and dispose of the old grass bag and contact MTD to receive a free replacement ba…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled grass bags by checking the model number 18A-407-000 for the red body or 18A-407-062 for the green body on the label of the mower's rear discharge door.

cards.title: CPSC, Excel Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Riding Lawn Mowers
cards.hazard: Excessive heat, vibrations and wear causes the fuel line to droop over time and rub against the transmission fan, causing the fuel line to be cut. This poses a fire hazard and a risk of burn injuries…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these recalled riding mowers immediately and contact their local Hustler dealer to determine if their mower is…
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers on the identification plate located on the left side of the frame in front of the fuel tank, below the operator's platform.

cards.product: Sears Craftsman, Husqvarna and Poulan Pro garden tractors
cards.title: CPSC, Electrolux Home Products, Inc. Announce Recall of Garden Tractors
cards.hazard: Under certain operating conditions, the rear wheel hub may crack or wear and spin free on its axle, resulting in a loss of power to the wheel and brake, which poses the risk of injury to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers who have purchased one of these garden tractors (within the affected date code range) are asked to stop using the tractor immedia…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the brand, model number, and serial date codes ranging from 011501 to 092101 located on the product.

cards.product: Greenlee CM-700 and CM-750 electrical meters
cards.title: CPSC, Greenlee Textron Inc. Announce Recall of Electrical Testing Meters
cards.hazard: An incompatible grommet, located in the battery compartment to protect internal wires, can cause the meter to provide inaccurate voltage and current readings. A meter that inaccurately indicates zero…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled meters immediately and contact Greenlee to receive a replacement meter.
cards.tell: Check the model on the front and the serial number on the silver plate on the back; recalled meters have serial numbers from 0203540001 through 0203540650.

cards.title: CPSC, STK International Announce Recall of Extension Cords
cards.hazard: The cords have undersized wires, presenting a shock hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using and unplug these extension cords immediately and return them to STK International for a refund, including posta…
cards.tell: Check the model number printed in the upper right corner of the packaging (EC-221 for white, EC-222 for brown) and look for YWC-981 8 CHINA E157848 printed on the cord.

cards.title: CPSC, Remington Products Co., LLC Re-Announce Recall of Hairdryers Firm Offering Free Upgraded Replacement Hairdryer
cards.hazard: These hairdryers are not equipped with an appliance leakage current interrupter (ALCI) plug to cut off electrical current in case of contact with water. If dropped in water, the hairdryers pose an el…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the hairdryers immediately. Owners of the recalled hair dryers will be sent a postage-paid shipping container t…
cards.tell: All units of this model are recalled. The model name and number are printed on the sides of the air intake grill.

cards.title: CPSC, Small World Toys Announce Recall of Sorter Toys
cards.hazard: The plastic windows on the "see-inside" sorting blocks can break, causing the beads inside to be released. This presents a choking hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled shape sorters away from children immediately and return the toys to the store where purchased, for a ref…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The words Ryan's Room are printed on one side of the sorter box.

cards.title: CPSC, Radio Flyer Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Steering Wheel on Toy Car
cards.hazard: A child can pull the horn from the steering wheel, and a small part inside poses a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these Roadsters from young children immediately and contact Redwagons to order a replacement steering wheel.
cards.tell: Recalled units have a date of manufacture of 12/2001 or earlier, a horn symbol on the red rubber horn, and the label on the bottom shows MD followed by the date code.

cards.product: Toddler Tote™ toddler activity sets and "Familiar Things" toddler puzzles
cards.title: CPSC, Lauri® Inc. Announce Recall of Toddler Activity Sets and Puzzles
cards.hazard: The dog puzzle included with both of these products and the rubber handle on the box of the activity set can tear apart into small pieces and pose a choking hazard to small children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these toys away from children immediately and call Lauri for free replacement pieces.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The Toddler Tote has a blue box with model LR-2116, and Familiar Things has a purple box with model LR-2113.

cards.title: CPSC, BRIO® Corporation and Small World Toys Announce Recall of Snail Pull Toy
cards.hazard: The eyes on the pull toy can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these pull toys away from children immediately and call BRIO® for a refund. Consumers should return the recalled pull…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the toy by its bright green, yellow and red wooden design with the Plan Toys logo and 'Made in Thailand' stamped on the bottom of the head.

cards.product: Novelty cigarette lighters in the shape of "Coca Cola" and "Budweiser" beverage cans
cards.title: CPSC, Young's J.K. Inc. Announce Recall of Novelty Lighters
cards.hazard: These lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, posing fire and burn hazards.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
cards.tell: All units of these novelty beverage can lighters are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Yamaha Motor Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall to Inspect and Repair ATVs
cards.hazard: A mounting-bracket weld on the rear hub can come loose, resulting in rear brake failure and possible injury to operators.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ATVs immediately and call their local Yamaha ATV dealer to schedule a free appointment to have their unit…
cards.tell: Check the model year, the 350 Electric label, and the VIN stamped into the vehicle frame between the front and rear wheels.

cards.title: CPSC, Cane Creek Announce Recall of Bicycle Suspension Seat Posts
cards.hazard: The seat post's cradle, which attaches to the bicycle seat, can break, posing the risk of falls and serious injury to riders.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these seat posts immediately and return them to the company for a free repair.
cards.tell: All units with serial numbers between 10894 and 18710 are recalled, found inside the seat post tube toward the bottom.

cards.title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Announce Recall of Red Devil Gas Grills Sold at Wal-Mart
cards.hazard: The product's design allows consumers to light the grill at an air intake tube, instead of at the burner. Though the grill appears to function normally, gas inside the air intake tube ignites. The tu…
cards.remedy: CPSC urges consumers to stop using these grills immediately. Consumers who purchased Red Devil gas grills from Wal-Mart can return them to…
cards.tell: This recall only includes Red Devil gas grills sold at Wal-Mart.

cards.product: Flat Rock Grill Shoreline Series Models 2000 and 3000
cards.title: CPSC, Flat Rock Grill Co. Announce Recall of Gas Grills
cards.hazard: The glass casing of the thermometer displays attached to these grills can break or shatter, posing a risk of cuts or other serious injuries to consumers.
cards.remedy: The firm is no longer in business and the recall remedy is no longer available. Discard this product. Do not donate or resell.
cards.tell: The model number is on a label on the front of the grill and includes thermometers with BBQ-1 or BBQ Pit written within the glass casing.

cards.product: SCUBAPRO/UWATEC™ dive computer consoles with U-Line™ submersible pressure gauges
cards.title: CPSC, Johnson Outdoors Inc. Announce Recall of SCUBAPRO/UWATEC™ Dive Computer Consoles
cards.hazard: The U-Line™ submersible pressure gauge that is part of the dive consoles can malfunction and display inaccurate pressure readings. Divers using the consoles could fail to decompress properly during a…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled consoles immediately and contact SCUBAPRO/UWATEC. Consumers should send the console to SCUBAPRO/UW…
cards.tell: You can identify a recalled unit by checking for the UWATEC brand name on the front of the gray console and one of the specific test codes on the back of the gauge.

cards.title: CPSC, Jakks Pacific Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Certain Cans of "Smatter" Spray Foam
cards.hazard: If the pressurized can is left in a hot automobile, it can forcefully break apart and cause injury to a nearby consumer.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the recalled "Smatter" away from children and contact Jakks Pacific, Inc. for information on receiving a…
cards.tell: Check the date codes 0492PT to 0952PT stamped on the bottom of the can.

cards.title: CPSC, Hilton Hotels Corporation Announce Recall of Vacation Station™ Children's Cooler/Chairs
cards.hazard: When the chair collapses, the folding mechanism can pose a crushing, cutting or severing hazard to consumers' fingers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled cooler/chairs immediately and contact Hilton Hotels for information on returning the cooler/chairs…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The chairs have either a purple aluminum frame with a purple fabric seat and green cooler bag, or a green aluminum frame with a green fabric seat and a blue cooler bag, with Vacation Station prin…

cards.title: CPSC, Aroma Housewares Co. Announce Another Recall of Juicers
cards.hazard: The juicer's filter and lid can break apart and project metal and plastic into the air, causing injuries to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled juice extractors immediately, and call the company for information on receiving a refund. Even if…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. ACJ-250 and MADE IN CHINA are written on the bottom of the juicer on a silver label.

cards.product: Royal Colonial Vinyl Deck Post Kits
cards.title: CPSC and Royal Outdoor Products Announce Recall of Colonial Vinyl Deck Post Kits
cards.hazard: Cracks can develop near the base of the posts. This can allow the railing to collapse, potentially injuring people on the deck.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the product immediately and contact Royal Outdoor Products to receive a free reinforcement kit.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the post by a label with the words Royal Outdoor Products and R008-45-136 affixed to the bottom of each post.

cards.title: CPSC, The Coleman Company Announce Recall of Mosquito Traps
cards.hazard: The mosquito trap's propane regulator can leak propane or allow an overflow of propane gas, both of which pose a fire hazard to consumers. In addition, the fuel hose attachment sold with the Back Hom…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the mosquito traps and propane hoses immediately. Consumers should contact Coleman, so that a representative ca…
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled trap by model numbers 2950-800 or 2950-801 located on a label on the front of the trap above the warning.

cards.title: CPSC, Dynacraft Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Sold at Target
cards.hazard: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall, and suffer serious injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately and contact Dynacraft Industries for information on receiving a free replacement for…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled bicycles by checking the model number 8524-21 on a label on the frame near the crank housing.

cards.title: CPSC, Dollar Tree Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Drip Pans
cards.hazard: These drip pans are used under the burners of kitchen ranges to catch food that drips while cooking. The hot burners can ignite the drip pans and pose a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the drip pans immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled drip pans by SKU number 845289 located on the pan or on a cardboard insert in the package, and their black color.

cards.title: CPSC, Snapper, Inc. Recall Lawn Mowers
cards.hazard: The walk-behind lawn mowers' side discharge deflector, which is sold as an accessory for these models, is defective. The material used to manufacture the side discharge deflector is not strong enough…
cards.remedy: Consumers who have removed the bag and attached the side discharge deflector should stop using these walk-behind lawn mowers with the defle…
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the model number 216751BV, P2167517BV, or FRP 216751BV located on a white label attached to the top of the lawn mower.

cards.product: Combination washer and gas dryer units
cards.title: CPSC, Whirlpool Announce Recall of Washer and Gas Dryer Units
cards.hazard: The gas dryer can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these washer and gas dryer units and unplug them immediately. Do not attempt to shut off the gas supply.
cards.tell: Check the model number, brand, and serial number located behind the dryer door at the top of the opening to see if it matches the recalled specifications.

cards.title: CPSC, PM International Ltd. Announce Recall to Replace International Adapter Plugs
cards.hazard: The adapter plug can separate when the plug is removed, exposing live electrical conductors, posing an electric shock or electrocution hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these adapters and contact the store or catalog where purchased to receive a free replacement adapt…
cards.tell: You can tell by the white matte plastic finish and the marking 6A250V molded on the bottom surface between the prongs. Only individually sold plugs are included.

cards.title: CPSC, L.A. Lighter Inc. Announce Recall of Disposable Cigarette Lighters
cards.hazard: The lighters may have child-resistant mechanisms that do not meet federal safety standards. Young children may be able to operate these lighters, which could pose a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and contact L.A. Lighter to receive a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are metal, resemble a pencil across a protractor and triangle, have a ruler on the side, and a label with UPC 7 63052 20108 5.

cards.product: Enduralume® and Low Profile Enduralume® Luminaires
cards.title: CPSC, Holophane Announce Recall of Luminaire Optical Assemblies
cards.hazard: The glass portion of the luminaire optical assembly may crack, presenting a laceration hazard.
cards.remedy: All distributors and customers who received these optical assemblies have been notified to stop using these products and have been sent rep…
cards.tell: The recall involves optical assemblies with a glass refractor and an aluminum reflector used in Enduralume and Low Profile Enduralume luminaires sold from January 2002 through February 2002.

cards.title: Bath & Body Works Recall of Ice Shaver
cards.hazard: The stainless steel blade on the shaver can cut consumers and cause injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ice shavers immediately and return them to any Bath & Body Works store for a full refund or store credit.
cards.tell: All units of this Art Stuff ice shaver are recalled. You can identify it by the orange and blue body, palm tree design, and Bath and Body Works Art Stuff on the front.

cards.title: CPSC, In-Sink-Erator Announce Recall to Repair Instant Hot Water Dispensers
cards.hazard: Water can leak from the metal holding tank, wet insulating material and cause electrical arcing and heat build-up. This poses a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should unplug their hot water dispensers immediately, check the serial number and contact In-Sink-Erator, if their unit is part o…
cards.tell: Check the specification plate on the metal holding tank for serial numbers 999-10 or those between 1000 and 3084000.

cards.product: MSR White Premium Blend Stove Fuel
cards.title: CPSC, Mountain Safety Research Announce Recall of Stove Fuel
cards.hazard: Corrosion can cause the can to leak fuel, posing a fire or injury hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should check their stove fuel cans for leaks immediately. If the can is leaking, consumers should move it to a location free of i…
cards.tell: Check the lower front of the red metal can for batch number 2003-2.

cards.title: CPSC, Hammacher Schlemmer & Co. Announce Recall of Lighters
cards.hazard: The lighters were imported into this country without first being tested to ensure they comply with the Consumer Product Safety Commission's requirements that the lighters be child-resistant. Child-re…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately. Consumers should dispose of the lighter in a manner that is in compliance with any…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They have a brushed chrome finish, a black rubber slide lever with Rowenta embossed, and measure seven inches long.

cards.title: CPSC, Candle-lite Announce Recall of Martha Stewart Everyday™ Brand Potpourri Simmering Pots Sold at Kmart
cards.hazard: Flames from the tea light candles inside these potpourri pots can flare out of the side ventilation holes, possibly causing burns to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the pots and call Candle-lite for information on receiving a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are six-sided, white ceramic, three-piece units measuring about 6 inches high with a label on the bottom of the base reading MADE IN CHINA.

cards.product: The Motion Picture series electrical paintings
cards.title: CPSC, UL United Inc. Announce Recall of Electrical Paintings
cards.hazard: The electrical paintings can short circuit, posing a shock or fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately unplug and stop using these paintings and contact UL United for a full refund, including shipping costs.
cards.tell: All units of The Motion Picture series electrical paintings are included in this recall.

cards.product: Next Ultra Shock mountain bicycles with "Ballistic 105" front suspension forks
cards.title: CPSC, BY US International Co. Announce Recall of "NEXT" Ultra Shock Bicycles Sold at Wal-Mart
cards.hazard: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall and suffer serious injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately and call Dynacraft Industries for information on receiving a free replacement fork a…
cards.tell: Recalled bikes are blue with model numbers 8524-14 or 8526-20 and manufactured between April 1999 and November 9, 1999, identified by a label on the frame near the crank housing.

cards.title: CPSC, Radio Flyer Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Ride-On Push Cars
cards.hazard: A child can pull the horn off the car's steering wheel, and a small part inside poses a choking hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the recalled cars away from young children immediately and contact Radio Flyer Inc., to receive a replacement steerin…
cards.tell: Recalled push cars have a red plastic horn on the steering wheel, whereas cars without horns are not included.

cards.title: CPSC, Brinkmann Announce Recall of Outdoor Tabletop Propane Heaters
cards.hazard: The heaters can emit high levels of carbon monoxide (CO), which poses a risk of CO poisoning to consumers.
cards.remedy: The firm is no longer in business and the recall remedy is no longer available. Discard this product. Do not donate or resell.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled heater by the label on the base that reads Brinkmann Outdoor Tabletop Heater and model number 883-1000-0.

cards.title: CPSC, Specialty Sales Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Novelty Cigarette Lighters
cards.hazard: These lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, posing fire and burn hazards.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They feature specific decals including a frog with a banjo, man in the moon, Tweety Bird, unicorn, skull and crossbones, or a molded dolphin.

cards.title: CPSC, Little Tikes Announce Recall of Pop 'n Scoot Ride-on Toys
cards.hazard: Young children who lean forward can fall forward over the handlebars, causing facial injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the toys immediately and contact Little Tikes, to receive a Little Tikes replacement product.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the toy by checking the model number 1568-01 molded on the bottom of the storage area and identification number 32922XX 1 on the underside of the body.

cards.product: Toy tracks attached to children's activity centers
cards.title: CPSC and Graco Announce Recall of Toy Track on Activity Centers
cards.hazard: The toy track can break, presenting a cut or pinch hazard, and exposed small parts pose a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these activity centers with toy tracks immediately, and contact Graco, to receive a free replacement track.
cards.tell: Check the model number and made in U.S.A. printed on a label on the underside of the tray.

cards.title: CPSC, Brookdale International Systems Inc. Announce Recall of Emergency Escape Smoke Hoods
cards.hazard: The smoke hood is a one-time emergency use personal safety device, that provides quick temporary protection from smoke in the event of a fire. In some instances, consumers purchased the smoke hoods f…
cards.remedy: Consumers who purchased the EVAC-U8 emergency escape smoke hood for protection from tear gas and chemical warfare agents may return the pro…
cards.tell: Recalled units have a serial number of A97,921 or higher, and an expiration date of May 1, 2002 or later printed on the cylinder.

cards.product: NiMh battery packs used with certain Megatech radio-controlled airplanes
cards.title: CPSC, Megatech Announce Recall of Rechargeable Battery Packs for Radio Controlled Airplanes
cards.hazard: The internal battery cell connections may slip and result in arcing and overheating, posing a fire or thermal burn hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these batteries immediately and contact Megatech for information on obtaining a replacement power supply.
cards.tell: All NiMh battery packs included with Skyliner model radio-controlled airplanes and those sold separately are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Island Soap & Candle Works Announce Recall of Candles
cards.hazard: Pieces of the candles' wick can fall off while burning and the wick can re-ignite after extinguishing, posing a burn and fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the candles immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a full refund. The candles also can b…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They feature a single wick in wax inside a brown coconut shell with a label on the bottom and optional moon and star cutouts.

cards.title: CPSC, Luxo Corp. Announce Recall of Portable Fluorescent Lamps
cards.hazard: The ballast (the electrical part located in the arm of the lamp) in these lamps can overheat, short-circuit, and melt the insulating cover of the ballast, causing the lamp to fail and posing a skin b…
cards.remedy: Consumers with the recalled units should unplug the lamps and stop using them immediately. Contact Luxo to return the lamp and receive a re…
cards.tell: Check for model numbers PS355 or PS360 and serial numbers between 198076 and 244871 or between 35500001 and 36003256 on a silver label on the back of the light bulb cover.

cards.title: CPSC, Southern Wood Products Announce Recall of Children's Toy Box
cards.hazard: The middle lid support hinge can collapse suddenly and cause an injury to a child's head, neck, fingers, or hands; or can become an entrapment hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers who purchased the toy box should stop using the toy box immediately and contact Southern Wood Products to receive a free replacem…
cards.tell: Check the sticker on the back or bottom of the unit for the manufacture date code 8502-021502A or 8502-030702A.

cards.title: CPSC, Lands' End, Inc. Announce Recall of Soft Farm Set
cards.hazard: The legs of the chicken and duck figures may detach, posing a risk of choking.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the toy immediately and either remove the legs from the chicken and duck figures or contact Lands' End to recei…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. This includes the polyester/cotton barn with farm animals and accessories.

cards.title: CPSC, D.A.M. Clothing, Inc., Announce Recall of Basic Editions 2-Piece Toddler Girls' Short Set
cards.hazard: The buttons on the garment are sewn on too loosely, creating a danger of them falling off or being easily pulled off, which poses a potential choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these garments immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled short set by style number 7071 located on a hang-tag attached to the right armpit of the garment.

cards.title: CPSC, The Sportsman's Guide Announce Recall of the Big Red Wagon
cards.hazard: The Big Red Wagon has four rubber wheels that include plastic rims that may break and explode under pressure, when being inflated. Parts of the wheel and the tire can strike and injure anyone nearby.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the Big Red Wagon immediately and contact The Sportsman's Guide to receive free replacement wheels and a $10 co…
cards.tell: All units with model number 54774 are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Spin Master Toys Announce Recall of Firestormer and Skyblazer Toy Planes
cards.hazard: The plastic air intake chamber of the air-powered toy planes can burst, throwing plastic pieces, posing a laceration, bruise and abrasion hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the planes immediately and contact Spin Master Toys, to receive a free replacement plane.
cards.tell: Look for date codes 12/29/01-KS through 03/24/02-KS on the bottom of the hand pump.

cards.title: CPSC Issues Warning About Hazardous Red Devil Gas Grills
cards.hazard: The product's design allows consumers to light the grill at an air intake tube, instead of at the burner. Though the grill appears to function normally, gas inside the air intake tube ignites. The tu…
cards.remedy: Both the Home Shopping Network (HSN) and QVC voluntarily notified their customers directly about the hazard these grills pose, and provided…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are red metal gas grills with a tripod stand and a logo on the lid and grill base showing a devil cooking with the writing Red Devil.

cards.title: CPSC, Rose Art Industries Announce Recall to Repair Cotton Candy Machine
cards.hazard: The motors on the cotton candy machines can jam and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Additionally, the heating unit can be activated without the spinner in place, presenting a risk of burn to consumer…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these cotton candy machines immediately and contact Rose Art for a free replacement motor unit, and free sample…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The machines have a blue or purple base, a clear plastic cover, and the words The Real Cotton Candy Machine printed on the base.

cards.product: Toy steering wheel attachment sold on Kolcraft's Jeep® Cherokee stroller
cards.title: CPSC, Kolcraft Announce Recall of Toy Steering Wheels Sold on Strollers
cards.hazard: The steering wheel can break away from its base, allowing the small plastic turn signal and horn pieces to come off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should remove the toy steering wheel on these strollers and contact Kolcraft to receive a free replacement toy steering wheel.
cards.tell: Check the model number 55120 and manufacture date between January 2001 and February 2001 on the sticker located on one of the rear legs of the stroller.

cards.title: CPSC, Aqua-Leisure Industries Inc. Remind Consumers about Recall of Inflatable Baby Floats
cards.hazard: The leg holes in the seat of the float can tear, causing children to unexpectedly fall into the water and, possibly, drown.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these recalled floats immediately and contact Aqua-Leisure for a free replacement.
cards.tell: Recalled floats have the lettering "C/S" molded on the valve.

cards.product: Safety 1st and Beatrix Potter "Designer 22" infant car seats/carriers
cards.title: CPSC, NHTSA, and Dorel Juvenile Group Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Infant Car Seats/Carriers
cards.hazard: When the seat is used as a carrier, the plastic handle can unexpectedly release from the carrying position. When this happens, an unrestrained infant can fall to the ground and suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers can continue to use the "Designer 22" as a car seat but should stop using it as a carrier immediately and contact Dorel Juvenile…
cards.tell: Check the model number and manufacture date on the instruction and warning label on the side of the car seat/carrier.

cards.title: CPSC, QVC, Inc., Announce Recall of Red Devil Gas Grills
cards.hazard: The product's design allows consumers to light the grill at an air intake tube, instead of at the burner. When the grill is lit at the air intake tube, it will appear to function normally, though gas…
cards.remedy: Consumers who purchased one of these grills from QVC should stop using them immediately and call QVC Customer Service. Consumers who purcha…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are red metal gas grills with a tripod stand and a logo on the lid and base showing a devil cooking.

cards.title: CPSC, Seismic Safety Products Inc. Announce Recall of Gas Shut-Off Valves
cards.hazard: These gas valves could stick in the open position, allowing gas to flow freely, which poses a risk of serious injury to consumers, from fire and explosion during an earthquake.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact Seismic Safety Products immediately to have their shut-off valve replaced free of charge.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled valves by the white reset knob reading Northridge 2000 Valve and a white label on the back with models M75 or M100.

cards.title: CPSC, Philips Electronics Announce Recall of Speaker Power Adapters Sold with HP Computers
cards.hazard: The speaker power adapter's power cord connector is not grounded, posing a potential shock hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should unplug the T-junction plug immediately and stop using the speakers. Consumers should contact Philips Electronics for a fre…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled adapter by the white label on the power adapter with Model D12-1-A-950 and Made in China printed on it.

cards.product: Total Gym® 1000 and the Total Gym® Pro model exercise machines
cards.title: CPSC, Fitness Quest Inc. Announce Recall of "Total Gym" Exercise Machines
cards.hazard: The handles on these exercise machines can detach during use and the cable attached to the handles can break, resulting in injury to the user.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these exercisers immediately and contact Fitness Quest to order a free repair kit.
cards.tell: Check the underside of the glide board for serial numbers DK000001 through DK129350, prefixes XO or SM, or no serial number at all.

cards.title: CPSC, E-filliate Inc. Announce Recall of Extension Cords
cards.hazard: The cords have reversed polarity, which can present electric shock and electrocution hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should unplug the cords immediately and call E-filliate to receive a prepaid shipping label, to return the cord and to select a f…
cards.tell: Recalled cords have MSL imprinted on the three-pronged plug and lack a yellow QC label wrapped around the cord.

cards.title: CPSC, Milwaukee Tool Corp. Announce Recall of Automotive Chargers
cards.hazard: The automotive chargers are often used on job sites to charge power tool batteries. When used under low voltage conditions, the chargers can overheat. This poses a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the chargers immediately and return them to their nearest Milwaukee factory service center or authorized power…
cards.tell: Check the catalog number on the nameplate on the back of the charger or the serial number on the side of the impact wrench kit.

cards.title: CPSC, Ryobi Technologies, Inc. Announce Recall of Hammer Drills
cards.hazard: The on-off trigger can stick, or the lock-on button can jam, posing a risk of physical injury to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the hammer drills immediately and return them to the place where purchased to receive a full refund.
cards.tell: Check the side of the drill for the RYOBI brand and model number HD501.

cards.title: CPSC, Rocky Mountain Bicycles Announce Recall of Mountain Bicycles
cards.hazard: The chainstay that holds the rear wheel in place can fail, causing the rear wheel to separate from the bicycle. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bicycles immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a free repair.
cards.tell: Recalled are 16.5-, 18- and 19-inch Slayer and Edge full-suspension mountain bicycles without the letter S stamped on the chainstay yoke.

cards.title: CPSC, Baseline Design Announce Recall of Bean Bag Chairs
cards.hazard: The bean bags contain small polystyrene beads that present suffocation and strangulation hazards to young children who may inhale the small beads. The recalled bean bag chairs have zippers that were…
cards.remedy: Consumers should inspect their bean bag chairs. If the zippers can be opened freely, Baseline Design will provide owners with a free replac…
cards.tell: All units are recalled, featuring 12-inch double zippers in smiley face, football, baseball, basketball motifs, and solid neon green, yellow, pink, and blue colors.

cards.title: CPSC, Astra International and Consumers Union Announce Recall of Glove Compartment Organizer
cards.hazard: The flashlight can overheat when the batteries are inserted, presenting a possible burn hazard. Also, the tire gauge does not produce accurate measurements when used.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact Consumers Union immediately for further information. Those who return the kit to Consumers Union or show they've d…
cards.tell: All units of this glove compartment organizer kit are included in the recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Total Gym Fitness LLC Announce Recall of Exercise Equipment Sold by TV Infomercials
cards.hazard: A lever pin that supports the elevated railing of the glideboard could fail, causing the user to fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the exerciser immediately and call Total Gym Fitness for a free safety bracket. Purchasers were sent direct mai…
cards.tell: All Total Gym XL exercisers are included in this recall, which are black and chrome and have Total Gym XL written on the glideboard.

cards.title: CPSC, Eugenio Serafin Inc. Announce Recall of Electric Showerhead Hot Water Heaters Sold in Puerto Rico
cards.hazard: The nozzle can be easily unscrewed, exposing the uninsulated heater coil. The heater coil's grounding screw does not sufficiently reduce the current through the water, posing an electrocution and sho…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these showerhead hot water heaters immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units sold under the Corona, Corona Maxi, and Fammy names in clear plastic bags with a card reading ducha and manufactured in Venezuela are recalled.

cards.product: Club Car DS Golf Cars and Utility Vehicles
cards.title: CPSC, Club Car, Inc. Announce Recall of Golf Cars
cards.hazard: The fuel tank may leak, posing a potential fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled vehicles immediately and inspect the tank and storage areas for any sign of leakage prior to use.…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled vehicles by serial numbers 0229-169750 through 0236-197543, located on a decal just above and to the right of the accelerator pedal.

cards.title: CPSC and Sears Announce Recall of Riding Lawn Mower
cards.hazard: Under certain operating conditions, the vehicle's transmission may fail, causing a loss of drive and brake ability. Should this occur, the potential for personal injury and/or property damage exists.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using their riding lawn mowers immediately and contact Sears to schedule an appointment to have a free new transmissi…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled mower by model number 247.270250 located on the model plate under the seat, and Craftsman Lawn Utility Vehicle written on the side.

cards.title: CPSC, Best Lock Corp. Announce Recall of Electronic Door Locks
cards.hazard: In an extreme fire situation, it is possible for the electronic wires and mounting holes to become exposed, posing a fire hazard risk. There is no danger of latch failure, nor will this prevent norma…
cards.remedy: Customers will be contacted directly by Best Access Systems to receive a replacement product. Products installed in non-fire rated applicat…
cards.tell: All IDH Max and B.A.S.I.S. cylindrical and mortise electronic door lock products are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, ECR International Announce Recall to Repair of Gas Boilers
cards.hazard: The burners on these boilers could produce excess carbon monoxide (CO) in the flue, due to improper combustion, posing a risk of CO poisoning to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact ECR International immediately to arrange for a free repair. CPSC recommends that every home should have at least o…
cards.tell: Check the brand name on the front and the model and serial numbers on the data plate on the right side of the boiler to see if they match the recalled ranges.

cards.title: CPSC, Prestige Toy Corp. Announce Recall of Duckie Ring Rattle/Teethers
cards.hazard: The rattle may break, causing small beads to fall out, which presents a potential choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the rattles away from children and return them to the company to receive a replacement toy or refund. Con…
cards.tell: Check for model numbers 4576, 44576, and 84576 printed on the sewn-on label.

cards.title: CPSC, Sherwood SCUBA LLC Announce Recall of Maximus Regulators
cards.hazard: The second stage orifices on these regulators can be cracked, bent or broken. This can result in a loss of breathing air underwater.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled regulators immediately, and contact their nearest authorized Sherwood retailer, for a free repair.
cards.tell: Check the model number and serial number laser marked on the top of the second stage case next to the mouthpiece.

cards.title: CPSC, Vermont Precision Woodworks Announce Recall of Cribs
cards.hazard: The slats on the cribs can loosen and detach from the drop side rail, creating a large opening between the slats, where a child's head or neck could become entrapped, resulting in serious injury or d…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these recalled cribs until the repair has been performed. Vermont Precision Woodworks is providing…
cards.tell: Check the label on the bottom of the crib for the Vermont Precision Woodworks name, manufacturing date, and model name.

cards.title: CPSC, Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
cards.hazard: The rear seatstays, the tube behind the seat that connects the rear axle to the rear shock, can break, possibly causing the rider to lose control and crash.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately, and return them to their local Specialized dealer for a new rear seatstay, which w…
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled bicycle by the model name on the top tube and brand name on the down tube, available in silver, black, yellow, and blue for model year 2002.

cards.title: CPSC, InSTEP LLC Announce Recall of Trailer Bikes
cards.hazard: The bike's universal joint system can fail, causing a rider to lose control of the bike. This poses a risk of injury to either of the two riders.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these trailer bikes immediately and contact InSTEP for a free repair kit with instructions.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Look for model NH300 and the words HITCHHIKER III printed in red on the trailer arm.

cards.title: CPSC, Coast Energy Management Announce Recall of Power Saving Devices
cards.hazard: The Power Planner is a device connected between motorized appliances and wall outlets that is intended to save electricity. These Power Planners have reversed polarity, posing a shock hazard to consu…
cards.remedy: Consumers should unplug these devices immediately. Coast Energy Management is out of business, and a remedy is no longer available. Do not…
cards.tell: Check the model number SP010-N or SP010-NV on the green and silver label on the left side, and lot numbers 6/2-01, 10/2-01, 25/2-01, 28/5-01, 20/6-01 or no lot number on the back label.

cards.title: CPSC, Horizon Fitness Announce Recall of Treadmills
cards.hazard: A component of the electronic control panel can malfunction, causing the motor and walking belt to rapidly accelerate and the user can lose balance and fall.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these treadmills immediately and contact Horizon Fitness to receive a repair kit and to set up an appointment t…
cards.tell: Recalled units are model year 2000/2001 Paragon, Quantum, and Omega treadmills, while 2002 models like Omega II, Quantum II, Paragon II, and Alpine are excluded.

cards.product: Glade® Extra Outlet Scented Oil Air Fresheners
cards.title: CPSC, SC Johnson Announce Recall of Glade® Extra Outlet Scented Oil Air Fresheners
cards.hazard: These Extra Outlet PlugIns® may have been misassembled during manufacture, which could pose a risk of fire.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately unplug the air fresheners and contact SC Johnson for free, full value replacement coupons or a refund.
cards.tell: Check the back of the unit for model number SCJ079 and a yellow disk on the back of the rotating plug-thru outlet.

cards.product: Harry Potter Magic Potion Bottle key chains
cards.title: CPSC, Hallmark Announce Recall of Harry Potter Key Chains
cards.hazard: The key chains can leak petroleum distillates, which can pose an ingestion hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the key chains away from children immediately and contact Hallmark for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The 3-inch tall key chain features a potion bottle filled with purple mineral oil and red water, a green base, a gold top, and 'HP' printed on the bottle.

cards.product: GL-X200™ Estes Air™ Powered Rocket Systems
cards.title: CPSC, Estes Industries Announce Recall of Air Powered Rockets
cards.hazard: The rockets' foam tips can break off, exposing sharp edges that can cause face lacerations or eye injuries to consumers. The rocket systems also have weak pump handles that can break during use, posi…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the air rockets immediately and contact Estes Industries for information on how to get a replacement rocket.
cards.tell: Recalled pumps lack the warning label that reads WARNING: Stay away from rocket when pumping and launching on the unit.

cards.product: Mongoose and Roadmaster mountain bicycles with Ballistic 105 front suspension forks
cards.title: CPSC, Brunswick Corp. Announce Another Expanded Recall of Mongoose and Roadmaster Mountain Bicycles
cards.hazard: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall and suffer serious injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these bicycles and call the firm to obtain information on receiving a $65 refund for the bicycle fo…
cards.tell: All Ballistic model 105 forks sold on Mongoose and Roadmaster mountain bicycles manufactured by Brunswick (except Mongoose A40) are included. The black forks have BALLISTIC and 105 decals on the legs.

cards.title: CPSC, Ames True Temper Announce Recall of Wheelbarrows
cards.hazard: The plastic wheel assemblies on these wheelbarrows, manufactured by a predecessor company, can break when being inflated with high-pressure air hoses. This can result in plastic pieces exploding from…
cards.remedy: Consumers should not inflate the tires on these wheelbarrows. Consumers should contact Ames True Temper to receive a free replacement steel…
cards.tell: All units with a black plastic rim on the wheel assembly and the Mustang or Douglas brand label attached to the tray are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall for In-Home Repair of Infant Swings
cards.hazard: It is possible to misassemble the seats of these swings, so that they appear secure, but are not. If the seat of the swing is not properly attached, the seat and baby can flip forward.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using swings immediately and call Fisher-Price for help in inspecting the seat, to make sure the seat is properly att…
cards.tell: Check for product numbers 79644, 79645 or 79647 molded onto the back of the seat.

cards.title: CPSC, Country Home Products, Inc. Announce Recall for Repair of Cordless Electric Lawnmowers
cards.hazard: A wiring problem on the lawnmower's circuit board may cause some of the safety functions to become inoperable. The mower may continue to operate, after the Operator Presence Control Bar is released.…
cards.remedy: Consumers with a recalled lawn mower should immediately stop using the lawnmower. Country Home Products is sending all registered users of…
cards.tell: All DR Whisperlite cordless electric lawnmowers are included in this recall; they have DR printed on the red or yellow plastic housing and Whisperlite on a label on the front.

cards.product: Seahorse® and "Bradford & White" Outdoor Gas-Powered Water Heaters
cards.title: CPSC and Gas-Fired Products Inc. Announce Recall of Water Heaters
cards.hazard: Over time, the heat exchanger could become blocked, creating a potential ventilation and cracking problem, posing a fire hazard, if nearby combustibles ignite.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the water heaters immediately and contact the recall hotline to receive a free repair kit. Most consumers were…
cards.tell: Check the brand and model number on the water heater's label to see if it matches the recalled Seahorse or Bradford & White models.

cards.title: CPSC, DeWALT Industrial Tool Co. Announce Recall to Repair Circular Saws
cards.hazard: The spindle on the saw may slip, causing the blade to contact the lower guard, posing a hazard to the consumer, from an exposed blade.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the circular saws immediately and return them to the nearest DeWALT service center, for a free repair.
cards.tell: Check for model numbers DW368, DW368K, or DW369CSK on the black label near the handle and date codes 200128-F through 200152-F stamped on the bottom of the motor case.

cards.title: CPSC, Crystal Mountain Water Cooler Corp. Announce Recall of Water Coolers
cards.hazard: The hot & cold water dispenser's heater band can short circuit, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should turn off the hot tank power switch or simply unplug the units and contact Crystal Mountain to receive repair information.…
cards.tell: Check the serial number plate on the back at the top of the dispenser for serial numbers between 1199125 and 1100175.

cards.product: Ozark Trail or "Wenzel" propane-fueled camping lanterns
cards.title: CPSC, Wenzel Reminds Consumers about Recall of Propane Camping Lanterns
cards.hazard: An insufficient connection between the lantern and the propane cylinder can allow gas to escape and ignite unexpectedly, posing a potential fire and injury hazard to consumers. This hazard can occur…
cards.remedy: Consumers with Ozark Trail or Wenzel lanterns should stop using them immediately and detach the lantern from the propane cylinder. Consumer…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the box and ensure the lantern was purchased before September 1, 2001.

cards.product: Time Out folding mini beach chairs
cards.title: CPSC, Intercon Merchandising Source Announce Recall of Mini Beach Chairs Given with "Time Out" Cosmetics at Sears
cards.hazard: The chairs can collapse, posing crush and amputation hazards to consumer's fingers and toes.
cards.remedy: Consumer should stop using these mini beach chairs immediately and contact Intercon for a free repair.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The chairs are white aluminum with a blue canvas seat and back with the name Time Out printed on the canvas backrest.

cards.product: Up, Down & Around toddler maze toys
cards.title: CPSC, Discovery Toys Announce Recall of Children's Toy
cards.hazard: The plastic tubes can break from the wooden base, releasing beads, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the toy immediately and contact Discovery Toys to receive a free replacement. Purchasers were sent direct mail…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled toy by model number 1612 located on the product.

cards.product: Greendog® girl's capri pant and shirt set
cards.title: CPSC and Federated Merchandising Group Announce Recall of Girl's Capri Pant and Shirt Set
cards.hazard: The buttons in the center of the embroidered flowers on the shirt can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these sets immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund or store credit.
cards.tell: Check the hang tag for style number 8088, which applies to yellow or white ruffled tops with embroidered flowers and denim capri pants sold in sizes 12, 18, and 24 months.

cards.product: RM and ZM model Cadet in-wall electric heaters
cards.title: Cadet Manufacturing Co. Recall of In-Wall Electric Heaters
cards.hazard: When an RM or ZM model heatbox (replacing a ZA or RA model heatbox) is inserted into a ZAC wall can and wired through a fitting in the top-left wall can knock-out (see the picture), the RM or ZM mode…
cards.remedy: If the heater is part of the recall, stop using it immediately by turning it off at the electrical panel board (circuit breaker or fuse box…
cards.tell: This recall includes RM and ZM models shipped prior to September 2000 as replacements for ZA and RA heaters and installed in a ZAC wall can with top-left knock-out wiring, plus certain units sold from 1998 through 2001.

cards.title: CPSC and Tristar Products Inc. Announce Recall of Steam Cleaner
cards.hazard: The internal hose connected to the trigger in the handle can detach, allowing hot water and/or steam to escape, posing a burn hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the Steam Buggy Deluxe immediately and contact Tristar customer service for information on how to ship the reca…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The steam cleaner is blue plastic and measures about 12 inches long and 8 inches high.

cards.title: CPSC, Tough Traveler Ltd. Announce Recall of Child Backpack Carriers
cards.hazard: A child could fall from a carrier when the seat restraint strap is not doubled-back through the slider if the carrier's safety harness is not used. The seat restraint strap is located between the chi…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these carriers immediately and contact Tough Traveler to receive instructions on doubling back the strap throug…
cards.tell: Only certain Kid Carrier, Filly, and Stallion carriers sold from December 2000 through February 2002 with metal contoured frames and specific teal color combinations are included. A tag on the outside reads Tough Travel…

cards.title: CPSC, Lifetime Products Inc. and Escalade Sports Announce Recall to Repair Portable Basketball Hoops
cards.hazard: The basketball hoops may have a sharp protruding bolt on the players' side of the pole, that can cause serious leg or body lacerations to consumers, when the bolt is exposed.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the basketball hoops immediately and contact Lifetime Products or Escalade Sports to receive free cap nuts to c…
cards.tell: All Lifetime models except Quick Court are recalled. Escalade Sports models include Harvard, The Big Easy, Spalding, Apex B9995, Mini Court, Alley Court, and model numbers B3100 through B3500 and B3402.

cards.title: CPSC, Invensys Climate Controls Announce Recall of TS11 Thermal Safety Control Valve
cards.hazard: The lower body, with 1/4", 3/8", 7/16" inlet/outlet diameter, may have a machining defect that can create a thin wall on the bottom of the casting. The cast area may break through partially or comple…
cards.remedy: Consumers who have one of these valves should return to the point of purchase or to Invensys.
cards.tell: Recalled valves have production date codes beginning with 0124 through 0131 marked on the backside of the upper housing below the red button.

cards.title: CPSC, Childcraft Education Corp. Announce Recall of Changing Table with Steps
