cards.product: Cosco "Zip n Go," "Okie Dokie," and "Carters" playpens
cards.title: CPSC, Dorel Juvenile Group Announce Recall of Cosco Playpens
cards.hazard: The plastic tabs on the playpen that lock the rails into the corners can break or loosen over time, allowing the rails to turn inward, collapse and entrap an infant.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these playpens immediately and call Dorel Juvenile Group to receive a refund or replacement product.
cards.tell: Check the model number on the label located on the bottom of the playpen on the metal tubular frame near one of the corners.

cards.title: CPSC, Salsa Cycles Announce Recall of Bicycle Rims
cards.hazard: The rims can unexpectedly fail during normal use, posing the risk of falls and serious injury to riders.
cards.remedy: Consumers with the recalled rims should stop using them immediately and return them to the store where they were purchased, for a full refu…
cards.tell: All Salsa Alto models with a black anodized finish and labeled Salsa and Salsa Alto in yellow, red and white are included.

cards.title: CPSC, Biddeford Textile Corp. Announce Recall of Electric Blankets
cards.hazard: The plug that connects the detachable control switch to the blanket can become loose. The resulting poor electrical contacts can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: The firm is no longer in business and the recall remedy is no longer available. Discard this product. Do not donate or resell.
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by the model name, serial numbers A001A to C210C, and Biddeford Textile Corporation printed on a label near where the control switch is plugged in.

cards.product: AC adapters used with certain Compaq notebook computers
cards.title: CPSC, Compaq Announce Recall of Notebook Computer AC Adapters
cards.hazard: These AC adapters can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled AC adapter immediately and contact Compaq to order a free replacement AC adapter.
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by the model series number PPP003SD, PPP003, or PP2012 located directly under Compaq Computer Corporation on the adapter label.

cards.title: CPSC, Maytag Corp. Announce Recall to Repair of Amana Gas Ranges
cards.hazard: During the broil and self-clean modes, the range can emit high levels of carbon monoxide (CO), presenting the potential for CO poisoning to consumers. Additionally, during the broil and self-clean mo…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the self-clean or broil functions of the ranges immediately. Consumers should call Amana for an in-home inspect…
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers on the tag located by opening the storage drawer and looking on either the left or right side.

cards.title: CPSC, American Suzuki Motor Corp. Announce Recall of Youth ATVs
cards.hazard: The drive chain on these ATVs could come off the sprockets and lock the rear axle. This could cause the driver to lose control of the ATV and crash, possibly resulting in injury or death.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ATVs immediately and contact their local Suzuki dealer to schedule an appointment for a free repair.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The ATV has QuadMaster 50 written on both sides of the bodywork.

cards.product: Drain Opener Clog Remover and Hair Clog Remover sold in 64-oz. bottles
cards.title: CPSC, National Service Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Drain Cleaners
cards.hazard: The bottles can leak, allowing the contents of the cleaner to come into contact with consumers. These cleaners can cause irritation and burns to the skin and eyes.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the cleaners immediately and contact the appropriate company, to receive a free replacement cap. Consumers shou…
cards.tell: Only 64-ounce bottles are affected. Check the brand name and UPC code on the label.

cards.product: Rain-X® Super Glass Cleaner Concentrate, Rain-X® Plus Washer Fluid Concentrate, and Rain-X® Washer Fluid Additive
cards.title: CPSC, Blue Coral Announce Recall of Rain-X® Glass Cleaner and Washer Fluid
cards.hazard: The products, which contain methyl alcohol, are not sealed with child-resistant closures, as required by federal law. Methyl alcohol, also known as methanol, is toxic and can cause blindness or death…
cards.remedy: Consumers should keep these recalled products out of the reach of young children. Consumers should call Blue Coral for information on recei…
cards.tell: Recalled items are Super Glass Cleaner Concentrate, Plus Washer Fluid Concentrate, and Washer Fluid Additive in specific sizes, excluding 10-oz and 16-oz yellow bottles of Washer Fluid Additive.

cards.title: CPSC, TH!NK Mobility Recall Electrically Assisted Bicycles
cards.hazard: The top of the handlebar stem binder bolt may twist off, while being tightened.
cards.remedy: Consumers should be aware of this possible condition while tightening the stem binder bolt and contact TH!NK Mobility to receive a free rep…
cards.tell: Check the model number and color: red (TT20001), blue (TT20002), silver (TT20003), and white (TT20004). The serial number is stamped into the inside of the left rear dropout of the frame.

cards.title: CPSC, Ryobi Technologies Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Circular Saws
cards.hazard: The lower blade guards on these saws can stick in the open position, posing a risk of serious injury to the operator and bystanders.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the saws immediately and contact Ryobi's Consumer Response Team for a free repair kit.
cards.tell: Check the white label on the motor housing for model numbers CSB120, CSB130, CSB1308, CSB130K, or CSB130JS.

cards.product: Tilt latches on Andersen 200 Series Tilt-Wash Double-Hung Windows
cards.title: CPSC, Andersen Corporation Announce Recall of Window Latches
cards.hazard: The latches on the lower sash of the window can unexpectedly open, posing a potential injury hazard to consumers who can be struck by the window or by shattered glass.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately ensure that the latches are in the closed position. Consumers should call the Andersen WindowCare® Solution Ce…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the Andersen A/W logo on the glass and the product label on the frame of 200 Series Tilt-Wash Double-Hung Windows.

cards.product: Premier and "Four Seasons" brand assembled utility wall cabinets
cards.title: CPSC, Mill's Pride Announce Recall of Assembled Utility Wall Cabinet
cards.hazard: The cabinets can detach from the wall and fall, possibly injuring consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should carefully remove the cabinet's contents and contact Mill's Pride to receive a free repair kit.
cards.tell: There are no labels, but these were the only assembled white 54-inch utility cabinets sold at Home Depot stores from July 2000 through May 2001.

cards.title: CPSC, Hunter's View Ltd. Announce Recall of Hunting Treestands
cards.hazard: The cables on these stands can break, causing the treestand to fall to the ground, posing an injury hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product. Do not donate or resell.
cards.tell: Check the model number and look for a yellow label on the tree stand that reads Hunter's View Ltd., 1-888-878-0440.

cards.title: CPSC, SBH Restructuring Corp. (formally Storybook Heirlooms) Recall Children's Pajamas
cards.hazard: These pajamas fail to meet the Federal Standards for the Flammability of Children's Sleepwear and, as a result, these pajamas pose a risk of injury to children, due to the possible ignition of the ga…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop their children from wearing these pajamas and return them to SBH Restructuring Corporation, 348 Poplar St…
cards.tell: Check the style number on the label attached to the neck or waistband to see if it is 26789, 26441, or 27338.

cards.product: AC adaptors for ZipVac rechargeable vacuums
cards.title: CPSC, Oreck Manufacturing Co. Announce the Recall of Certain A/C Adaptors for its ZipVac Hand Held Rechargeable Vacuum
cards.hazard: The charger can overheat and melt, presenting a burn or electric shock hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these rechargeable vacuums immediately and contact Oreck for information on receiving a replacement unit.
cards.tell: Recalled adaptors are model U090010D and have two circular holes in the adaptor plug end.

cards.product: Gas furnaces sold under the York, Luxaire, and Coleman brand names
cards.title: CPSC, York International Corporation Announce Recall of Gas Furnaces
cards.hazard: York's quality assurance and manufacturing investigation found these furnaces could have detached heat exchanger tubes. A separated heat exchanger tube could result in leakage of flue gases, includin…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these furnaces immediately and contact York for information in determining if the furnace is part of the recall…
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the brand, model number, and serial number located inside the removable front panels, where serial numbers start with WFKM or WGKM within specific ranges.

cards.title: CPSC, Racing Champions Ertl, Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Toy Toolboxes
cards.hazard: The toy's carrying handle can break, creating small parts and a sharp plastic edge that pose a choking and laceration hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Parents and caregivers should take the toy away from young children immediately and contact RCE for instructions on returning these toys an…
cards.tell: All yellow-handled toolboxes are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Kids II Announce Recall of Butterfly Baby Toys
cards.hazard: The antennae on these butterfly toys contain wire that can pass through the fabric, causing cuts and scratches to babies.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these toys away from babies immediately, and return the toy to the store where purchased or contact Kids II for a fre…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled toy by model number 50052 and date codes ending in 00433, 00856, 01003, or 01148 found on a small tag behind one of its wings.

cards.title: CPSC, Maya Wrap Announce Recall of Infant Carriers/Slings
cards.hazard: The welds of the metal rings that support the carriers/slings can break, posing a fall hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these carriers/slings immediately and call Maya Wrap for instructions on how to have the carriers/slings repair…
cards.tell: Recalled slings have metal support rings measuring 1/8-inch in width and a white label sewn inside reading MAYA WRAP. Slings with 1/4-inch rings are not included.

cards.title: CPSC, The Discovery Channel Store Announce Recall of Oil Lamps
cards.hazard: The glass on these lamps can shatter when lit, posing a fire and laceration hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lamps immediately and return them to any Discovery Channel Store or The Nature Company store nationwide,…
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled.

cards.product: Ozark Trail and Wenzel propane-fueled camping lanterns
cards.title: CPSC, Wenzel Announce Recall of Ozark Trail and Wenzel Propane Camping Lanterns
cards.hazard: An insufficient connection between the lantern and the propane cylinder can allow gas to escape and ignite unexpectedly, posing a potential fire and injury hazard to consumers. This hazard can occur…
cards.remedy: Consumers with Ozark Trail or Wenzel lanterns should stop using them immediately and detach the lantern from the propane cylinder. Consumer…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled lanterns by the model numbers 824927, 824928, 824208, 824226, 824227, and 824401 which appear on the packaging box.

cards.title: CPSC, SoloRider Industries Announce Recall of Single Rider Golf Carts
cards.hazard: The golf cart's software can be corrupted by static electricity, allowing it to move forward without assistance. Riders or bystanders could suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled golf carts immediately and contact the SoloRider dealer where purchased for a free repair. SoloRid…
cards.tell: You can tell by the serial number beginning with 32 located on a label on the frame of the vehicle near the left front tire.

cards.product: Snapper walk-behind rotary lawn mowers with model number MR216015T
cards.title: CPSC, Snapper Announce Recall of Walk-Behind Lawn Mowers
cards.hazard: Lawn mowers that have a serial number beginning with a 0 may exhibit improper blade retention that could injure the operator or a bystander, if the blade separates from the mower's housing. In additi…
cards.remedy: Consumers who have not received a notice from Snapper regarding this matter or have not been contacted by their Snapper dealer should stop…
cards.tell: The recalled mowers have model number MR216015T and Tecumseh engines, with serial numbers located on a silver label on the rear of the deck behind the engine.

cards.product: Three-wick and five-wick glass oil lamps
cards.title: CPSC, LTD Commodities Inc. Announce Recall of Three- and Five-Wick Glass Oil Lamps
cards.hazard: If the glass sleeves are not properly secured around the wicks, or the wicks are not properly inserted, the top glass of the lamps could shatter.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled glass oil lamps immediately and contact LTD Commodities Inc. for information on how to return the…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; check for catalog codes GOV for the three-wick lamp and GOY for the five-wick lamp.

cards.product: Little Tree natural wood dollhouse bathroom furniture sets
cards.title: CPSC, XL Machine Ltd. Announce Recall of Dollhouse Furniture Sets Sold at Target Stores
cards.hazard: The yellow paint on the furniture contains lead, which can present a risk of lead poisoning to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take these dollhouse furniture sets away from children, and return the sets to the Target store where purchase…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The packaging reads Little Tree, Distributed by Target Corporation, and MADE IN CHINA.

cards.title: CPSC, World Industries Announce Recall of Skateboard Helmets
cards.hazard: These helmets failed impact testing required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets. Riders wearing these helmets are not adequately protected from falls and could suffer head injuries or d…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these helmets immediately and return them to the stores where purchased, for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They come in black, blue and white with cartoon characters on the sides, World Industries printed on the chin strap, back, and padding, and labels inside reading Certified CPSC 16CFR1203.

cards.product: Children's toys: "2 PC Tambourine Set", "Bathtime Water Wheel", "Funny Loco Wind-Up", and "Pull Back Duck in Boat"
cards.title: CPSC, STK International Announce Recall of Children's Toys
cards.hazard: The toys can break, causing small balls to be released, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the toys away from children immediately, and return them to STK International, for a full refund.
cards.tell: Check for specific names, stickers, and markings on each toy, such as number 985 on the tambourines, NO:368 on the water wheel, NO:883 on the train, and My Baby Products sticker on the boat.

cards.title: CPSC, Recreational Equipment Inc. (REI) Announce Recall of Children's Baseball Caps
cards.hazard: The adjustment cords, located on the rear of the hats, use a snap-on plastic pull. The snap-on plastic pull could separate from the cord, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled children's baseball caps immediately and return them to the nearest REI retailer, to receive a ref…
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Kids "R" Us and Babies "R" Us Announce Recall of Children's Cargo Pants
cards.hazard: The toggle on the pockets of the pants can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove and discard the two toggles on the leg pockets. The pants then can be worn without the toggle.
cards.tell: All units of these pants are recalled. Look for a label on the rear inside seam reading Koala Baby or Little Legends and a care label reading Made in Thailand.

cards.title: CPSC, Cannondale Corp. Announce Recall of ATVs
cards.hazard: The ball joints in the A-arm assembly on these vehicles can break, which could cause the front wheels to lose stability. Also, the tie-rod assemblies on these vehicles can break or work loose, and da…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these ATVs and contact their local Cannondale dealer to schedule an appointment to have the ball joints and ti…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Cannondale appears on the rear fenders and bodywork, Cannibal appears near the operator's knee, and FX400 appears on the seat.

cards.product: Suspension forks on FX and RX model recumbent bicycles
cards.title: CPSC, BikeE Announce Recall of Recumbent Bicycle Suspension Forks
cards.hazard: The link pins in the forks can fall out, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall, and possibly suffer serious injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately. The firm, BikeE, is out of business and cannot be contacted. As the firm is no long…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; check if the serial number located below the crank bottom bracket on the frame starts with F or B.

cards.title: CPSC, Kolcraft Announce Recall of LiteSport Strollers
cards.hazard: Lock mechanisms, found on both sides of the stroller, can break and cause the stroller to suddenly collapse. When the strollers collapse, babies can fall and suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the strollers immediately and call Kolcraft to receive a free repair kit.
cards.tell: The model number 36122 and manufacture date from December 1997 through December 1999 are on a label on the back leg frame of the stroller.

cards.product: Safety 1st Cabinet and Drawer Spring Latches
cards.title: CPSC, Safety 1st Announce Recall of Cabinet and Drawer Spring Latches
cards.hazard: If the safety latch breaks, a small spring could be released. Young children could choke on the small spring or gain access to a cabinet or drawer where dangerous items are stored.
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact Safety 1st for free replacement latches immediately.
cards.tell: The recalled latches have uncovered straight ends of the metal springs, whereas replacement latches have a plastic tab over the spring.

cards.product: Portable bassinet sold under the names Sit & Soothe Portable Bassinet, Soothing Sounds Bassinet, and Soothing Sounds Po…
cards.title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Portable Bassinets
cards.hazard: Children and adults can be injured when their fingers are pinched or cut between parts of the folding mechanism.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these portable bassinets immediately and contact Fisher-Price to order a free repair kit. The repair kit will p…
cards.tell: Check the white nylon label on the underside of the foot for model numbers 79338, 79334, or 79336, and ensure the manufacture date is before April 2000.

cards.product: Hourglass Space Sprout and "Look for Me Bumblebee" toddler toys
cards.title: CPSC, Burger King and Alcone Announce Recall of Two Kids Meal Toys
cards.hazard: The toys can break, causing small beads or balls to be released, which poses a choking or aspiration hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Parents should immediately take the toys away from children and call Burger King's Consumer Affairs for instructions on returning the toy f…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify them by the Sassy and Burger King markings on the back.

cards.title: CPSC, Acetrike Bicycle Co. Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
cards.hazard: The frames of these bikes can break, causing the riders to fall and suffer injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bicycles immediately, and call Huffy Bicycle Co. to determine if their bicycle is part of the recall. Co…
cards.tell: You can tell a recalled unit by its model name on the frame and date codes of April 2000 or earlier molded on the left rear frame near the rear wheel.

cards.title: CPSC, Milwaukee Electric Tool Corp. Announce Recall of Electric Wrenches
cards.hazard: The wrenches have power cords that can release from the handle, posing an injury or electrocution hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these electric wrenches immediately and return them to the nearest Milwaukee Factory Service Center or authoriz…
cards.tell: Check the nameplate on the tool body for model numbers 9070-20, 9071-20, or 9075-20 along with the corresponding serial number ranges listed in the recall.

cards.product: Winch Kits used with All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs)
cards.title: CPSC, Warn Industries Inc. Announce Recall of ATV Winch Kits
cards.hazard: An electrical component of the winch kit, the solenoid, poses a fire hazard when used in this application, even when the vehicle is parked and the winch is not in use.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately disconnect the solenoid wires from their ATV and call their local ATV dealer or Warn Industries to receive the…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking for the White-Rodgers solenoid with a bracket that has one open slot and one hole.

cards.title: CPSC, Basic Comfort Inc. Announce Recall of Infant Seat Pads
cards.hazard: The seat pad has two shoulder straps that create a v-shaped opening around the head and neck, presenting a strangulation hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the infant pads immediately and contact Basic Comfort to receive a replacement.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The pad is denim blue with white restraint straps and attaches to a chair with Velcro side straps.

cards.title: CPSC, NIKE USA Inc. Announce Recall of Jordan Trunner Cross-Training Shoes
cards.hazard: The shoes have a thin metal strip on the outside of the heel that can protrude from the shoe and form a sharp edge that can cut consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these cross-training shoes immediately and contact NIKE to receive free replacement shoes.
cards.tell: Check the model number on the white label located inside the shoe above the UPC code to see if it matches the recalled model numbers.

cards.title: CPSC, Inca Imports Announce Recall of Stuffed Bears
cards.hazard: The noses, bells, and eyes of the bears can detach, presenting a choking hazard to young children. The eyes also present a sharp point hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these stuffed bears away from young children immediately and return them to the store where they were purchased, for…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They come in small, medium, and large sizes made of alpaca fur with plastic eyes and noses, red ribbon bows with bells, and a sticker on the back of the ribbon reading Made in Peru.

cards.product: Toro and Exmark brand commercial duty zero-turn radius riding mowers
cards.title: CPSC, The Toro Company Announce Recall of Riding Mowers
cards.hazard: Spilled fuel can ignite during refueling, when fuel vapors are drawn into the hot muffler.
cards.remedy: Call Exmark or Toro to determine if the riding mower is part of the recall. If so, local Exmark or Toro dealers will install a spark arrest…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled mowers by the model number found on a decal located on the right side of the operating console below the seat.

cards.product: P-Handle Hand Trucks and Baby Walkers
cards.title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Hand Trucks, Baby Walkers
cards.hazard: If the tires of the hand trucks are substantially over-inflated beyond the recommended maximum 30 P.S.I., the rims of the tire can separate under the intense pressure and strike the user or bystander…
cards.remedy: Consumers should contact UnionTools, Inc. to receive a free repair kit. Consumers should only use a hand pump to inflate the tires. Consume…
cards.tell: All units of this baby walker are included in the recall. Model number ST-108ST is on the box, and Q BABY is on the front label.

cards.title: CPSC, JT USA Inc. Announce Recall of Proteus Paint Ball Masks
cards.hazard: The plastic facemask could crack around the ear cover, when hit by a paint ball. This could allow the facemask to come off, exposing consumers to eye injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these masks immediately, and return them to JT USA for a free replacement mask.
cards.tell: The recalled masks are gray with clear plastic ear covers.

cards.title: CPSC, Krups Announce Recall of Coffeemakers

cards.remedy: Consumers should unplug and stop using the coffeemakers immediately and contact Krups North America, to receive a free replacement coffeema…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the bottom of the coffeemaker for model 398 with a black or white exterior or model 405 with a simulated wood-grain exterior.

cards.title: CPSC, Atico International USA Inc. Announce Recall of Percolators
cards.hazard: If the thermostat fails, the plastic housing of the percolator can overheat and melt while in use, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product. Do not donate or resell.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are white plastic percolators with gray bases, including the Kitchen Gourmet with red flowers and the Prinetti with Prinetti written on the front.

cards.title: CPSC, Raymond Geddes & Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Velcro Wallets
cards.hazard: The zipper pull in the wallet contains lead, which can present a risk of lead poisoning to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take these wallets away from children, and return the wallets to the store where purchased, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify them by the 3.5 by 5 inch size, velcro flap, black trim, yellow backing on the largest pocket, and a tag stating "MADE IN CHINA."

cards.title: CPSC, Peg Perego USA Announce Recall of High Chairs
cards.hazard: When the seat is reclined, the high chairs have a space between the armrest and backrest, in which a child's head or arm can become entrapped. This can pose a risk of suffocation or injury to the hea…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the high chairs immediately. Consumers should call Peg Perego to receive free replacement armrests that will el…
cards.tell: Recalled models include Prima Pappa, Roller, and Martinelli Pappa and Nanna without 9-inch armrests, identified by model names on the footrest or seat back and a sticker on the leg brace.

cards.product: CUDDLES FEEDING SET or "CUDDLES MEAL TIME" toy feeding sets

cards.hazard: The nipple on the toy baby bottle included in these sets could come off, posing a serious choking hazard to small children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these recalled toys away from young children immediately, and return the toy set to the store where purchased, for a…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Packaging reads CUDDLES FEEDING SET or CUDDLES MEAL TIME and Imperial NO. 8327.

cards.product: Kitty Kitty Kittens stuffed toy kittens

cards.remedy: Parents and caregivers should take these kitten toys away from children immediately, and discard or destroy them. The firm is out of busine…

cards.product: Let's Start™ Numbers and "Optical Illusions Lab" educational kits

cards.hazard: The red painted numbers on the acetate stencil sheet included in the "Let's Start™" kit contain lead; and the gold paint bearing the words "Kasy's Extrafine" on the black pen included in the "Optical…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the stencil sheets and pens from the activity kits and discard them. Customers should call Advantage Pu…
cards.tell: All units of the Let's Start Numbers and Optical Illusions Lab educational kits are included in this recall.

cards.product: Gas-fired horizontal furnaces commonly called NOx rod furnaces

cards.hazard: These furnaces pose a substantial risk of fire.
cards.remedy: This recall remedy is no longer available. The firm that announced the recall is out of business.

cards.title: CPSC, Apple Announces Recall of AC Adapter for Prior Generation PowerBook Laptops
cards.hazard: These AC adapters could overheat, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these AC adapters and contact Apple to receive a free replacement.
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; check the label on the side of the adapter for the model number M4402 and the text Macintosh PowerBook 45W AC Adapter.

cards.product: Twin plantation bed headboards, queen plantation bed headboards, plantation nightstands and antique tin mirrors

cards.hazard: The furniture could be painted with lead-containing paint. Ingestion of lead from deteriorating paint is a major source of lead poisoning for children 6 years old and under.
cards.remedy: Consumers should call Neiman Marcus to arrange for free pick-up and a full refund.
cards.tell: All units of these twin and queen plantation bed headboards, plantation nightstands, and antique tin mirrors are recalled.

cards.product: Fujika Models KSP-229 and KSP-231 Hi-Pet Heaters/Cookers

cards.tell: Check the model number on the unit to see if it is KSP-229 or KSP-231 Hi-Pet Heaters/Cookers.

cards.title: CPSC, Chicco USA Inc. Announce Recall of Preschool Toys
cards.hazard: Some of the larger-sized ball halves can become stuck on a young child's face, covering the nose and mouth, and causing suffocation.
cards.remedy: Parents and caregivers should take these balls away from young children immediately and return the toys to the store where purchased for a…
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled. The balls feature chicco written inside, and the packaging is labeled chicco, Build-a-Ball, and Cod. 66167.

cards.title: CPSC, Five Firms Announce Recall of Backpack Blowers
cards.hazard: The fuel tanks on these blowers can leak, posing a fire hazard and risk of burn injuries to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled blowers immediately, and contact the manufacturer to have their blower repaired free of charge.
cards.tell: The brand name, model number, and serial number are written on the units, and consumers should contact the manufacturer with their serial number to check if their blower is recalled.

cards.product: Chain Saws and Child Table Seats
cards.title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Chain Saws and Child Table Seats
cards.hazard: A missing screw can cause the chain brake to fail to operate, presenting a laceration hazard to consumers. The seats were sold without a seat belt, posing a risk to children who climb out of the seat.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled chain saw immediately and return it to the Stihl dealer where purchased for repair. Consumers shou…
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled chain saw by model number 019T and serial numbers 249129398 through 249956311, with the label reading STIHL.

cards.product: Fluke T-2 hand-held electrical voltage and continuity testers
cards.title: CPSC, Fluke Corp. Announce Recall of Electrical Testers
cards.hazard: The recalled units can "lock-up" and stop working. When the tester "locks-up" it stops working for approximately 8 minutes without warning. Consumers testing electrical sources could fail to be warne…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these voltage and continuity testers immediately, and contact Fluke for information on returning the recalled u…
cards.tell: Recalled units have a serial number higher than 73510000 located on the back of the unit above the wire leads.

cards.product: Remote Controlled Toy Race Cars and Galileo Weather Thermometers
cards.title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Remote Controlled Toy Race Cars and Galileo Weather Thermometers
cards.hazard: Problems with the circuits are rendering some of the Remote Controlled Race Cars inoperable. These cars can overheat and emit smoke and may pose a potential burn hazard. The thermometers contain a li…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these cars immediately, remove the batteries from the remote controlled race cars and the remote controls and r…
cards.tell: All units of this remote controlled toy race car are included in the recall.

cards.product: Electronic Light N' Learn activity gyms
cards.title: CPSC, KB Toys Announce Recall of Activity Gym Toys
cards.hazard: Five detachable hanging rattle toys have small round pegs at the top of the toys that can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these toys away from young children immediately and return the toy to the store where purchased for a refund. Consume…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled gym by checking the label under the handle on the main console which reads ELECTRONIC LIGHT N' LEARN ACTIVITY GYM MODEL: 8735.

cards.title: CPSC, Century Announce Recall of Multi-Use Strollers
cards.hazard: The strollers can unexpectedly collapse or the car seat/carrier adapter can unexpectedly detach. When this happens, an infant or young child inside the stroller or an attached car seat/carrier can fa…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these strollers and call Graco to order a free repair kit. Consumers should have their strollers available, as…
cards.tell: Check the model name on the footrest, seat pad, frame legs, or white label on the side locks.

cards.title: CPSC, Gymboree Announce Recall of Baby Boy Bodysuits
cards.hazard: The wheel-shaped zipper pull can twist off and become a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these outfits and return them to any Gymboree store for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify them as short-sleeved green or red bodysuits with a wheel-shaped zipper pull, a Soap Box Derby patch, and a white care label that reads 2000 Gymboree.

cards.title: CPSC, BRIO® Announce Recall of Toy Baking Sets
cards.hazard: The sets include a hand mixer with a knob that can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the hand mixer away from children immediately and call BRIO for a refund or replacement item. Consumers also can send…
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled set by the model number 31798 or 31795 printed on the product packaging.

cards.product: Parents™ magazine-brand Soft Landing Beanbag cushions
cards.title: CPSC, Battat Incorporated Announce Recall of Beanbag Cushions Suffocation and Strangulation Hazards to Babies Cited
cards.hazard: This product is an infant cushion manufactured by Battat for Parents™ magazine. Infant pillows and cushions have been banned under the Federal Hazardous Substances Act since 1992 because they pose a…
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the cushions away from children immediately and return the cushions to a Target store for a refund. Consumers also ca…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are airplane-shaped cushions with a smiley face, spinning propeller, plush nose, side pockets, and a hang tag reading Battat Inc.

cards.product: Star Cruiser® and Rocket Rider® swings on backyard gym sets
cards.title: CPSC, Hedstrom® Corp. Announce Recall of Swings on Backyard Gym Sets
cards.hazard: Screws that hold the swing together can fall out, causing the seat to fall to the ground, posing an injury risk to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the swings immediately, detach them from the gym set, and discard or destroy them. The firm is out of business…
cards.tell: All Star Cruiser and Rocket Rider swings sold separately or with gym sets are included.

cards.title: CPSC, Saks Incorporated Announce Recall of Boys' Vests
cards.hazard: The elastic toggle cord on the end of the zipper pulls can loosen and come off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the vest immediately and return the vest to any Saks store for a refund.
cards.tell: All units of this product are included in the recall. Check for labels sewn into the front side pocket reading Parisian kids or URIT.

cards.product: TROY-BILT and GARDEN WAY BY TROY-BILT trimmers/mowers
cards.title: CPSC, Garden Way Announce Recall of Trimmers/Mowers
cards.hazard: The trimmer heads, which control the cutting cords, can split and detach, posing a serious injury risk to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the trimmers/mowers immediately and discard or destroy the product.
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers on the deck behind the left wheel from the operator's position, and compare them to the listed ranges.

cards.title: CPSC, Schottenstein and Value City Department Stores Recall Candles
cards.hazard: The candle flame can ignite the silver paint coating on the candle container, presenting a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled candles immediately and contact Schottenstein or Value City Stores to receive a refund and a $5 of…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The candles come in two terracotta ceramic containers: a vase-shape leaf design measuring 3.5 inches high and a jar-shape rope design measuring 2 inches high.

cards.product: Tropical Fish and Rockin' Reptile Push'n Pop toys
cards.title: CPSC, Raymond Geddes & Co. Inc. Recall Push'n Pop Toys
cards.hazard: The balloon tongues and the cylinders holding the tongues on these toys can detach, which poses choking and aspiration hazards to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take these toys away from young children and take them back to where they were purchased for a refund, or thro…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The toys come in fish and lizard styles where squeezing inflates a balloon tongue, and 'MADE IN CHINA' is molded into the toy.

cards.title: CPSC, Giant Bicycle, Inc. Recall Giant Bicycle Forks
cards.hazard: The forks can break during use, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall and suffer serious injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately, and return them to the nearest Giant Authorized Dealer for a free inspection, and,…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled forks by checking the date code on the steerer tube, which has specific year, month, or embossed alphanumeric codes depending on the bicycle model.

cards.title: CPSC, Spin Master Toys Announce Recall of Water Rocket Toys
cards.hazard: The rockets, once propelled from the launcher, can fly rapidly in unpredictable directions, and can hit and injure children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled water rocket toys immediately and call Spin Master Toys to to receive a replacement rocket.
cards.tell: Recalled rockets were manufactured up to March 17, 2001, identified by a date code on the launcher base ending in AC up to 03172001AC.

cards.title: CPSC, COMBI International Corp. Announce Recall of Activity Rockers
cards.hazard: One of the toys, a clear plastic ball, can crack and break during use, exposing the small beads inside, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately detach the toy bar from the activity rocker, discard it and call COMBI to receive a free replacement toy bar.
cards.tell: Check the frame of the rocker for model numbers 9710-0 and 9710-1 along with lot numbers 7000-10102 and 5000-6034.

cards.title: CPSC, Child Craft Industries Announce Recall of Changing Tables
cards.hazard: Some changing table joints were not properly glued and can separate, presenting a fall hazard to babies.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled changing tables immediately and call Child Craft to receive information on participating in this r…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the product by two labels on one of the rails, including a gold label reading Child Craft Industries and a black stamped label reading FoppaPedretti.

cards.title: CPSC, BSH Home Appliances Corp.Announce Recall of Thermal/Microwave Ovens
cards.hazard: The oven door may not lock properly when the oven is put into the "self clean" mode. While the oven is in "self clean" mode, intense heat is generated to clean the oven. If oxygen is introduced by op…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the "self clean" mode of the recalled ovens immediately and contact Thermador to arrange for a free inspection…
cards.tell: Check the data plate inside the grill beneath the control panel for the model number and a serial number beginning with 2003 through 2010.

cards.title: CPSC, Sears Announce Recall of Glue Gun
cards.hazard: These glue guns can overheat, presenting fire and burn hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the glue guns immediately and return them to the place of purchase or their nearest Sears store, for a full ref…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled glue gun by checking the label on the side that reads Craftsman Glue Gun 526.804420.

cards.title: CPSC, Unilever Home and Personal Care USA Announce Recall of Snuggle® Teeny Bean Bears Included with Fabric Softener
cards.hazard: The yellow pom-pom can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the bear's pom-pom, to eliminate the choking hazard.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled bear by its 5-inch size, blue nightcap with yellow moon and star design, yellow pom-pom at the end, and a label reading ©2001 Lever Brothers Company, Made In China.

cards.product: Milwaukee Electric Tool 1/2" drills and DEWALT 1/2" Stud & Joist Drills
cards.title: CPSC, Power Tool Manufacturers Announce Recall of Electric Drills
cards.hazard: The switches on these power tools, which were manufactured by Eaton Corp., of Cleveland, Ohio, can stick. The drills can continue to operate after the trigger is released, posing a risk of injury to…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these drills immediately and contact the tool manufacturer to receive a free tool repair.
cards.tell: Check the model number and serial number or date code on the identification plate attached to the drill or stamped into the drill body to see if it matches the recalled ranges.

cards.title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Basketball Sets
cards.hazard: Some of the nets have enlarged openings. If children put their heads into these enlarged openings, the net can get tangled around their necks and they could strangle.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the basketball set immediately. Consumers should call Fisher-Price to order a free replacement net.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled set by the Fisher-Price logo on the front of the backboard and model number 72408 on the back.

cards.title: CPSC, Drinkmaker of Sweden AB Announce Recall of Home Soda Machines
cards.hazard: Components inside the soda machine can break apart, posing a serious risk of lacerations to consumers, who can be struck by shrapnel.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these soda machines immediately and call The Soft Drink Company, of Seattle, Washington to receive a free repai…
cards.tell: All units sold between 1990 and 1996 are recalled; machines sold after 1996 are not included. They feature a white exterior, black lid, and model name on the front.

cards.title: CPSC, Canon U.S.A. Inc. Announce Recall of Fax Machines
cards.hazard: The Faxphones are combination plain-paper copiers and facsimile machines. A component failure can cause the Faxphone to catch on fire.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the Faxphones immediately, and contact Canon U.S.A. Inc. to get a free replacement Faxphone.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model number B640 and serial numbers UKK52923 to UKK55442, UKK60513 to UKK99999, and YKK02001 to YKK20000 on the silver label on the back.

cards.title: CPSC, Vermont Castings, Majestic Products Announce Recall of Space Heaters
cards.hazard: Overheating inside the space heaters can cause the exterior to become extremely hot, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the heaters immediately and discard or destroy them. The company is no longer in business and a remedy is no lo…
cards.tell: Model numbers starting with VBVH or VPVH can be found on a rating plate on the left side of the heater.

cards.title: CPSC, Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Padlocks and Cable Gun Locks
cards.hazard: The padlocks can be opened using keys other than those originally provided with the locks and the cable locks can be opened if struck with force, potentially allowing unauthorized access to a firearm.
cards.remedy: Consumers with the recalled padlocks and cable locks should send them to Sturm, Ruger & Co. Inc., Dept. LK, 411 Sunapee Street, Newport, NH…
cards.tell: All padlocks shipped from 1987 to 1995 and red cable gun locks shipped from 1998 to March 2001 bearing the Ruger name are included in the recall.

cards.product: Crosley and Magic Chef electric ranges
cards.title: CPSC, Maytag Announce Recall of Electric Ranges
cards.hazard: Liquid can enter the indicator light and can cause sparking and flaming in the light, presenting a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using their electric ranges immediately and disconnect power to them. Consumers should contact Maytag to schedule a f…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the tag located on the left side by opening the storage drawer.

cards.title: CPSC, Sheico PKS Inc. Announce Recall of Scuba Buoyancy Compensator Devices (BCDs)
cards.hazard: The overpressure valve can stick in the open position, presenting a drowning hazard to divers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the BCDs immediately and return them to the dive store where purchased for a free replacement.
cards.tell: Check the brand on the right outside pocket, model inside near the back, and serial number on the aircell to see if it falls within the recalled serial number ranges.

cards.title: CPSC, Dynacraft Announce Recall of Mountain Bicycles Sold at Toys R Us
cards.hazard: The pedals on these bicycles can loosen and fall off while riding, resulting in serious injury to the rider.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately, and call Dynacraft to receive a free replacement pedal/crank set and to arrange for…
cards.tell: You can tell by the model number, month, and year of manufacture on a label affixed to the frame near the crank housing.

cards.title: CPSC, Dell Computer Corp. Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries
cards.hazard: These batteries can overcharge, causing them to become very hot, release smoke, and possibly catch fire.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these batteries immediately and contact Dell to obtain a discount on a future purchase from Dell of a new consu…
cards.tell: Check the colored sticker at the rear of the battery for the number 99 or series 00 51 or less with the letter P in the first line.

cards.product: The "Hotery Pocke Torch" and "Fire Plug" Pocket Torch
cards.title: CPSC, Tools Exchange Inc. Announce Recall of Novelty Cigarette Lighters
cards.hazard: The lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The Hotery Pocke Torch has PT-16 printed on the cap and HOTERY POCKE TORCH on the side, while the Fire Plug features Fire Plug inside a black disk on both sides.

cards.title: CPSC, Harbor Freight Tools Announce Recall Propane Torches
cards.hazard: The hose that comes with the propane torch can crack or burst, presenting a fire and explosion hazard.
cards.remedy: Stop using the propane torches immediately. Consumers should call Harbor Freight Tools to obtain a refund.
cards.tell: Recalled units have hose writing that reads IN-8MM OUT-13MM BURST 525 PSI PRESSURE WORK 150 PSI MADE IN CHINA, whereas similar torches marked Made in Italy are not included.

cards.title: CPSC, NHTSA, Evenflo Announce Recall to Repair Evenflo® Joyride® Car Seats/Carriers
cards.hazard: When the seat is used as an infant carrier, the handle can unexpectedly release, causing the seat to flip forward. When this happens, an infant inside the carrier can fall to the ground and suffer se…
cards.remedy: Evenflo will provide consumers with a free easy-to-install repair kit that helps secure the handle. Consumers should not carry the seat by…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Evenflo Joyride Car Seat/Carrier is written on the outside of the handle locks, with model numbers beginning with 203, 205, 210, 435 or 493 on a label underneath or on the side.

cards.product: MARTHA STEWART EVERYDAY® brand tea kettles
cards.title: CPSC, Kmart Corp. Announce Recall of MARTHA STEWART EVERYDAY® Brand Tea Kettles
cards.hazard: Boiling water can be expelled from the kettle's spout, presenting a burn hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these tea kettles immediately and return them to any Kmart store for a refund.
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled; check for the words MSE Thailand printed on the knob attached to the lid.

cards.title: CPSC, Creative Consumer Concepts Inc. and Whataburger Inc. Announce Recall of Kid's Meal Toys
cards.hazard: The clear plastic lens covers on these compass toys can come off and pose a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Parents should take these toys away from children immediately, and return the toy to any Whataburger Restaurant, for a free replacement toy.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The back of the compass reads WHATAGEAR and WHATABURGER.

cards.title: CPSC, Dynacraft Announce Recall of Boys' Mountain Bicycles Sold at Wal-Mart
cards.hazard: The front-suspension forks on these bicycles can break during use, resulting in serious injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these bicycles immediately, and call Dynacraft to receive a free replacement fork and to arrange for free insta…
cards.tell: Only orange bicycles with model number 8536-33 on the frame near the crank housing are included in this recall.

cards.product: ASIC Gel Wrestling Ear Guard with Neoprene
cards.title: CPSC, ASICS TIGER Corp. Announce Recall of Wrestling Ear Guards
cards.hazard: The plastic protective shell of these guards can break when it is hit against a hard surface, resulting in impact injuries to the wrestler's head.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these ear guards immediately, and return them to the store where purchased or to the firm for a free replacemen…
cards.tell: Look for date codes beginning with 98 or 99 written on the neoprene nylon underneath the outer rim of the ear piece.

cards.product: Cigarette lighters packaged in souvenir sets with ashtrays, pencils or pens
cards.title: Cigarette Lighters Recalled by DFS Group Ltd.
cards.hazard: The lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms. Young children can easily ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the DFS store where purchased for a refund.
cards.tell: Recalled lighters are refillable electronic ignition lighters with flip-up caps, location names, and an orange warning label on the back stating they are not child resistant.

cards.title: Backpack Blowers Recalled by Kawasaki Motors Corp. USA
cards.hazard: The engine exhaust can emit flames, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the backpack blowers immediately, and call their local ASTRON or TMC dealer for a free repair.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model name and serial numbers located on the blower base or fan case, and on the recoil starter.

cards.product: Goldstar, General Electric, and Sears Kenmore portable dehumidifiers
cards.title: CPSC, LG Electronics Inc. Announce Recall of Goldstar, General Electric, and Sears Kenmore Dehumidifiers
cards.hazard: These dehumidifiers have an internal electrical connection that can overheat, presenting a potential fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the dehumidifiers immediately and call LG Electronics for a free repair.
cards.tell: Check the brand on the front left and the model number on a sticker behind the condensate bucket on the left side.

cards.title: CPSC, Disney Store Announce Recall of Children's Costumes
cards.hazard: Fabric used in these costumes can ignite readily and presents a serious risk of burn injuries in violation of the Federal Flammable Fabrics Act.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop wearing these costumes immediately, and return them to any Disney Store or to the Disney Store catalog for a refund a…
cards.tell: Recalled costumes have a green skirt with two layers of netting on top and a sequined purple metallic bodice with a picture of Ariel, and neckline labels reading The Disney Store.

cards.product: On/off switches sold in packages of Westek rope lights
cards.title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of On/Off Switches for Rope and Cable Lights
cards.hazard: If the rope lights are plugged in, even if the lights are not lit, the recalled switch on the power cord could allow the rope lights to remain energized. This poses a potential electric shock hazard…
cards.remedy: Consumers should not install the power switch supplied with the Westek rope lights. If the switch is already installed, stop using the ligh…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The switches are a rectangular white plastic box about 1 inch long with a wheel-type switch through the middle, included with Westek rope lights and power cord kits.

cards.product: Of/off switches included in Cable Lights packages
cards.title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of On/Off Switches for Rope and Cable Lights
cards.hazard: If the cable lights are plugged in, even if the lights are not lit, the recalled switch on the power cord could allow the cable lights to remain energized. This poses a potential electric shock hazar…
cards.remedy: Consumers should not install the power switch supplied with the cable lights. If the switch is already installed, stop using the lights imm…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The switches are a rectangular white plastic box with a rotating wheel switch.

cards.title: CPSC, Atomic Aquatics Announce Recall of Scuba Regulators
cards.hazard: The regulator's first stage spring can break, causing restricted airflow, posing a drowning hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these regulators immediately and return them to Atomic Aquatics or an authorized Atomic Aquatics dealer for rep…
cards.tell: You can tell by the model numbers T1, T1x, B1 or Z1 printed on the faceplate along with Atomic Aquatics and Titanium.

cards.title: CPSC, Gladstrong Investments USA Announce Recall of Disposable Lighters
cards.hazard: The lighters' child-resistant mechanisms are frequently ineffective. Young children are able to operate the lighters, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund.
cards.tell: Recalled lighters have BODA-BING, GIL, HAPPY, or WAX stamped on both sides of the metal top, specific UPC codes on the label, and MADE IN CHINA printed on them.

cards.title: CPSC, Lithonia Lighting Announce Recall of Emergency Lights
cards.hazard: The emergency lights have an internal electrical component that could overheat when connected to 277-volt electrical systems and melt the lighting enclosure, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Building managers with recalled ELM and ELM2 emergency lights should contact Lithonia Lighting for repair kits.
cards.tell: Recalled units have date codes between 208S13 and 705S13, or between 9208S13 and 9705S13, located on a label inside the front housing.

cards.title: CPSC, Tony USA Inc. Announce Recall of Easter Egg Garlands
cards.hazard: The string can break and release the eggs, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these garlands immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The 6-foot garland is made of plastic egg-shaped beads in green, yellow, blue, purple, and red connected by a clear plastic string.

cards.title: CPSC, Fleetwood EXIM Inc. Announce Recall of Cigarette Lighters
cards.hazard: The lighters have child-resistant mechanisms that do not work. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The lighters have an oval tube shape, a blue, orange, red or clear transparent case, and the brand name youjie stamped into the windshield.

cards.title: CPSC, Midwest of Cannon Falls Inc. Announce Recall of Candles
cards.hazard: When the duck-shaped candle burns, the pooling of wax can ignite the paint on the duck, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the candles immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The yellow duck candle on a green base has a UPC code of 7 38449 38819 8 on a label on the bottom.

cards.title: CPSC, Lakewood Announce Recall of Electric Heaters
cards.hazard: The electrical connections inside of the heater can become loose, causing the heater's metal frame to become energized. This poses a serious electric shock hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these heaters, disable and discard them. The firm is out of business and a remedy is no longer avai…
cards.tell: Check the model number 797 or 797 DFT stamped on the back of the unit and the word Lakewood printed on the control panel.

cards.title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Infant and Toddler Toys
cards.hazard: Two red knobs on the toy can break off, creating small parts that can pose a choking hazard for young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take the toys away from young children immediately and contact Fisher-Price to order a free repair kit with replacement kn…
cards.tell: Recalled models have a date code from 269(0) through 281(0) molded into the underside of the blue removable top and model number 77148 on the red base.

cards.product: Bungee Baby Jumpers and Wipe Warmers
cards.title: CPSC, Cosco Inc. and Safety 1st Announce Recall of Bungee Baby Jumpers and Wipe Warmers
cards.hazard: The Bungee Baby Jumper allows a baby to bounce while supported in a seat by an elastic "bungee cord," suspended from a doorway. Metal clasps can detach from the bungee cord, causing the unit to fall…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the bungee baby jumpers immediately and contact Cosco. The repair kit is no longer available. A new cash incent…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the bottom of the unit to see if it matches the recalled models and manufacturing dates.

cards.title: CPSC, White Consolidated Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Air Conditioners
cards.hazard: These air conditioners can short circuit, posing a risk of fires, and shock and burn injuries to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these units, and contact the company to arrange for a free repair.
cards.tell: Check the brand on the front under the control dial and the model number on a label inside viewed by lifting the filter.

cards.product: Levi's infant (12-24 month) and toddler (2T to 4T) garments with metal inseam snaps
cards.title: CPSC, Levi Strauss & Co. Announce Recall of Infant and Toddler Garments
cards.hazard: Parts from the metal inseam snaps can detach from the garment, posing a choking risk for young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the garments away from children and contact Levi Strauss & Co. for assistance in determining if the garme…
cards.tell: Check the first five digits of the nine-digit product code on the garment label to see if it matches one of the thirteen recalled product codes.

cards.title: CPSC, Gymboree Announce Recall of Children's Fleece Pants
cards.hazard: The cord locks on the pants can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these pants away from children immediately and return them to any Gymboree store for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They can be identified by the Gymboree label on the back pocket and the care label inside stating Made in Indonesia and 2000 Gymboree.

cards.title: CPSC, Remington Products Co., LLC Announce Recall of Hairdryers
cards.hazard: These hairdryers are not equipped with an appliance leakage current interrupter plug (ALCI plug) to cut off electrical current in case of contact with water. If dropped in water, the hairdryers pose…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the hairdryers immediately, and return them to the store where purchased for a full refund. Consumers also can…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The model name and number are printed on the air intake grill.

cards.title: CPSC, Hurricane Products Announce Recall of Propane Regulators
cards.hazard: These regulators can leak propane, which can result in a fire or explosion. The leak can cause the appliance flame to be larger than expected, possibly causing burns to nearby consumers and cause nea…
