cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using this product immediately. Consumers should either throw out the can or return it to the place where purchased,…
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled; the 16-ounce aerosol cans are red, orange, yellow, black and white with a red plastic cap and the words FIRE CAP FIRE and SMOKE SUPPRESSANT on the front.

cards.title: CPSC, Prometheus International Inc. Announce Recall of Novelty Lighters
cards.hazard: The lighters do not have any child-resistant mechanisms, as required by the Consumer Product Safety Act. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a free replacement lighter with a…
cards.tell: The Intruder model looks like a miniature propane or scuba tank with a clear body and black sleeve, while the Jupiter model has a gun-like metal body with engraved Prometheus branding.

cards.title: Toy Chests Recalled by Thornwood Furniture
cards.hazard: The lids on these toy chests could fall onto a child's head or neck. An investigator for the Georgia Office of Consumer Affairs discovered the problem with the toy chest while conducting retail surve…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop children from using the toy chests and contact the store where purchased, for information on getting a fr…
cards.tell: Check the rear panel for the Thornwood Furniture product sticker and model number 841LQ or 1814LQ.

cards.product: Vanguard V-twin gasoline engines and plastic fuel filters
cards.title: Vanguard Engines and Fuel Filters Recalled by Briggs & Stratton
cards.hazard: The fuel filters on these engines can leak gasoline, posing a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Stop using these recalled Vanguard engines and fuel filters even if no leaks are detected. Briggs & Stratton will install a new fuel filter…
cards.tell: Check the identification tag on the side of the engine for model numbers and an 8-digit date code between 990215XX and 991117XX. Fuel filters show part number 808116 on the bottom.

cards.title: Men's Sweatshirts Recalled by Eddie Bauer
cards.hazard: The sweatshirts, which fail to meet federal mandatory standards for fabric flammability, could ignite readily and present a serious risk of burn injuries, in violation of the Federal Flammable Fabric…
cards.remedy: Stop using these sweatshirts and return them to any Eddie Bauer store, for a refund.
cards.tell: Recalled sweatshirts are gray, bear "Made in USA" on the neckline label, and have item number 1313 or 1249 on the side seam label.

cards.title: Ladies' Robes Recalled by HANRO USA
cards.hazard: The robes fail to meet federal flammability standards for clothing and can ignite readily, presenting a serious risk of burn injuries. Fabrics that do not comply with the standard typically burn fast…
cards.remedy: Stop using these robes immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund and a $50 HANRO gift certificate.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled robes by checking the sewn-in label that reads HANRO of Switzerland.

cards.title: CPSC, Shopko Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Baby Garments
cards.hazard: The rose-shaped buttons on these garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these garments, and return them to Shopko, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units of Peek-A-Babe baby garments are recalled. Collar labels include 'MADE IN CHINA' and 'Peek-A-Babe.'

cards.product: Pokémon balls distributed with Burger King kids meals
cards.title: In Wake of Second Death, CPSC and Burger King Again Urge Consumers to Destroy and Discard Pokemon Balls
cards.hazard: The balls pose a suffocation hazard to children under three years of age.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the balls away from children under the age of three. They should discard the ball or return both halves o…
cards.tell: All units of the Pokemon balls distributed with Burger King kids meals are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Ariens Co. Announce Recall of Snowblowers
cards.hazard: Fuel can leak from the fuel-line connection, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these snowblowers immediately, and return the unit to a local dealer for a free repair.
cards.tell: Check the model and serial numbers located on the lower handlebar of the unit against the specific recalled ranges listed in the description.

cards.title: CPSC, K2 Corp. Announce Recall of In-Line Skates
cards.hazard: The skate's plastic brake mount could crack and fail, causing the skater to fall and suffer serious injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these skates immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for free replacement skates.
cards.tell: Check the tongue for the FLIGHT ALX brand and model numbers S00161 or S00162, and look for a manufacturing date before November 20, 1999, stamped on the heel footbed.

cards.title: CPSC, The Sherwin-Williams Co. and Brockway Standard Inc. Announce Recall of Furniture Refinisher
cards.hazard: The product and its vapors can seep or leak from the nozzle base at the top of the can, posing a risk of fire and chemical injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using this refinishing product immediately, and place the product in a well-ventilated area. Since it can leak, care…
cards.tell: Check the bottom of the metal can for a black ink code matching one of the recalled lot number sequences; cans with blue ink codes are not included.

cards.title: CPSC, Sauder Woodworking Announce Recall of Computer Armoires
cards.hazard: The upper doors or upper door components can fall off, causing injury to nearby consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the computer armoire immediately and call Sauder to order a free repair kit. The repair kit includes safety bra…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the sticker attached to the armoire or in the assembly instruction book, and look for washed pine, woodland oak, classic cherry, fruitwood, or amber oak finishes.

cards.product: Miniature skateboard keychains attached to Z.Z. Jamboarder teddy bears
cards.title: CPSC, Vermont Teddy Bear Co.® and Zany Brainy, Inc.® Announce Recall of Skateboard Keychains Sold With Teddy Bears
cards.hazard: The skateboards' wheels can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these skateboard keychains away from young children immediately, and return them to any Zany Brainy® store to receive…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can tell by the Z.Z. Jamboarder name and Limited Edition 1999 tag under the left arm.

cards.title: CPSC, Reckitt & Colman Inc. Announce Recall of EASY-OFF Oven Cleaner
cards.hazard: The oven cleaner's contents can spew out because of an improperly attached valve assembly, that can separate from the can. Direct contact with the contents poses a risk of chemical burns to consumers…
cards.remedy: Consumers should not remove the cap of this oven cleaner. Consumers should wrap the recalled can of oven cleaner in several layers of newsp…
cards.tell: Check the bottom of the 16-ounce yellow can for lot number B9305-NJ2.

cards.title: CPSC, L.L. Bean Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Overalls
cards.hazard: Snaps on these overalls can detach from the garments, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these overalls, and return them to L.L. Bean for a refund.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled overalls by the sewn-in label showing style number 0DB48 or 0HS39 located on the garment.

cards.title: CPSC, Nordstrom Inc. Announce Recall of Infant and Girls' Sweatshirts
cards.hazard: Zipper pulls on these sweatshirts can detach from the garments, posing a choking hazard to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop wearing these sweatshirts immediately, and return them to any Nordstrom store, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are pink or blue, feature a heart-shaped zipper pull, and have collar labels reading Baby N or N Kids.

cards.title: Safe Generator Use for Y2K: CPSC, DeVilbiss Air Power Company Alert Consumers About Gasoline Tanks on Certain Portable Generators
cards.hazard: CPSC and DAPC are investigating whether the fuel tanks on the generators can crack where the tanks mount on the frame, posing a fire hazard. As a precaution until that evaluation is complete, consume…
cards.remedy: Any consumer who has seen leakage from the tank should not use the generator and should contact DAPC to obtain a free warranty replacement…
cards.tell: Affected units have tanks bearing dates prior to June 1, 1999, found on the serial barcode label on a gasoline tank support rail or the shipping carton label.

cards.title: CPSC, Burger King Corporation Announce Voluntary Recall of Pokemon Ball
cards.hazard: The balls may pose a suffocation hazard to children under three years of age. Pokemon balls are the ball-shaped plastic containers that hold Pokemon toys in Burger King kids meals. Either half of the…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately take the balls away from children under the age of three. They should discard the ball or return both halves o…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. These are plastic ball-shaped containers between 2 and 3 inches in diameter that pull apart to reveal a Pokemon toy inside.

cards.title: CPSC, Neiman Marcus Announce Recall of "CerArte" Candles
cards.hazard: The painted surfaces on these candles can ignite, spark, burn rapidly, and drip wax, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these candles immediately and return them to any Neiman Marcus store for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are painted metallic candles packaged in clear plastic with a gold label on the bottom stating Made in Italy and a Neiman Marcus label.

cards.title: CPSC, Hanna's Candle Co. Announce Recall of Millennium Candles Sold at SAM'S CLUB Stores
cards.hazard: The candle holder can crack when the burning wick touches the side of the glass, causing lacerations.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these candles immediately and return them to any SAM'S CLUB store for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The box is labeled The Millennium Martini Scented Candle and the candle is in a martini glass with four wicks.

cards.product: Rich Pacific miniature Christmas lights and icicle-style lights
cards.title: CPSC, Rich Pacific Ltd. Announce Recall of Christmas Lights
cards.hazard: CPSC has found that these lights have undersized wires, that can pull out of the plugs and individual light sockets, posing shock or fire hazards.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these lights and return them to the store where purchased, for store credit.
cards.tell: Recalled lights lack an Underwriters Laboratories UL label and have specific numbers printed on the back of the red packaging.

cards.title: CPSC, Kelty Announce Recall to Repair Backpack Child Carriers
cards.hazard: The seat height adjustment strap on these carriers can slip out of the buckle. A child can slide downward in the seat unexpectedly and could fall out of the carrier.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these backpack carriers, and contact Kelty for instructions on getting the free repair kit.
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by the model name written on the side, the Kelty K.I.D.S. or L.L. KIDS label, and purchase date from March 1999 through December 1999.

cards.product: Fashion Bug gold-colored candles (Christmas tree or cherubs)
cards.title: CPSC, Fashion Bug Announce Recall of Christmas Candles
cards.hazard: The gold coating on these candles can ignite, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these candles immediately and return them to any Fashion Bug store, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The Christmas tree candle is about 7 inches high with a label on the bottom reading Made in China, and the cherub candles are about 3 inches high sold in pairs.

cards.title: CPSC, Safari Ltd. Announce Recall of Magnet Games
cards.hazard: Paint on the magnets metal figures contains amounts of lead that exceed federal standards for children's products. Prolonged exposure to high levels of lead presents a lead poisoning hazard to young…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately remove the metal figures from the magnetic base and discard them.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled games by the item numbers 6652-16, 6653-16, or 6654-16 printed on the triangle-shaped box.

cards.title: CPSC, NHTSA and Kolcraft Announce Recall of Infant Car Seats/Carriers
cards.hazard: When used as an infant carrier, the handle can unexpectedly move from the intended carrying position, causing the seat to suddenly rotate. When this happens, the infant can fall to the ground and suf…
cards.remedy: Check the label on the side of the product for the manufacturing date and five-digit model/style number and contact Kolcraft, which will pr…
cards.tell: You can tell by checking the model and manufacture date on a label on the side of the seat, where the model number starts with 1312X, 1382X, 1383X, 1384X, 1385X, 368XX, 43XXX, or 7700X and dates from January 1, 1993 thr…

cards.product: Jingle Bell miniature Christmas lights and icicle-style lights
cards.title: CPSC, Jingle Bell Enterprises Inc. Announce Recall of Christmas Lights
cards.hazard: These lights have undersized wires that can easily pull out of the plugs and individual light sockets, posing fire and shock hazards.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these lights, and return them to the store where purchased for either a refund or a replacement set…
cards.tell: Recalled units lack a UL label and have item numbers 00450 through 00455, 00491, 11491, and 11451 printed on the back of the red packaging.

cards.product: Selecta wooden toys: "Quatrino" wooden shape sorter toys, "Sorting Box" shape sorter toys, "Favola" shape sorter toys,…
cards.title: CPSC, Käthe Kruse Doll Co. Announce Recall of "Selecta" Wooden Toys
cards.hazard: The balls included with these toys are banned because they present a serious risk of choking deaths to young children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should take these toys away from young children immediately, and return them to the store where purchased for a refund. Consumers…
cards.tell: All units of these Selecta wooden toys are recalled. Check for specific names like Quatrino, Sorting Box, Favola, or Kugelbahn and accompanying small wooden balls.

cards.product: Royce Union ABT 2000 Mountain Bicycles (model no. 16368)
cards.title: CPSC, Royce Union Bicycles Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Men's Mountain Bicycles
cards.hazard: The frames of these bikes can break apart, causing falls and serious injuries to riders.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles, and call Royce Union for information on receiving a free replacement bicycle.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled bicycle by model number 16368 located on the bottom of the frame near the crank and pedals, and by the silver and red color with "Aluminum 2000" on the top tube.

cards.product: Huffy ALX 1000 bicycles (model no. 26809); ALX 1500 bicycles (model no. 26849), and Aluminum 300 bicycles (model no. K6…
cards.title: CPSC, Huffy Bicycle Co. Announce Recall of Men's Mountain Bicycles
cards.hazard: The frames of these bicycles can break apart, causing falls and serious injuries to riders.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop riding these bicycles, and call Huffy for information on receiving a free replacement bicycle.
cards.tell: Check the model number located on the bottom of the frame near the crank and pedals, which matches 26809, 26849, or K6809.

cards.product: Children's pajamas sold at Gap and Old Navy stores
cards.title: CPSC, Gap Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Pajamas
cards.hazard: The pajama sets fail to meet federal children's sleepwear flammability standards. The standards require sleepwear to be flame-resistant, and if the fabric ignites, the flame must self-extinguish. Fai…
cards.remedy: Parents and caregivers should immediately stop allowing children to wear these pajamas and return them to any Gap or Old Navy location for…
cards.tell: Check the style numbers 353558, 353554, 733002, 733032, 466291 or 674060 located on labels sewn into the side seams or collar of the garments.

cards.title: CPSC, Viking Sewing Machines Recall Sewing Machines
cards.hazard: When removing the sewing machine's power cord from the power transformer on the sewing machine, loose pins from the power transformer could remain in the cord, posing a risk of electric shock.
cards.remedy: Consumers should only unplug these machines from the wall outlet, and should not remove the power cord from the sewing machine power transf…
cards.tell: Check the serial number on the bottom of the machine; it is recalled if it falls within the specified serial number ranges.

cards.title: CPSC, Southern Exchange Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Camp Mess Kits
cards.hazard: The mess kit's sauce pan handle does not lock into place and the mess kit's fry pan handle can bend during use, spilling hot foods or liquids onto consumers and causing serious burns.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the mess kit immediately and return it to the store where purchased, for a refund or replacement mess kit.
cards.tell: All Texsport five-piece mess kits with item number 13150 are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Northern Bedroom's Inc. Announce Recall of Bunk Beds
cards.hazard: The top bunk does not have guardrails on both sides. A child could fall or become entrapped between the wall and the mattress if there are not guardrails on the top bunk.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled beds immediately and email the company to receive free guardrails for the top bunk.
cards.tell: All units of the Prestige, Spindle, and Cottage model wooden bunk beds made from Northern White Ash are recalled, as there is no identifying information on the beds.

cards.product: Sunbeam®, Hankscraft® and SunMark® humidifiers with water tanks that glow in the dark
cards.title: CPSC, Sunbeam® Announce Recall of Glow-In-the-Dark Humidifiers
cards.hazard: These humidifiers can develop an electrical short, presenting a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these humidifiers, and call Sunbeam for instructions on returning the products for a free replaceme…
cards.tell: Check the brand name, service numbers on the motor housing or inside plastic housing, and date codes stamped on the plug beginning with I001 through J226.

cards.title: CPSC, Manufacturers Announce Recall to Replace Toy and Youth Basketball Nets
cards.hazard: Children could strangle on loops or openings in nets that come unhooked from the rim or have knots that slide. If children put their heads into these openings, the net can get tangled around their ne…
cards.remedy: Consumers should remove and throw away nets that can unhook or have knots that slide. Manufacturers will send consumers new nets that secur…
cards.tell: Check the manufacturer's name on the backboard, base, or hoop for Franklin Sports Slam Dunk, Huffy Sports Youth One-On-One, or Lifetime Products Shoot Case sets.

cards.hazard: The straps on the bottom of the net can break. Children can fall out under the net and off the trampoline and be injured.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the safety nets immediately and contact JumpSport. JumpSport will send consumers free replacement bottom straps.
cards.tell: Recalled nets have black buckles and black or red extension straps on the yellow straps with JumpSport printed in red.

cards.title: CPSC, J.C. Penney Announce Recall of Boys Jackets
cards.hazard: There are 7-inch drawstrings at the bottom of the jackets. Children could be dragged if the drawstrings catch in a vehicle's door, and suffer injury or death.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the jackets immediately. Either remove the drawstrings or return the jacket to the nearest J.C. Penney store fo…
cards.tell: All USA Olympic brand reversible boys jackets are included in this recall.

cards.hazard: If the strobe becomes flooded, gas build-up can cause the battery cap to forcefully eject off of the strobe or cause the front section of the strobe to violently separate from the back section. Piece…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these strobes. Any strobe suspected of being flooded, which is indicated when the unit either stops…
cards.tell: All model YS-50 strobes are recalled, along with model YS-60 and YS-120 strobes having serial numbers beginning with 96 or 94 written inside the plastic housing.

cards.title: CPSC & Dynacraft Industries Recall Mountain Bikes
cards.hazard: These bikes could have defective handlebar stems, which will not tighten sufficiently to lock onto the bicycles. This can cause the front wheel not to turn properly, resulting in serious injuries to…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop riding these bikes immediately and take them to the Fred Meyer Store where purchased, for a free inspection and repai…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled bikes by the model number located on the left side of the seat post: 8504-50 (purple, girls), 8504-51 (blue, boys), 8547-84 (purple, women), or 8547-85 (black, men).

cards.title: Century Offers Cash Reward for Recalled Infant Swings Four strangulation deaths reported
cards.hazard: The swings, which were manufactured by Century from 1991 through 1997, have shoulder harness straps that are placed over each shoulder and buckled between the infant's legs. If the straps on these sw…
cards.remedy: The repair program is no longer available. Parents and caregivers should immediately stop using these infant swings and discard or destroy…
cards.tell: The recalled swings can be identified by model numbers 12-344, 12-345, 12-347, 12-475, or 12-476 located on the bottom of the swing's seat.

cards.title: CPSC, Perfecto Manufacturing Inc. Announce Recall of Aquarium Lights
cards.hazard: Sharp edges on these lights could cut the insulation on the wiring. If the wires become exposed, consumers could suffer shocks or electrocution. There is also a risk of fire. In addition, some of the…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these aquarium lights, unplug them, and return them to Perfecto for a free replacement.
cards.tell: All 36-inch SHOlights holding two bulbs, and all lights manufactured in July 1999 or earlier, are recalled. Check the white label with an anchor on the metal reflector.

cards.product: Model T-2 hand-held electrical voltage and continuity testers
cards.title: CPSC, Fluke Corp. Announce Second Recall of Electrical Testers
cards.hazard: The batteries in the tester could fail to maintain proper contact due to corrosion within the battery compartment, causing the device to lose power. Consumers testing electrical sources could fail to…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these voltage and continuity testers immediately, and contact Fluke to obtain a free repair kit or arrange to s…
cards.tell: Recalled units have a serial number lower than 74165430 located on the back of the unit above the wire leads.

cards.title: CPSC, Woods Industries, Inc. Recall Extension Cord Reels
cards.hazard: The housing of the extension cord reels could become energized, resulting in electrical shock or electrocution.
cards.remedy: Unplug the cord reels immediately and stop using them. Woods Industries is offering consumers either a refund or a free replacement extensi…
cards.tell: Check the back label for catalog number 28003 and date code Y MY or Y JE, and look for an unmarked silver-colored stud on the bottom mounting ring.

cards.title: CPSC, Fairlong International Recall Extension Cords
cards.hazard: The cords have undersized wires, incorrect ratings, lack overcurrent protection and allow polarize plugs to be incorrectly inserted into the receptacles. These cords present fire, shock and electrocu…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled cords immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund. Consumers also can r…
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled; the white or brown plastic cords are 6 or 9 feet long with 3 receptacles and caution statements imprinted on a plastic safety cover.

cards.title: CPSC & Penda New York Recall Cigarette Lighters
cards.hazard: The lighters do not have any child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards.
cards.remedy: Stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units of these novelty and disposable cigarette lighters are included in this recall.

cards.product: North West Blue boys hooded jackets and sweatshirts
cards.title: CPSC & Montgomery Wards Recall Boys Jackets and Sweatshirts
cards.hazard: The jackets and sweatshirts have hood drawstrings. Children can get entangled and strangle in the drawstrings that catch on playground equipment, fences or tree branches.
cards.remedy: Stop wearing the jackets and sweatshirts. Either remove the drawstrings from the hood or discard or destroy these products.
cards.tell: Check the care label for identification numbers RN90866 or RN81862 and the neck label for North West Blue.

cards.title: CPSC, Holmes Products Corp. Announce Recall of Portable Heaters
cards.hazard: The thermostats in some of these heaters are improperly positioned, which can cause them to overheat, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these heaters, and contact Holmes for information on how to receive a refund.
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the model number HFH-297 and the date code including 98 on a label located on the back, right-hand corner.

cards.product: Stihl Weed Trimmers, Brushcutters and Augers
cards.title: CPSC & Stihl Recall Various Weed Trimmers, Brushcutters and Augers
cards.hazard: Fuel could leak from an unsealed seam in the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Stop using these products immediately, and call Stihl to determine if your trimmer, brushcutter or auger is part of this recall. If so, con…
cards.tell: Check the model number on top of the engine shroud and the serial number on the metal plate stamped into the crank case base.

cards.title: CPSC & Midland Consumer Radio Recall Weather Radios
cards.hazard: The radio contains a programming error, which can cause the device to fail to recognize certain signals broadcast by the National Weather Service. Consumers could fail to receive some National Weathe…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately return the recalled radio to the store where purchased, to receive a new model 74-200 radio that has been prog…
cards.tell: Recalled units are model 74-200 with serial numbers beginning with 904 or 905 located on the bottom of the unit.

cards.title: CPSC, GE Announce Recall of Dishwashers
cards.hazard: The dishwashers have a slide switch that allows consumers to choose between heat drying and energy saver functions. Over time, the slide switch can melt and ignite, presenting a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dishwashers immediately. Keep the dishwasher door unlatched to prevent the flow of electric curren…
cards.tell: Recalled units have model GSD500D, GSD500G, GSD540, HDA467, HDA477 or HDA487 with a serial number having a second letter of A, M, R, S, T, V or Z, located on a label on the inner tub front edge.

cards.title: CPSC, Shine International Trading Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Cigarette Lighters
cards.hazard: The lighters child-resistant mechanisms fail to meet the requirements of the Consumer Product Safety Act. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards. Additionally, the…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these lighters immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a full refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The lighters have SHINE imprinted on the metal top and a warning label on the plastic body.

cards.product: York International Corporation Diamond 80 downflow mid-efficiency furnaces

cards.hazard: Because of inadequate gluing, the insulation surrounding the heat exchanger can separate from the cabinet wall of the furnace, and fall onto the heat exchanger. This could cause surrounding combustib…

cards.tell: Check the model number P2DP, PBKD or XEDO2 and serial numbers beginning with EECM through EGEM on a label inside the furnace cabinet.

cards.title: CPSC, Universal Candle Co. Announce Recall of Halloween Pumpkin Tealight Candles Sold at Bath & Body Works
cards.hazard: The candles can burn with a high flame, presenting fire and burn hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the candles immediately, and return the candles to any Bath & Body Works store for a full refund and a $10 gift…

cards.title: CPSC, Gateway Announce Recall of Foam Rubber Toy Cows

cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using Scrub Free Daily Shower Cleaner and Scrub Free Daily Shower Spray purchased prior to October 5, 199…

cards.remedy: Parents should immediately stop their children from wearing these robes. Return these robes to any Limited Too store for a refund of the fu…
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled. You can tell by the Limited Too label, 100 percent polyester content, and Made in Sri Lanka marking.

cards.title: CPSC, Elegant Headwear Co. Announce Recall to Repair Infant and Toddler Hats
cards.hazard: The hats have a one-piece chin strap. These one-piece chin straps can lead to strangulation if they get caught on playground equipment, riding toys or other catch points.
cards.remedy: Consumers should cut the one-piece chin straps on the infant and toddler hats in half. CPSC reminds consumers never to place any type of co…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Check the inside tag for 100 percent Acrylic, Made in U.S.A., and RN 36299 or RN 82864.

cards.title: CPSC, Emerson Electric Co. Announce Recall to Repair Ceiling Fans
cards.hazard: Over time, the bracket holding the fan can fail, causing the fan to fall or hang by its electric wires. The fans can fall at any time, possibly causing injuries to bystanders. In addition, exposed wi…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately check to see if their Emerson ceiling fan's housing has a two-piece canopy. Air Comfort will arrange to help c…
cards.tell: All units of model CF10N1 ceiling fan installation kits are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Toro Co. Announce Recall of Lawn-Boy Power Mowers
cards.hazard: Interference with the mower's mulching fan can cause the mower blade to crack and break off. Broken pieces of the blade can be propelled from underneath the mower, possibly injuring the operator or a…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these recalled mowers immediately. The company is mailing consumers free repair kits which include a new mower…
cards.tell: You can tell if your mower is recalled by checking the model and serial numbers printed on a decal located on the right rear of the mower.

cards.product: First Alert True Fit safety gates
cards.title: CPSC, BRK Announce Recall of First Alert True Fit Safety Gates
cards.hazard: Plastic parts of the gate can break off into small pieces, creating a potential choking hazard to young children. In some cases, when parts break off, the gate will no longer be secure.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these gates immediately and call BRK to obtain a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. A label on each gate identifies it as First Alert Model CSSG1.

cards.title: CPSC, Yang Lin Trading, Wholesale World Announce Recall of Christmas Lights
cards.hazard: These Christmas lights are poorly constructed, have undersized wires, no fuse to protect against overheating, and the wires can easily pull out of the plugs. They present a fire and electrocution haz…
cards.remedy: Consumers who purchased these recalled Christmas lights should immediately stop using them. The lights may be returned to the place of purc…
cards.tell: All units of these specific uncertified lights distributed by Yang Lin Trading and Wholesale World are recalled, identifiable by lacking an independent testing lab certification label like UL and having specific packagi…

cards.title: CPSC, Kmart Corp. Announce Recall of Angel Tree-Top Ornament
cards.hazard: The fabric used in making these ornaments is flammable, posing a fire hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these ornaments and return them to Kmart for a refund. For further information about this recall, c…
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled ornaments by the label attached to the power cord, which reads Made in China for Kmart Corporation and CODE: 0-377728- 118.

cards.title: CPSC, American Hua Mao Enterprises Announce Recall of Cigarette Lighters
cards.hazard: These cigarette lighters, which operate with push-button electronic ignition mechanisms to produce the flame, have child-resistant mechanisms that do not work. Young children could ignite the lighter…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these cigarette lighters and return them to the store where they were purchased, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are Windproof #L2 and #L3 models with a stick-on-label reading MADE IN CHINA.

cards.title: CPSC, Toy Manufacturers Announce Recall to Replace Toy Basketball Nets
cards.hazard: Children could strangle on loops or openings in the nets that come unhooked from the rim, or have knots that slide. If children put their heads into these openings, the net can get tangled around the…
cards.remedy: Consumers should remove and throw away nets that can unhook or have knots that slide, and call the manufacturer. However, one of the manufa…
cards.tell: Check the manufacturer's name and model located on the backboard or base of each toy and contact the manufacturer to determine if the net needs to be replaced.

cards.title: Hair Dryers Recalled by Sound-Tech Import
cards.hazard: These hairdryers are not equipped with Ground Fault Circuit Interrupters (GFCIs) to prevent electric shock, in case of current leakage.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these hairdryers and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund.
cards.tell: All units are recalled. You can identify them by the label near the air vent reading International AC 110V and model number SX-3000 on the carton.

cards.title: Extension Cords Recalled by Morton Paper Co.
cards.hazard: The cords have undersized wires that cannot carry the advertised load, lack overcurrent protection and are equipped with plugs that are not polarized properly, presenting fire, shock and electrocutio…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled cords immediately and return them to the store where purchased, for a refund. If consumers have qu…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. They are white or brown household extension cords packaged in green, white and red display sleeves with UPC codes ending in 18006 through 18020.

cards.title: CPSC, Marco Alert Consumers to Gas Fireplace Recall Due to Fire Hazard
cards.hazard: If the interior vent pipe separates from its connection to the exterior wall of the house, hot exhaust gasses can start a fire inside the wall.
cards.remedy: Marco already has repaired about 9,000 fireplace vent systems since July 1998. All other owners need to stop using these recalled fireplace…
cards.tell: Recalled fireplaces have a six or seven digit model number starting with 794 or 797 on a label inside the lower grill door, and often include CCT or MGC36DV.

cards.product: Garden Play Yard Pals crib and play yard rail toys
cards.title: CPSC, Summer Infant Products Inc. Announce Recall of Crib Rail Toys
cards.hazard: The plastic flower toy stem on this toy can break when bent, creating a sharp edge hazard for young children, and possibly causing cuts or puncture injuries.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the Garden Play Yard Pals immediately and contact Summer Infant Products to get a replacement product or refund.
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled. The toy features three figures on a plastic base with Summer written in white letters on the front.

cards.product: L.L. Bean backpack child carriers, model number AC25
cards.title: CPSC, L.L. Bean Inc. Announces Recall of Backpack Child Carriers
cards.hazard: Small children can become entangled in the carrier's harness,which poses a strangulation risk. Also, small children can work their way out of the harness and fall through a leg opening or topple out…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the carriers immediately and call L.L. Bean to receive instructions for returning the carrier for a refund or f…
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled unit by model number AC25, written on a tag in the upper left side of the rear storage compartment.

cards.title: CPSC, IRIS U.S.A. Announce Recall of Plastic Toy Storage Chests
cards.hazard: These chests, that were originally marketed for the storage of toys, lack a lid-support device, do not have adequate ventilation when the lid is closed, and have latches that secure the lids. Childre…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately prevent children from having access to these chests, and stop using them for toy storage. Consumers in househo…
cards.tell: Recalled chests have labels showing the chest being used for toy storage and a caution about not sitting on the lid or climbing in the trunk.

cards.title: CPSC, Rubbermaid Inc. Announce Recall of Icy Rider™ Toboggan
cards.hazard: The flexible, bowed front of the toboggan can break away while in use, causing loss of control and injury.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these toboggans immediately. To make arrangements to get a replacement toboggan with a reinforced bowed front,…
cards.tell: Recalled units are made of purple plastic with a yellow rope, yellow bolts, and a red Rubbermaid logo on the front. Blue models with green bolts and ropes are not recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, DeWalt Announce Recall to Repair Framing Saws
cards.hazard: The saw's lower blade guard can fail to fully close during use, leaving the blade exposed and presenting a risk of laceration.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these framing saws and take them to a DeWalt/Black & Decker service center for a free repair.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled saw by model number DW378G on the black nameplate and date codes 9813F through 9820F on the bottom of the saw below the power cord.

cards.title: CPSC Announces Multiple Play Yard Recalls Due to Strangulation Hazard
cards.hazard: Toddlers can strangle in these playpens, if pacifier strings or loose (or loosely woven) clothing catches on the playpens' protruding rivets.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these playpens and call the manufacturers (except for the three companies out of business) to parti…
cards.tell: Check the brand name on the floorboard, side rail, or plastic hinge covers depending on the brand, and look for protruding rivets.

cards.title: CPSC, Pacific Scientific Co. Announce Recall of Treadmills
cards.hazard: An electrical short can occur in the treadmills' motors, presenting electrocution, shock and fire hazards to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately unplug the recalled treadmills and call Pacific Scientific Co. for information on participating in the recall.…
cards.tell: The manufacturer's name and model number or name are found on the treadmill itself.

cards.title: Kolcraft, Playskool Double Reward for Return of Recalled Portable Cribs
cards.hazard: The cribs have rotating top rail hinges. These top rails can collapse, entrapping children and suffocating them.
cards.remedy: Despite a nationwide effort over the past five years to alert the public about this recall, some of the 11,000 cribs originally sold could…
cards.tell: All units of this model are recalled. They have two nylon mesh sides, two blue solid plastic ends, and Playskool in white letters on a red background on each end.

cards.title: Soldering Irons Recalled by Custom Accessories
cards.hazard: The internal connections in the soldering iron are not insulated, presenting a shock and electrocution hazard.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the soldering iron immediately and return it to Walmart for a refund or a replacement soldering iron.
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled soldering iron by part number 10764W and the brand name Electro-Tek written on the packaging, along with a black plastic handle and a silver label with red UL marking.

cards.title: Entertainment Units Recalled by AIG Designs Holding
cards.hazard: The light fixture in these units can have exposed wiring, which could cause a fire or cause serious shock or electrocution.
cards.remedy: Consumers should unplug the light fixtures immediately and call Sears to schedule a free, in-home service visit to replace the fixtures.
cards.tell: All units of this entertainment unit are recalled, which have black or white finishes and glass-front doors sold as three-piece sets or individual pieces.

cards.title: Bedside Cradles Recalled by W.C. Redmon
cards.hazard: The legs on the cradles can become loose and can separate, causing the cradle to tip.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the Cuddle Me Close cradle immediately and call Redmon for free replacement legs.
cards.tell: All units of the Cuddle Me Close bedside cradle are recalled.

cards.title: "Henry" Gym Sets Recalled by Menard
cards.hazard: If assembled incorrectly, the glider support tube on these gym sets could bend or break, causing the riders to fall or be thrown from the glider.
cards.remedy: Consumers should not allow children to ride on the gym set glider until they check if their gym set is assembled correctly. To determine th…
cards.tell: All Henry gym sets model 68 are included in this recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Manufacturers Announce Recall of Wooden Bunk Beds
cards.hazard: The beds have spaces on the top bunk that present potential entrapment and strangulation hazards to young children. The spaces can be large enough for a child's body to pass through, but small enough…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled beds immediately and call the company for a replacement guardrail, retrofit kit or instructions th…
cards.tell: Check the manufacturer, model number, and description to see if it matches the specific recalled wooden bunk beds sold between 1986 and 1998.

cards.product: Ponytail Top-Corded Handle Upright Vacuum Cleaners
cards.title: CPSC, Electrolux Announce Recall to Repair Top-Corded Vacuum Cleaners
cards.hazard: The power cords on these vacuums extend out of the very top of the handle, and the cord is often used as an extension of the handle. The power cord can break inside the handle or the casing around th…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these vacuums, and return them to an Electrolux store for a free repair. The handle on the vacuum w…
cards.tell: Only Electrolux upright vacuums with the cord coming out of the very top of the handle are included.

cards.title: CPSC, DeWalt Industrial Tool Co. Announce Recall to Repair Electric Screwdrivers
cards.hazard: The screwdrivers' wiring design can result in the user being shocked.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these screwdrivers immediately and take them to the nearest DeWalt/Black & Decker service center for a free rep…
cards.tell: Check the model number and numeric date code from 9601 to 9833 located on the nameplate on the right-hand side; units ending with an R are already repaired.

cards.product: Grillmaster gas grills with side burners
cards.title: CPSC and Sunbeam Products Inc. Announce Recall of Gas Grills With Side Burners
cards.hazard: The side burner's propane gas hose can twist up toward the aluminum casting of the grill, causing overheating and melting of the hose. Gas leakage or a fire could result from the hose damage.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled grills immediately and call Sunbeam to receive a free retrofit kit. The retrofit kit contains a wi…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the identification label on the back of the grill to see if it matches the recalled list.

cards.title: Love Me Tender Dolls Recalled By Tonka Products
cards.hazard: Choking
cards.tell: All units of model number 8900 and 8901 Love Me Tender dolls are included in this recall.

cards.product: NIKE Air Face Up men's basketball shoes
cards.title: CPSC, NIKE Announce Recall of Men's "Air Face Up" Basketball Shoes
cards.hazard: The basketball shoes have a small decorative metal rivet located on the outside of the shoe, that can bend and form a sharp edge.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these basketball shoes and should immediately return them to the store where purchased, to receive a substitute…
cards.tell: Check the model number on the label on the inside tongue of the shoe, above the UPC code, for model numbers 830080, 139358, or 630327.

cards.title: I-T-E Circuit Breaker Box Inspection Program Announced By Siemens
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled boxes by a five-digit date code on the top of the wiring diagram label inside the door, including H2586 through H3186, J0186 through J3086, and K0186 through K2486.

cards.product: Speed Queen caster-equipped Contempo Stack combination washer-dryer
cards.title: Contempo Mate Stack Washer-Dryer Retrofit by Speed Queen
cards.tell: All caster-equipped units of the Contempo Mate stack washer-dryer are included in this retrofit program.

cards.product: Children's vampire capes and witch brooms
cards.title: CPSC, Rubie's Costume Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Vampire Capes and Witch Brooms
cards.hazard: The capes and the brooms, which fail to meet federal mandatory standards for flammability, could ignite readily and present a serious risk of burn injuries to children.
cards.remedy: Consumers should not let their children wear the vampire capes or use the 27-inch witch brooms this Halloween. Consumers should return the…
cards.tell: All units are recalled. Capes feature a cardboard insert with No. 50282, and brooms have a sticker with Style No. 85.

cards.title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall to Repair Power Wheels Ride-On Battery-Powered Vehicles
cards.hazard: The vehicles' electrical components can overheat and cause fires. Children can suffer injuries from fires and house fires can occur. Additionally, wiring problems can prevent the vehicles from stoppi…
cards.remedy: Consumers should remove the vehicles' batteries right away and not let children use these Power Wheels vehicles. The firm will be providing…
cards.tell: All models with two batteries and certain models with one battery sold before October 1998 are recalled; check the Power Wheels logo and model name on the vehicle.

cards.title: Stuffed Animal Recalled by Great American Toy Co.
cards.hazard: The crab's antennas have sharp wires, presenting a puncture wound hazard to children.
cards.remedy: Stop using the stuffed crabs immediately, and return them to: Great American Toy Co. Inc., 22A Sintsink Drive East, Port Washington, N.Y. 1…
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; this involves only stuffed crabs with wired antennas and the letters BSW on the Great American Toy Co. label attached to the toy.

cards.title: Bi-fold Doors Repair by Schweiss Distributing
cards.hazard: The doors lack a safety shield, which could allow door operators and bystanders to become entrapped in moving door parts, such as the drive drums and cables, causing serious injuries, such as amputat…
cards.remedy: Schweiss is offering a free safety shield to help prevent further injuries. Until the safety shield is installed, consumers should use extr…
cards.tell: All units of these bi-fold doors are recalled. They may feature writing that includes Schweiss Chicken Pluckers.

cards.product: Individually sold xylophones, Little Ones® Infant three-piece musical gift sets, and Little Ones® Infant five-piece mus…
cards.title: CPSC, Playwell Toy Announce Recall of Xylophone Mallets
cards.hazard: The rounded ends of the xylophone mallets are smaller in diameter than the 1.75-inch standard for small balls. The mallets can get stuck in the throats of young children, blocking their airways, and…
cards.remedy: Firm no longer in business. Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product. Do not donate or resell.
cards.tell: All units are not recalled; check packaging for Item No. 044073 or stickers reading PLAYWELL SOUND TOY SERIES on individually sold xylophones.

cards.title: CPSC, Central Sprinkler Recall Omega Fire Sprinklers; Settle Lawsuit
cards.hazard: CPSC alleges that, on average, between 30 and 40 percent of Omegas removed from various locations across the country for testing failed to activate as they should. CPSC is warning consumers that they…
cards.remedy: Recall remedy no longer available. Discard the product. Do not donate or resell.
cards.tell: Check the model markings on the fire sprinkler to see if it matches the recalled Omega models listed.

cards.title: CPSC, Kmart Corp. Announce Recall of Inflatable Baby Floats
cards.hazard: The seat of the pool toy can tear at the seam, causing children to unexpectedly fall into the water and possibly drown.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these baby floats, and return them to their nearest Kmart store for a refund.
cards.tell: All units of this product are included in the recall.

cards.title: CPSC, Deckers Outdoor Corp. Announce Recall of Children's Teva Sandals
cards.hazard: The straps attached to the footbed of the sandals can come apart. This can cause falls.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these sandals immediately. To get information on obtaining a refund, contact Deckers.
cards.tell: You can tell recalled units by the strap colors Abstract Bright, Abstract Pink, or Frog Blue, and a black footbed.

cards.product: 2-pole ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) circuit breakers
cards.title: CPSC, Siemens Energy & Automation Inc. Announce Recall of GFCI Circuit Breakers Used with Hot Tubs and Spa
cards.hazard: These GFCI circuit breakers could overheat and lose their ability to prevent injury or death.
cards.remedy: Consumers should switch the recalled GFCI circuit breaker to the "off" position immediately to disconnect the power supply. Consumers shoul…
cards.tell: Only 2-pole units with a product identification sticker showing Siemens or Murray and the phrase 2 Pole Unit are recalled.

cards.product: Royal Sovereign model RST-1200 portable heaters
cards.title: CPSC, Royal Centurian/Sovereign Announce Recall of Portable Heaters
cards.hazard: The mechanism, which rotates the heater side-to-side, can wear through the insulation of electrical wiring inside the heater's base. In addition, some of the connections between the electrical wires…
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using these heaters immediately and call Royal Centurian Inc. for instructions on returning the heaters for free repa…
cards.tell: Recalled units have serial numbers beginning with 92, 93, 94, 95 or 96 located underneath the heater's base.

cards.title: Skil Hammer Drill Recalled by S-B Power Tool
cards.hazard: A wiring problem presents the possibility of an electric shock or electrocution in these drills.
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using these drills. To arrange for a free repair, consumers should call S-B Power Tool.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled drill by the model number 6464 and date codes 767 through 868 stamped on the nameplate on the side.

cards.title: Onika Iron Recalled by Bargain Wholesale
cards.hazard: The irons have inappropriate size wiring, which can cause a fire. The plastic housings of the irons are not resistant to ignition. Additionally, the irons present a potential scald hazard during use.…
cards.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using this item and return it to the place of purchase, for a full refund.
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled iron by the writing on the electric cord reading CH0001708-91 and the red box labeled Onika Steam/Dry Spray Iron and ZQYD150g.

cards.product: Philips Magnavox Home Audio Theatre Systems
cards.title: CPSC, Philips Consumer Electronics Company Announce Recall to Repair Philips Magnavox Home Audio Theatre Systems
cards.hazard: The system's speaker voice coil can overheat and lead to a speaker fire, presenting a fire hazard to consumers.
cards.remedy: Consumers should stop using the systems immediately and call Philips for instructions on receiving the free repair.
cards.tell: Check the model number MX920 prominently displayed on the front of the receiver cabinet and on a rear label.

cards.title: CPSC, Atico International USA Inc. Announce Recall of Pacifiers Sold at Bath & Body Works
cards.hazard: The nipples on these pacifiers could separate from the base, posing a choking hazard to children.
cards.remedy: The firm is out of business, the remedy is no longer available, and the product should be discarded or destroyed.
cards.tell: All units of these pacifiers are recalled, including those sold in diaper bag gift sets and individually with clips.

cards.title: TV Guards Recall/Repair by TV Guard
cards.hazard: Laceration
cards.tell: All units are recalled; they are clear plastic shields featuring a white warning sticker and sold in a blue box.

cards.title: Stationary Entertainers Repair/Recall by Graco
cards.hazard: Choking
cards.tell: Check the model number and manufacturing date, which is the first six digits of the serial number, located on a label underneath the Entertainer's tray.

cards.product: Limited Too children's satin pajama sets
cards.title: Children's Satin Sleepwear Recalled by Limited Too
cards.hazard: Fire & Fire-Related Burn
cards.tell: This recall involves 100 percent polyester woven satin children's pajama sets in sizes 6 through 14 sold from December 1995 through July 1998.

cards.product: First Choice power strip surge protectors
cards.title: Power Strip Surge Protectors Recalled by First Choice Products
cards.hazard: Electrocution/Electric Shock
cards.tell: All units of these two models are recalled; there is no significant labeling on the power strips themselves, but they were sold in specific distinctive boxes.

cards.product: Nikon Speedlight amphibious high-performance electronic flash unit bodies
cards.title: Underwater Flash Units Recalled by Nikon
cards.hazard: Vehicle Accident
cards.tell: You can identify the recalled unit by the Nikonos Speedlight Model SB-103 designation on the flash unit body.

cards.title: Go-Karts Recalled by Tiger Industries
cards.hazard: Entrapment
cards.tell: All units of Tiger and Black Max go-karts are recalled.

cards.title: Child Carriers Recalled by Evenflo
cards.hazard: Strangulation
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the model numbers 522101 or 522102 and the manufacturing dates between June 1, 1996, and October 31, 1997, found on a white tag attached to the bottom of the carrier.

cards.title: Fold-N-Go® Care Centers Recalled by Century
cards.hazard: Entrapment
cards.tell: You can identify recalled units by model numbers 10-750 or 10-760 manufactured before September 1998, with the model number and date found on the underside tube.

cards.title: Children's Furniture Sold at Target Recalled by PJ Toys
cards.hazard: Lead
cards.tell: All units of the specific circus and princess-themed items listed with item numbers on the original packaging are recalled.

cards.title: Flying Dolls Recalled by Tara Toy
cards.hazard: Laceration
cards.tell: All units are recalled; they are seven inches tall with the words Made in China embossed on the back of the leg.

cards.title: Paper Candle Shades Recalled by MacKenzie-Childs
cards.hazard: Fire & Fire-Related Burn
cards.tell: All units are recalled. MacKenzie-Childs, Ltd is printed inside the shades, which are decorated with various colors, designs, beads, and ribbons.

cards.product: Nippon AC power strip surge protectors
cards.title: Extension Cords & Power Strip Surge Protectors Recalled by Okura
cards.hazard: Electrocution/Electric Shock
cards.tell: Check for Nippon America labeling on packaging, China embossed on extension cord plugs, or a silver sticker on the bottom of the power strip reading AC Surge Protector and model 14-515.

cards.title: Mini Audio Systems Repair/Recall by AIWA America
cards.hazard: Fire & Fire-Related Burn
cards.tell: Recalled units have model number CX-NA303U on the back, while unaffected units have a red and white A on the back.

cards.product: Baby Trend Baby Express Portable cribs/play pens
cards.title: Portable Cribs and Play Yards Second Warning
cards.hazard: Collapse
cards.tell: All units of the specifically named previously recalled portable cribs and play yards are included in this warning due to collapsing top rails.

cards.title: Wooden Bunk Beds Recalled by Lexington Furniture
cards.hazard: Entrapment
cards.tell: The recalled twin size bunk beds have specific brand names or model names and numbers stenciled on the inside frame of the bed.

cards.title: Christmas Windmills Recalled by Boscov's Department Stores
cards.hazard: Fire & Fire-Related Burn
cards.tell: All units are recalled. This is a 14-inch pine wooden windmill decoration with a green roof, red trim, nativity scene, and red-star printed fans, sold in a mostly red box.

cards.product: Brass Eagle's Z Leader Xtreme Vision 280 paintball masks
cards.title: Paintball Masks Recalled by Brass Eagle
cards.hazard: Laceration
cards.tell: Lenses that bear a date stamp molded into the lens on a tab at the outside corner of the wearer's right lens are not included; recalled masks have Z Leader on the lens and an eagle logo on the forehead.

cards.title: Mulan Backpacks & Rolling Luggage Recalled by Pyramid Accessories
cards.hazard: Lead
cards.tell: All units of this product are included in the recall. The items feature Disney Mulan artwork in pink or purple colors.

cards.product: Kmart Splash Club Deluxe Inflatable Kiddie Boats
cards.title: Inflatable Kiddie Boats Recalled by Kmart
cards.hazard: Fall
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled; the boats are orange with blue handles and feature writing including 'SPLASH CLUB' and a dolphin picture.

cards.title: Children's Jewelry Sets Recalled by Almar Sales
cards.hazard: Choking
cards.tell: Check the style number on the cardboard hang tag attached to the sets; recalled styles are NB104, NB113, NB114, NB118, and NB136.

cards.title: Toy Chests Repair/Recall by Crate & Barrel
cards.hazard: Entrapment
cards.tell: All units of this Crate & Barrel toy chest are recalled.

cards.title: CPSC, Warns That Old Servel Gas Refrigerators Still In Use Can Be Deadly
cards.tell: All Servel gas refrigerators manufactured between 1933 and 1957 are included in this recall.

cards.product: Sure-Pik Bowling Ball Returns Recall/Repair by AMF Bowling Products
cards.title: Sure-Pik Bowling Ball Returns Recall/Repair by AMF Bowling Products
cards.hazard: Entrapment
cards.tell: All units are recalled; consumers should look for plastic guards and warning labels installed on the side of the Sure-Pik ball returns.

cards.product: Activity Block Sets Recalled by T.S. Toys
cards.title: Activity Block Sets Recalled by T.S. Toys
cards.hazard: Choking
cards.tell: All units of this product are recalled. You can identify them by the item number 38329 and the packaging labeled QUALITY FunKids TOYS Activity Blocks T.S. Toys.

cards.product: Animal Toys With Sound squeaker toys
cards.title: Jet Fighter & Animal Squeak Toys Recalled by In-Mar Trading
cards.hazard: Choking
cards.tell: All units of these toys are recalled; the animal squeak toys are marked with item 828-6 and the jet fighter is marked with Marlboro USAF- 28 DL.

cards.title: Electric Baseboard Heater Thermostats Revised Rating & Recall by Honeywell
cards.hazard: Fire & Fire-Related Burn
cards.tell: Check the brand name stamped on the front and the model number located underneath the unit's snap-off front cover.

cards.title: CPSC, Bemis Manufacturing Announce Recall of Lawn Chairs
cards.hazard: Collapse
cards.tell: You can tell the recalled chair by Model 2068 embossed on the underside of the seat, available in white, green, and taupe.

cards.product: Knock-A-Ball Wooden Toy Recalled by Laiko International
cards.title: Knock-A-Ball Wooden Toy Recalled by Laiko International
cards.hazard: Choking
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The packaging states 'WOODEN TOY KNOCK-A-BALL' and 'ITEM NO.785'.

cards.title: Rattles Recalled by Michael Friedman
cards.hazard: Choking
cards.tell: All units are recalled. The 5.25-inch rattles look like pink or purple roses with a green stem handle and the words Hong Kong embossed on the lower portion.
